Are you a dynamic ERP leader ready to architect and execute business-critical transformations across global operations? Do you thrive in high-visibility roles where your expertise in Epicor Kinetic and manufacturing environments drives real change? If so, this confidential opportunity is your chance to lead at the forefront of digital evolution.
Our client, a U.S.-based, global engineering and manufacturing organization, is undertaking a major ERP transformation across multiple international sites. As Director of ERP Systems, you will report to the CIO and play a key leadership role in modernizing and harmonizing business processes through Epicor (Kinetic and E10), Salesforce integrations, and related corporate systems.
This is a strategic, hands-on position ideal for a leader who excels in a fast-paced, multi-system, global environment and is passionate about turning ERP potential into business reality.

• Drive business process harmonization across multi-site manufacturing operations.
• Collaborate with international stakeholders to translate operational goals into scalable ERP solutions.
• Manage internal teams and external vendors to ensure project delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
• Support integrations with CAD, PLM, and other enterprise tools.
• Provide technical oversight, troubleshoot system issues, and ensure end-user support and training.
• Maintain documentation, governance, and data integrity across ERP ecosystems.

What You Bring:
• 7+ years of ERP leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
• Proven success leading Epicor implementations/upgrades (especially Kinetic).
• Strong grasp of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, manufacturing workflows (Make to Order, Engineer to Order), and costing/accounting models.
• Experience with data migration and designing archive repositories.
• Familiarity with PLM and CAD systems (Autodesk, SolidWorks, ePlan, etc.).
• Adept at SQL and data-driven business analysis.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across levels and functions.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or related field.

Nice to Have:
• Experience managing geographically dispersed ERP teams.
• Prior work in international rollouts and multi-company environments.
• Working knowledge of Salesforce integrations.

Job Description

Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

The Enterprise Information Services (EIS) team at Cedars-Sinai understands that true clinical transformation and the optimization of a clinical information systems implementation is fueled through the alignment of the right people, processes, and technologies.

Why work here?

Cedars-Sinai placed in the top 20 on Newsweek’s “World's Best Smart Hospitals 2024” list, which highlights hospitals that have excelled in the utilization of electronic functionalities, telemedicine, digital imaging, artificial intelligence and robotics.

The organization’s Healthtech excellence was acknowledged again, this time by the esteemed “CHIME Digital Health Most Wired“ recognition program. Cedars-Sinai was assigned a Level 10—the most prestigious level of certification—among more than 300 surveyed healthcare organizations. Cedars-Sinai netted high scores across multiple verticals and particularly excelled in areas of infrastructure, interoperability, and population health innovation.

What will you be doing in this role:

The ERP Project Manager is responsible for coordinating all phases and activities vital to implement various ERP initiatives: system requirements definition, process and/or workflow redesign, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiation (if applicable), implementation coordination with operations and other EIS departments, as well as transition to support functions. The ERP Project Manager works closely with operational and IT stakeholders to ensure project alignment with organizational goals, compliance requirements and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Responsible for crafting and leading all aspects of detailed project budgets and timelines, progress updates, project slide decks, and blocking issues. Provide project management expertise for an entire project life cycle. Ensures contract compliance, risk analysis, project scope, implementation management, and support transition.
• Coordinate communication between all project team members and operational partners, ensure vendor responsiveness and compliance with the terms of the contract (if applicable), and coordinate initial user training/transition to an ongoing user support group.
• Ensure ERP initiatives align with business needs, compliance requirements, and EIS capabilities.
• Drive continuous improvement and automation to streamline operations and reduce manual efforts.
• Build and sustain strong working relationships with operational partners, taking ownership of issue resolution and ensuring successful outcomes.
• Multi-functional Project Execution – Improve resource planning, risk management, and critical metric tracking to ensure successful ERP adoption.
• Forecast resource requirements, ensuring appropriate assignment of resources to each project/support phase, adding and removing resources as vital, and have overall responsibility for completion of projects. Lead and manage projects within established time and budget parameters.
• Deliver informative and timely status reports using department reporting procedures for both internal EIS and external operational customers.
• Keep abreast of current trend and developments in Oracle Cloud and ERP through participation with vendor user groups, attend conferences, vendor demonstrations, and interacting with other vendor customers. Maintain a solid grasp of system development and project management methodologies.

This remote position is approved for workers in the following states only: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, and Texas.

Qualifications

Experience Requirements:

One (1) year plus of experience leading IT projects, ideally ERP-related, within a healthcare or similarly complex environment.

Solid understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP, including Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and Payroll modules.

Experience with UKG Timekeeping and Scheduling or similar systems.

Background in healthcare IT project management is highly desirable.

Educational/Certification Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare, Management, Business or related field.

PMP (Project Management Professional) preferred.

We celebrate diversity as it fuels our creativity, enriches our solutions, and drives our success. We're not just building technology; we're building bridges between people, ideas, and possibilities. Together, we thrive, grow, and make a positive impact on the world.

Senior ERP Consultant – IFS Cloud Implementation (9-12 Month Engagement)

Job Description:
We are seeking two Senior ERP Consultants to support a large-scale IFS Cloud ERP implementation. This will be a long-term contract (9-12 months), working closely with our team and the client to ensure a smooth and successful ERP deployment.

The ideal candidates are seasoned ERP professionals with deep experience in IFS Cloud, strong client-facing skills, and the ability to guide business and technical teams through the implementation process.

Key Responsibilities:

✅ Lead functional and technical implementation efforts for IFS Cloud
✅ Work directly with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into ERP solutions
✅ Configure, customize, and optimize IFS Cloud modules based on project requirements
✅ Provide hands-on problem-solving and troubleshooting for ERP-related issues
✅ Conduct system testing, validation, and end-user training
✅ Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations
✅ Ensure smooth data migration, system integration, and post-go-live support

Ideal Candidate:
• 8+ years of ERP implementation experience, with at least 3+ years specific to IFS Cloud
• Strong background in business process mapping, configuration, and deployment
• Experience with ERP data migration, integrations, and customizations
• Client-facing and customer service-oriented mindset – excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to work independently and proactively solve problems in a fast-paced environment
• Prior consulting or professional services experience preferred

Project Details:
• Duration: 9-12 months (full-time or near full-time commitment)
• Remote with occasional on-site meetings (TBD based on project needs)
• Competitive hourly rate based on experience

This is an exciting opportunity to work on a high-impact ERP project with a dynamic team. If you are an experienced IFS Cloud consultant who thrives in a collaborative, client-facing role, we’d love to hear from you!

Please answer these questions in your cover letter:
• What is your desired hourly rate for this role?
• Do you have experience with ERP data migration, integrations, and customizations?
• Have you led functional and technical implementation efforts for IFS Cloud?

Competencies:

Communication Effectiveness - Articulate and present a friendly Customer Service experience in both phone and in person. Communicates effectively verbally and in writing; expresses self well in a group and one-on-one; Fosters trust by sharing information with others; Encourages open expression of ideas and opinions; actively listens to others and demonstrates understanding.

description:
Are you ready to make an impact?

West Monroe is currently seeking a Senior Manager to join our Operations Excellence practice within our Transformation Enablement & Outsourcing Advisory (TEOA) discipline. This person will bring expertise advising clients on technology and digital transformation initiatives for core business systems (ERP) during complex mergers and carveout transactions.

What You’ll Do
• Lead teams serving clients across various industries (e.g. - consumer & industrial product, healthcare & life sciences, Utilities, high-tech and software, insurance) demonstrating executive presence with C-level client counterparts, particularly in the context of Office of CIO advisory.
• Provide expertise in buy-side and sell-side merger & carveout transactions supporting activities through end-to-end M&A lifecycle (e.g. – Technology Diligence, Pre-Close/Day 1 Readiness, Post-Close Execution) associated with core ERP platforms (e.g., SAP ECC, SAP GROW, SAP RISE, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, SAP Ariba) and integrating ERP applications.
• Lead separation planning and integration planning phase by defining separated/integrated state platform strategy, identifying value creation opportunities, performing core architecture disposition strategies, identifying software vendors and system integrators, identifying business capability impacts, identifying critical entanglements, refining one-time and run-rate cost estimates, and defining roadmap for separation/integration.
• Manage TSAs, ensuring all contractual obligations are met and aiding in the transition process, including managing data transfer management process with seller to aid in new system implementations.
• Interface with Private Equity operations and deal teams to inform on major risks, dependencies, decisions, and progress on transaction.
• Manage project economics including tracking project budgets, creating and delivering invoices, and managing the collection process.
• Assess functional and technology investment strategies and compare respective operating models and organizational structures against leading practices and industry benchmarks.
• Support storyline development for project teams – drawing together data analysis, visualizations, recommendations, and financial impacts into a cohesive deliverable.
• Coach and manage other consultants and actively participate in the performance review process.
• Understand client strategy and investment priorities and turn those goals into concrete engagements and detailed proposals.
• Lead internal offering development projects (pitch decks, BD toolkit, GTM plans), in alignment with firm and practice focus areas and strategy.
• Support Directors and Partners in identifying, shaping and pitching projects to new prospects and existing clients.

What You’ll Bring
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
• Minimum of 7+ years of work experience including at least one of the following:
• 3 full lifecycle ERP system implementations (e.g. SAP ECC, SAP RISE, Oracle Fusion Cloud).
• 5 years supporting technology/digital transformation initiatives for core business systems.
• Lead technology workstream for a merger or carveout in a moderate-to-high complexity transaction.
• Experience managing client relationships in a consulting firm environment.
• Global technology transformation experience; leading complex engagements and managing teams of 3-10 members.
• Experience in SAP or Oracle ERP.
• Experience in LeanIX or similar Enterprise Architecture tools is a plus.
• Expert program manager with extensive experience managing multiple projects including developing work plans, project scopes, pricing estimates, budget management, issue and risk management, and presenting deliverables.
• Business development experience including farming leads and assisting in managing the sales process – pursuit strategy, client development cycle and tools, proposal development, fee and profitability planning, and contract management.
• Strong data visualization and analysis skills; experience in financial analytics and models; highly proficient using tools like Excel to analyze data and present key insights in a compelling way.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills including the ability to create impactful and concise executive stakeholder-ready deliverables, and polished client-facing oral communication skills.
• Ability to travel as needed for client projects.
• Ability to work permanently in the United States without sponsorship.
• A commitment to inclusion and diversity, and openness to new ideas and perspectives.

West Monroe’s Operations Excellence practice is focused on driving value from strategy through execution—not merely pointing to best practices and standards.  We enable clients to realize the enduring benefits of IT, business, process, and organizational optimization by delivering real, sustainable adoption.  Our solutions focus on value creation through the lenses of people, process, and technology across functional transformation and related platforms, productivity, and transformation enablement. Each consultant within our Operations Excellence practice is aligned to one of four focus areas including Financial Management, Productivity, Supply Chain Management, and Transformation Enablement and Outsourcing Advisory.

Based on pay transparency guidelines, the salary range for this role can vary based on your proximity to one of our West Monroe offices (see table below). Information on our competitive total rewards package, including our bonus structure and benefits is here. Individual salaries are determined by evaluating a variety of factors including geography, experience, skills, education, and internal equity.

Employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, purchase shares from our employee stock ownership program and be eligible to receive annual bonuses. Employees will also receive unlimited flexible time off and ten paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Eligibility for ten weeks of paid parental leave will also be available upon hire date.

Seattle or Washington, D.C.

$194,100—$228,400 USD

Los Angeles

$203,400—$239,300 USD

$212,600—$250,100 USD

Other consultancies talk at you.

At West Monroe, we work with you.

We’re a global business and technology consulting firm passionate about creating measurable value for our clients, delivering real-world solutions.

The combination of business and technology is not new, but how we bring them together is unique. We’re fluent in both. We know that technology alone is not the answer, but how we apply it is. We rely on data to constantly adapt and solve new challenges. Actions that work today with outcomes that generate value for years to come.

At West Monroe, we zero in on the heart of the opportunity, getting to results faster and preparing people for what’s next.

You’ll feel the difference in how we work. We show up personally. We’re right there in the room with you, co-creating through the challenges. With West Monroe, collaboration isn’t a lofty promise, but a daily action. We work together with you to turn vision into clear action with lasting impact.

West Monroe is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer 

We believe in treating each employee and applicant for employment fairly and with dignity. We base our employment decisions on merit, experience, and potential, without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, religion, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state or local law. To learn more about diversity, equity and inclusion at West Monroe, visit www.westmonroe.com/inclusion. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in our recruiting process, please inquire by sending an email to recruiting@westmonroe.com.

Please review our current policy regarding use of generative artificial intelligence during the application process.

Kenyon College is seeking applications for an ERP Programmer Analyst in the Information Technology (IT) department. This is a full time position eligible for benefits, limited to a term of five years (August 2025 through June 2030).

About Us: Join our Team!

Kenyon College, one of the nation’s finest liberal arts colleges, is a small school where academic excellence and a strong sense of community go hand in hand. Kenyon’s beautiful hilltop campus is located in Gambier, OH, 45 miles northeast of Columbus, OH. Kenyon enrolls 1800 undergraduate students, all of whom live on campus the entire time they are students at Kenyon.

The Information Technology (IT) department is an inclusive group committed to ensuring all students, faculty, staff, alumni, and other campus partners have a safe, productive, enjoyable, and meaningful experience with college technology. We provide creative solutions, responsive services, and reliable, secure access to an enabling infrastructure. The IT team is an encouraging environment where we grow, learn, and pursue our craft. We are helpful, kind, friendly, and respectful of all. We enjoy a sense of humor--something we find essential to our success. We make our work fun whenever possible! Work/life balance is valued here: we love our work but understand that there is more to life. Professional development and diversity are also valued here: we continually learn new skills, grow in our understanding of the world around us, and explore new technologies.

About the Position: Do Work that Matters!

Are you a versatile IT professional with a knack for tackling a wide range of technical challenges? If you're adept at managing complex systems, diving into server logs, and assisting partners with innovative solutions, we invite you to join our team.

The ERP Programmer Analyst reports to the Director for Institutional Data Systems and primarily supports the college’s enterprise data system, Ellucian Banner, and its data integrations. The ERP Programmer Analyst will interact regularly with other departments to support the mission of the College, collaborating extensively with other members of the IT team.

The major functional areas for the ERP Programmer Analyst includes database and server management, integration and analysis. The ERP Programmer Analyst supports the ERP system used for Finance, Human Resources, and Academics. The ERP Programmer Analyst also creates and maintains custom system integrations that connect and synchronize data between the enterprise software system and performs the detailed analysis needed to implement these integrations effectively across a combination of campus and cloud infrastructure.

IT team members are encouraged and expected to develop and grow their skills to match the needs of the institution, and to help others grow, too. Recognizing that technology is continually changing, the ERP Programmer Analyst participates in regular professional development and in the larger professional community as well.

Minimum Requirements:

We value both education and experience. A successful candidate should be comfortable with technology, be curious, and love to learn. These are the minimum requirements for a successful candidate:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field or a combination of relevant education and experience. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

These are the preferred qualifications for a successful candidate:
• Three (3) years of professional experience with management, operation, and support of computing systems, preferably within a higher education environment. Experience with Higher Education ERP Systems, specifically Ellucian Banner: Student, Finance and Human Resource (HR) modules. Knowledge of or experience with common programming languages and ability to utilize APIs. Knowledge of database and application upgrades and testing. Knowledge of SQL programming - design, coding and testing. Knowledge of scripting languages - Python, PowerShell, Perl, etc. Knowledge of Oracle DBMS and Microsoft SQL Server DBMS database administration. Knowledge of Windows server and Linux server operating systems . Experience with authentication and authorization.

Working Conditions:

Kenyon is an employer that understands the complexity of modern life. Our IT team works flexible hours and can function in a hybrid environment.

Application Process:
• Applicants should submit a cover letter and a resume.

For full consideration, please submit your materials by June 20th, 2025.

Compensation and Benefits:

Salaries at Kenyon are competitive and commensurate with experience. In addition to an attractive salary, Kenyon offers excellent benefits for employees and their family members. Children of employees are eligible for 100% tuition waivers at Kenyon, and through the Great Lakes Colleges Association, children of employees are eligible for 90% tuition waivers at nineteen other of the nation's finest liberal arts colleges.

We also offer health, dental and vision insurance, TIAA retirement, and many other benefits, including provisions for a spouse, families, and domestic partners. Details about benefits as well as conditions of employment are described more fully in our Staff Handbook.

Kenyon is a unique place to live and work. To discover why it should be your next home, click here.

Kenyon College is an equal opportunity employer and applications from members of all underrepresented groups are encouraged. It is the College's policy to evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, physical and/or mental disability, age, religion, medical condition, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by institutional policy or state, local, or federal law. Kenyon College has a strong commitment to supporting diversity, equity and inclusion. Please visit our Diversity at Kenyon website.

description:
Requisition Number: 69437

The company built on breakthroughs.
Join us.

Corning is one of the world's leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what's possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations- not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company,and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

Corning's businesses are ever evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, and automotive markets. We are changing the world with:
• Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
• Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
• Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
• Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
• Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
Role Purpose

This position will be instrumental in enabling and supporting the implementation of a new plant-wide ERP (Enterprise Resource Management) and support of the existing and future Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) aimed at bringing a growing plant from legacy, independent manufacturing systems to a robust, common systems platform across all plant businesses.

This position will have responsibility for Plant MES administration, providing overall leadership for its proper use, maintenance, upgrades, etc. ensuring alignment with the ERP system

Key Responsibilities
• Work as key member of cross-functional project team to ensure MES system requirements are properly defined, designed, tested, and implemented.
• Cross-functional team includes: corporate system developers, business and IT program managers, plant manufacturing department leaders, process engineers, and hourly workforce leaders and associates.
• Learn from experts regarding fundamentals of system interface design; apply to later functionality as implementation team moves on and database evolution falls under purview of the plant
• Provide overall long-term direction for proper use of ERP / MES, maintenance, upgrades, etc.
• Monitor daily ERP/MES error log and responsibility for troubleshooting and fixing errors in ERP/MES systems with the goal of determining root cause to ensure permanent corrective actions are put in place
• Ensure alignment of ERP master data between the 2 systems (MES & ERP) such as workflows and routers, production orders (status, quantities, dates, etc.), and master data like material tolerances
• Champion MES needs to make manufacturing more efficient
• Provide manufacturing with key reporting and data required to manufacture parts and track performance

Experiences/Education - Required
• 2-year degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Software Development, Engineering or technical degree and/or similar skills and experiences with IT systems / software in a manufacturing environment
• 3-5 years in manufacturing or technical field
• Ability to harvest data from multiple data sources and turn into informative spreadsheet, manufacturing report, or other tool that captures the essence of a manufacturing process in a meaningful, informative way
• Enjoys spending time on manufacturing floor interfacing with hourly workforce working to understand details of their daily challenges and working to create solutions that result in efficiency gains
• Works collaboratively in a diverse team environment, possesses robust written and communication skills, can communicate effectively across numerous groups (project team, manufacturing floor, plant leadership, etc.), and enjoys building strong relationships
• Experience with data visualization via Power BI and SharePoint
• Hands-on project experience with demonstrated success
• Experience harvesting data from multiple data stores via SQL or other
• Strong desire to learn and grow in areas needed for the position that they may not know starting out

Experiences/Education - Desired
• Advanced spreadsheet skills
• Experience managing and supporting databases such as Microsoft SQL
• Experience creating custom reports in Microsoft SSRS
• Programming skills, including .NET, C#
• Familiarity with OSI PI and OPC
• Experience with Camstar and SAP

This position does not support immigration sponsorship.

The range for this position is $51,884.00 - $71,341.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. The benefits available for this position are dependent on hours worked and may include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, pension plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, and PTO.

Corning offers you the total package.

Your well-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial, and career from day one
• As part of our commitment to your financial well-being, we provide a 100% company-paid pension benefit that grows throughout your career. We also offer a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions.
• Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company-paid life insurance, disability, and disease management programs.
• Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives, align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well - when Corning wins, we all win.
• Getting paid for our work is important but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That's why Corning offers a peer-to-peer recognition program to celebrate success by recognizing colleagues who demonstrate above-and-beyond behaviors.

We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To request an accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com.

description:
Responsabilidades clave:

Gestión de datos y supervisión del flujo de trabajo
• Poseer y gestionar el flujo diario de datos operativos y de ventas de múltiples fuentes, incluidos sistemas ERP, hojas de cálculo e importaciones externas.
• Limpie, estructure y fusione conjuntos de datos para garantizar la coherencia, la confiabilidad y la facilidad de uso en todos los departamentos.
• Mantenga la integridad de los datos y garantice actualizaciones oportunas en todas las plataformas, acompañadas de una documentación exhaustiva de los procesos de datos.

Generación de conocimiento y soporte analítico
• Analizar periódicamente datos de importaciones, ventas y proveedores para identificar anomalías, tendencias, inconsistencias y oportunidades comerciales.
• Aprovechar los datos del comercio mundial y los indicadores macroeconómicos para fundamentar las previsiones y estrategias internas.
• Realizar análisis en profundidad de las tendencias del mercado global y los patrones de importación/exportación para respaldar la planificación estratégica y la toma de decisiones.

Control de Ventas y Análisis Comercial
• Supervisar las métricas de desempeño de ventas, las estrategias de precios y el flujo de pedidos para respaldar las funciones de control comercial.
• Garantizar informes precisos sobre los KPI de ventas, proporcionando información útil a los líderes de ventas y a las partes interesadas ejecutivas.
• Apoyar el desarrollo y la aplicación de los procesos de gobernanza de ventas.

Informes y automatización
• Cree y mantenga plantillas y herramientas automatizadas en Excel, Python, Power BI o Tableau para optimizar las tareas de informes recurrentes.
• Ayudar a crear paneles e informes personalizados para mejorar la visibilidad entre los equipos comerciales, logísticos y financieros.
• Apoyar los ciclos de informes semanales y mensuales, garantizando que la información basada en datos se entregue de forma clara y eficaz.

Colaboración y asociación empresarial
• Trabaje en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de gestión para traducir las preguntas comerciales en recomendaciones basadas en datos.
• Brindar soporte continuo para solicitudes de datos ad hoc y proyectos estratégicos en equipos multifuncionales.

Requisitos:
• Sólidas habilidades en Excel (tablas dinámicas, búsquedas, validación de datos, automatización mediante fórmulas/macros).
• Confianza y rapidez en la manipulación de datos utilizando Python (pandas) o SQL.
• Orientado a los detalles, metódico y confiable: prospera en un entorno de rápido movimiento.
• Excelente comunicador: capaz de explicar los datos con claridad a partes interesadas sin conocimientos técnicos.

description:
Te gustaria trabajar en la cuidad de referencia tecnologica a nivel mundial?
Siendo asi, tu oportunidad laboral esta aqui en Malaga.
Te gustaria formar parte del progreso de una cuidad sostenible? Te gustaria ver crecer esta cuidad de la mano de tu propio desarrollo profesional en un grupo empresarial internacional?

Entonces, esto te interesa!
Desde Eulen Seleccion, Division de Soluciones Globales de RRHH y Empleo de Grupo EULEN, seleccionamos un/a Analista Informatico/a en Malaga para importante empresa internacional del sector.
Tienes experiencia como desarrollador, has trabajado en la gestion de plataformas y has generado bases de datos?

En tal caso, tu mision sera:
El mantenimiento nivel 1 y control de una Plataforma de gestion basada en un middleware compuesto, con operaciones CRUD sobre los datos. Esta plataforma de datos permitira una facil integracion de otros sistemas, con la funcionalidad de almacenar cualquier cambio en una base de datos para ir generando un Big Data de toda la informacion.

Funciones:
- Mantenimiento y control de la plataforma de gestion
- Supervision del funcionamiento y seguimiento del proceso
- Planificacion y ejecucion de mejoras y/o actualizaciones
- Facilitacion de la Integracion de sistemas
- Accesibilidad para la generacion de macrodatos
Te ofrecemos:
- Participacion en proyecto muy interesante y retador, donde seguir creciendo y desarrollarte profesionalmente.
- Jornada completa de lunes a viernes por la manana
- Salario bruto anual segun valia y a determinar por la compania
- Contrato indefinido directamente con la empresa cliente
- Incorporacion inmediata

Eres lo que necesitamos porque

- Aportas una Ingenieria tecnica informatica, Grado en Informatica y/o FP Grado superior en informatica.
- Aportas experiencia de al menos 2-3 anos como desarrollador trabajando con las siguientes tecnologias y aplicaciones:- Base de datos en tiempo real NoSQL, en especial se valora base de datos MongoDB.
- Base de datos en tiempo real SQL.
- Arquitecturas cliente-servidor sobre plataforma web NODEJS/Javascript.
- Acceso a la informacion mediante API Rest o mediante mecanismo de Publicacion/Subscripcion usando tecnologia de LiveQuery.
- Tecnologias a utilizar: HTML5, CSS3, y Javascript ES6, React y/o Blaze y construccion de aplicaciones reales en el propio navegador.
- Despliegue de componentes sobre maquinas virtuales con Linux y plataforma Docker, utilizando un cluster de kubernetes.

Otros requisitos:
- Carnet de conducir y disponibilidad de desplazamiento.
- Valorable nivel B2 de ingles o superior.

Te estamos esperando!

Consultor de Tecnología

EY es una red global de servicios profesionales con más de 280,000 personas en 150 países y 700 oficinas en el mundo. Nuestras operaciones en Latam Norte (LAN) cuenta con casi 50 oficinas en más de 10 países nos posiciona en una de las firmas líderes en servicios profesionales en la zona.

Trabajar en EY ofrece una excelente oportunidad por su reputación global, el desarrollo profesional que ofrece a sus colaboradores, las oportunidades de relacionamiento con niveles ejecutivos en todas las industrias, la exposición a experiencias de aprendizaje y de valor para el crecimiento de cada persona y las oportunidades de trabajar con herramientas de vanguardia y contribuir a soluciones innovadoras a diferentes clientes y mercados.

• Profesional en Ingeniería de sistemas, desarrollo de software o a fin.
• Experiencia 3 años en implementación de sistemas, arquitectura empresarial o en implementación de modelos operativos basados en ITIL o en modelos de gobierno de TI.

• Gestión de planes de trabajo.

description_final: Tecnología de agronegocios: somos una solución completa de gestión de agronegocios. Servimos toda la cadena de producción de aves de corral, cerdos, ganado, leche, pescado y alimento. Desde 1996, Agrrosys ha estado desarrollando la tecnología estatal -de -art para áreas agroindustriales. Somos la primera compañía en Brasil en lanzar un ERP dirigido a la gestión de agronegocios, gestionando el concepto de ingeniería inversa (desmontaje en lugar de ensamblaje) dentro de los refrigeradores. ¡Y somos un ritmo constante de crecimiento! Hoy estamos casi 150 talentos centrados en el segmento agroindustrial, y estamos ampliando nuestra participación en Brasil y América Latina, siempre impulsando tecnológicamente a nuestros clientes y expandiendo nuestra base de una manera comprometida y dinámica. Esta hazaña es el resultado de la seriedad, la solidez, la investigación y la dedicación a nuestros clientes y al mercado, ¡y puede ser parte de ella! Su desafío será llevar a cabo implementaciones y una capacitación cara a cara y/o remota para usuarios de módulos industriales, PCP y calidad. Brindar soporte y consultoría durante el proceso de implementación del sistema, asegurando que los clientes usen herramientas de manera efectiva. Rastree la adaptación del cliente a los sistemas implementados, ofreciendo soporte para ajustes y optimizaciones. Colaborar con el equipo de desarrollo para informar los comentarios de los clientes y sugerir mejoras de productos. Prepare la documentación técnica y los manuales del usuario, cuando sea necesario. Actúe como un punto de contacto principal entre Agrosys y el cliente durante el período de implementación. Requisitos para esto, esperamos que tenga: disponibilidad para actuar en persona en nuestra sede en Criciúma/SC; Experiencia con sistemas de producción, inventario y garantía de calidad; Conocimiento del paquete de oficina; Capacidad para realizar capacitación y transmitir conocimiento de manera clara y efectiva; Fáciles de entender y resolver problemas relacionados con los sistemas implantados; Disponibilidad para viajes y CNH B; Mayor capacitación en áreas relacionadas, como ingeniería de producción, administración, tecnología de la información y otros; Los beneficios aquí valoramos el bienestar de nuestros empleados, por lo que estos son algunos de nuestros beneficios: cupón de alimentación de anacardos - (promedio de R $ 550. 00/mes); Cupón de transporte; Día libre en el cumpleaños: aquí disfrutas tu día, la forma en que prefieres; 3x Gimnasia de trabajo en la semana; Wellhub (Gympass); Psicología viva: queremos que cuide su salud en su totalidad, ofrecemos 2 consultas gratuitas por mes con un psicólogo; Conectado: plataforma con varios profesionales de la salud para cuidarlo en su totalidad, con valores muy asequibles. description:
Beneficios:

¡Únete a nosotros! Estamos buscando un técnico de redes calificado que esté bien informado, motivado y con experiencia en soporte técnico y consultoría de redes. Nuestra misión en SDS es asegurarnos de proporcionar a nuestros valiosos clientes infraestructuras de TI que se utilicen al máximo de sus capacidades. Esta función dará soporte a las redes, firewalls, servidores y sistemas informáticos de nuestros clientes finales, incluida la gestión de consultas de seguridad, solicitudes de soporte y la asistencia a nuestros clientes con sus necesidades de TI. El candidato ideal debe tener sólidas habilidades técnicas, excelente servicio al cliente, gestión del tiempo y habilidades de comunicación. Esperamos seguir creciendo como proveedor líder de servicios de TI y esperamos contar con un miembro del equipo al que le apasione formar parte de nuestro equipo de expertos.

Responsabilidades
• Proporcionar soporte técnico profesional a los servidores y redes de nuestros clientes
• Instalar, configurar y actualizar la infraestructura de hardware y las aplicaciones (incluidos servidores, firewalls, conmutadores, VPN, otro hardware físico)
• Evaluar los riesgos de seguridad y recomendar mejoras para proteger los sistemas
• Supervise y evalúe el rendimiento de la red y mejore la seguridad del firewall
• Responda a las solicitudes de soporte de manera oportuna y resuelva los problemas técnicos para minimizar el impacto comercial del cliente
• Desarrollar y mantener procedimientos y documentación tecnológica
• Instruir a nuestros usuarios en las mejores prácticas de uso en tecnología, software, seguridad y equipos
• Liderar y entrenar a otros, capacitarse con otros miembros del equipo y buscar oportunidades para el crecimiento del servicio en SDS

Calificaciones
• Se requiere un título de asociado, licenciatura o experiencia avanzada equivalente en un campo relacionado con TI.
• Experiencia significativa con Microsoft Active Directory y Entra ID (Azure) con compatibilidad de dominio de Microsoft en las instalaciones preferida
• Sólida comprensión de la infraestructura de servidores de red y gestión de seguridad mejorada
• Fuertes habilidades de comunicación, resolución de problemas y habilidades analíticas
• Es deseable el conocimiento y la comprensión de la seguridad EDR, XDR y MDR
• Se prefiere la experiencia de VMWare y/o Hyper-V
• experiencia en la implementación y gestión de firewalls como SonicWall o Cisco
• Conocimiento de los sistemas de copia de seguridad en la nube y otras soluciones seguras de copia de seguridad de datos
• Altamente automotivado con la capacidad de trabajar en un entorno de rápido movimiento
• La capacidad de colaborar eficazmente con el equipo es necesaria para el éxito de la empresa
• Se valorará la experiencia con sistemas telefónicos VOIP y el soporte de entornos inalámbricos

Acerca de la tecnología SDS

Las áreas de proveedor líder de servicios informáticos, reparación de computadoras, servicios comerciales de TI, ventas y servicios de respaldo y seguridad de TI desde 1984. SDS Technology (SDS) es sinónimo en nuestra área de experiencia tecnológica, servicio rápido e innovación. SDS es también el proveedor líder de ventas y servicios de computadoras y redes del área. Hemos alcanzado una reputación de excelencia en nuestra área de mercado porque nuestro personal de técnicos se toma en serio su profesión.

Cuando nuestros técnicos no están atendiendo las variadas necesidades técnicas de nuestros clientes, están estudiando las últimas tendencias y tecnologías de la industria informática y acumulando una serie de certificaciones profesionales orientadas a las necesidades comerciales del mundo real de hoy y mañana.
SDS se dedica y dedica sus esfuerzos a diseñar soluciones que satisfagan las especificaciones y necesidades únicas de los negocios de nuestros clientes

• Configurar aplicaciones de Guidewire y desarrollar reglas de negocio dentro del entorno de desarrollo propio de Guidewire.
• Desarrollar integraciones personalizadas para conectar las aplicaciones de Guidewire con otros sistemas internos y externos mediante JAVA y XML.
• Ejecutar pruebas de configuración/integración para detectar defectos en el desarrollo.
• Liderar un proyecto o parte de proyecto organizando, gestionando y aconsejando a consultores con menos experiencia

• Graduado en Informática o equivalente.
• Inglés B2.
• Experiencia previa como desarrollador en programación orientada a objetos (preferiblemente JAVA), bases de datos relacionales (modelado de datos/SQL), interfaz de usuario web (diseño y desarrollo), XML, arquitectura de aplicaciones distribuidas.
• Conocimiento sobre el ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software (preferiblemente Agile).

En el día a día, esta persona gestionará un gran volumen de llamadas entrantes/salientes y trabajará dentro de una herramienta de gestión de relaciones con los clientes (CRM) para programar citas y registrar los datos de los clientes. Este puesto también solucionará problemas de productos y servicios en todos los departamentos aclarando y documentando las quejas de los clientes, determinando la causa del problema, seleccionando y acelerando la mejor solución y haciendo un seguimiento para garantizar una resolución y comprensión del cliente, trabajando con nuestros consultores de diseño externos para ayudar con preguntas e inquietudes, y un asistente directo del vicepresidente de ventas para necesidades administrativas y de oficina. • Mantener un sólido conocimiento de los productos, políticas y servicios de la organización.

• Programe citas de ventas y mida las citas tanto con los clientes como con el equipo de Window World.
• Resuelva los problemas de los clientes determinando la causa del problema, facilitando una resolución y haciendo un seguimiento oportuno de los clientes.

• Siga los procedimientos operativos estándar.
• Preparar informes de llamadas de servicio al cliente para la gerencia.
• Mantener un espacio de trabajo bien organizado y profesional.
• Proporcionar asistencia con la capacitación y orientación para otros miembros del equipo según se asigne.

description:
Te interesa participar en un proyecto estratégico de implantación de SAP SuccessFactors y Concur en una compañía internacional? ¿Te motiva trabajar en un entorno técnico con autonomía, retos constantes y visión de largo plazo?

En OCA Global estamos construyendo el futuro de nuestra arquitectura tecnológica y queremos que formes parte del equipo que liderará esta evolución. Si disfrutas de la integración de sistemas, la resolución de problemas complejos y el desarrollo de soluciones técnicas que impactan en toda la organización, este proyecto es para ti.

Cuál será tu misión en este puesto?

Te incorporarás al equipo SAP de OCA Global, reportando directamente al Manager del área, para convertirte en una pieza clave en la implantación y evolución de nuestra plataforma SuccessFactors.

Tus Principales Misiones Serán
• Diseñarás e implementarás integraciones entre SuccessFactors y otros sistemas como SAP ERP, Active Directory o herramientas de nómina mediante SAP CPI o APIs.
• Gestionarás la migración de datos, asegurando la calidad y fiabilidad desde los sistemas heredados hacia SuccessFactors.
• Realizarás desarrollos personalizados y configuraciones técnicas cuando las soluciones estándar no sean suficientes, utilizando SAP BTP.
• Administrarás la plataforma SuccessFactors, incluyendo roles, permisos, usuarios API y configuraciones avanzadas como MDF.
• Asegurarás el mantenimiento post-implantación, corrigiendo errores, desarrollando evolutivos y acompañando al equipo de People&Talent.
• Liderarás la validación técnica de los entregables del proyecto y participarás en reuniones clave de seguimiento, velando por la calidad, coherencia e integración con SAP ECC.
• Documentarás procesos, riesgos, pruebas y mejoras para facilitar la evolución continua del sistema.

Este proyecto te permitirá crecer desde la definición de los GAPS hasta la migración futura a S4 / HANA. ¡Tendrás un rol estratégico en cada fase!
• Experiencia previa en SAP SuccessFactors (entre 1 y 2 años) : Para afrontar con seguridad el seguimiento del proyecto, las integraciones y el mantenimiento técnico.
• Conocimiento en integraciones (SAP CPI / APIs) : Esencial para asegurar que nuestros sistemas se comuniquen de forma eficiente y segura.

ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream

Unilever Ice Cream is the largest global Ice Cream Company in the world, with over 100 years of experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences and treats delighting consumers. Committed to innovation, quality, and sustainability we have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of over $8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win.

We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. However, it is not as simple as it may seem. As Ice Cream makers we are serious about happiness. With warm hearts, we create the coolest products.

Job Purpose

The Business Unit Representative - SCF will serve as the key liaison between the Business Unit and the central finance project team, ensuring that the new ERP system aligns with local business requirements while maintaining global standardization. This role is crucial in representing the Business Unit’s needs for Supply Chain (Including Factories), Logistics, Transfer Pricing and Costing, Net Working Capital Management and Planning functions while ensuring compliance with financial regulations delivering Performance Management solution.

This Position Is Part Of a Large-scale ERP Implementation Project, Expected To Last 2.5–3 Years. Business Unit Representatives Will Cover One Of The Following Regions

Europe (Base AMS / London)
Asia (Base China)
METSA (Middle East, Turkey, South Asia)
Americas (Base Brazil / USA)

Business Unit Representation & Financial Process Alignment:
Act as the primary representative of the Business Unit for all SCF discussions.
Ensure BU Supply Chain financial requirements are reflected in the ERP implementation and financial process design.

description:
Transform Your Career

We deliver unparalleled opportunities for growth and career advancement. Our dynamic, entrepreneurial culture supports your journey every step of the way.

Embrace new challenges and deliver real value to some of the world’s most influential Fortune 100 brands, growth companies transforming their industries, and mid-market firms that need help navigating the defining moments of their lifecycle. Work side by side with business leaders to solve complex client challenges and make a true impact. Love what you do as part of a diverse organization committed to collaboration and continuous learning.

The Team: Risk & Regulatory - ERP Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC) & Internal Control Automation Solutions

Our team is comprised of a powerful mix of seasoned professionals with public accounting experience and business consultants with a deep expertise in a broad range of industries and focus areas. We take a comprehensive approach to help clients navigate through internal audit, risk, and compliance activities. We work as a broader team to address a wide range of business needs across the organization. 

Your Impact

Provide ERP, automation, AI and data analytics support to clients of our growing Risk and Regulatory practice. Serve in a client-facing and field team leader role by leading defined work streams focused on IT risk and automation. Activities include:

Lead risk advisory engagements from beginning to end, including planning, execution, reporting, and supervision of consultants.
Apply current knowledge of IT trends, techniques, and risks to identify technology enabled opportunities to enhance value to our clients.
Identify internal controls issues within our clients’ ERP environment and design and implement solutions to mitigate risk.
Develop understanding of core ERP processes and look for opportunities to help management in gaining process efficiencies and control optimization.
Summarize and document results of ERP internal controls testing for management reporting including proper disposition of test exceptions.
Assist clients redesign and transform their ERP risk management and related technical controls to achieve their compliance goals.
Contribute to the growth of the risk advisory team to achieve key goals and initiatives.
Develop thought leadership materials.
Participate in business development activities.
Actively participate in career development activities and technical training of staff.
Document and perform analysis of client environment including technology strategy, current technology architecture, organizational structure, and business processes.
Develop strategies and recommendations for technology-enabled solutions including key aspects of architecture, migration and security.
Responsible for the analysis, design and implementation of automation solutions.
Support the development of an Automation Center of Excellence to align client’s strategic priorities, develop performance/risk reporting, and support the transition to a new service delivery model (e.g. Agile).
Develop automation solutions across various platforms

What Do You Need to Succeed?

Minimum Qualifications:

8+ years of ERP, automation and data analytics experience in professional services and/or specific relevant internal audit industry experience.
Public accounting firm experience.
CISA, CISSP, or other applicable certification.
Knowledge of ERP security and control leading practices to provide clients effective and practical recommendations.
Hands-on experience with one or more “low code” RPA, AI and/or data analytic tools and techniques.
Subject Matter Expertise on select ERP applications such as SAP, Oracle Cloud, NetSuite or Workday.
Ability to lead workshops, including the gathering/documenting of requirements and use-cases and recommendation of envisioned processes.
Understanding of typical software development lifecycles (Waterfall and Agile) and their associated lifecycle artifacts.
Experience with identifying and correcting problems in imperfect data and processes.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Management Information Systems or a related field.
Must be flexible for travel.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience architecting and developing AI/ML solutions.
Experience programming in Python, SQL, and/or R.
Significant experience and/or Certification Alteryx, PowerBi and UiPath.
ERP security assessment and/or design and implementation experience.
Experience with the design and implementation of ERP GRC tools and related processes.

description:
Backend Systems Integration Engineer (OMS / ERP / Shopify)
tarte cosmetics is seeking an experienced Backend Systems Integration Engineer to join our Order Management Systems (OMS) team. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the seamless flow of data between our Shopify Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) storefront and backend systems including ERP, Vertex (tax), and ESW (international logistics).
The ideal candidate is a systems-minded troubleshooter with strong technical fluency across APIs, cloud tools, and databases. This role is highly cross-functional, partnering with Planning, Customer Experience, QA, and Engineering teams to support clean, timely, and reliable order processing.
This is a hybrid position based in New York City and requires working in our office at least 3 days per week.
Key Responsibilities

Monitor and troubleshoot order and data flows between eCommerce front-end, ERP, tax, and fulfillment systems 
Investigate and resolve sync failures, webhook issues, and data mismatches using Postman, SQL, and system logs 
Reprocess or replay failed API calls and validate successful resolution 
Escalate, track, and document issues via Jira with clear root cause analysis 
Partner with internal teams and external vendors (e.g., Shopify, Vertex, ESW) to identify and resolve integration issues 
Support UAT/staging testing and monitor CI/CD pipelines during release cycles 
Maintain SOPs, system documentation, and integration flow diagrams 
Ensure smooth operation of critical data workflows in a fast-paced production environment 

Qualifications

3-8 years of experience in technical operations, eCommerce systems support, or integration-heavy environments (e.g., WMS, OMS, ERP) 
Strong proficiency in REST/GraphQL APIs (e.g., Shopify, Salesforce Commerce, Magento, BigCommerce) 
Experience using AWS tools such as EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, SNS, and Route 53 
Proficient in SQL for querying large datasets, optimizing schema design, and tuning performance 
Comfortable navigating Linux/Unix systems, retrieving logs, and using shell/SSH 
Familiar with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows 
Able to read and debug scripts in JavaScript, Node.js, Python, or PHP (for troubleshooting purposes) 
Experience with Jira or similar tools for issue tracking and documentation 
Detail-oriented, well-organized, and thrives in cross-functional technical environments 

Preferred Skills

Experience with ERP platforms like NetSuite or SAP

Experience working with external platforms/vendors (3PLs, tax engines, SaaS APIs) 

What Sets You Up for Success

You love diving into system-level issues and tracing order data across APIs, logs, and databases

Our team is comprised of a powerful mix of seasoned professionals with public accounting experience and business consultants with a deep expertise in a broad range of industries and focus areas. We take a comprehensive approach to help clients navigate through internal audit, risk, and compliance activities. We work as a broader team to address a wide range of business needs across the organization. 

Your Impact

Provide ERP, automation, AI and data analytics support to clients of our growing Risk and Regulatory practice. Serve in a client-facing and field team leader role by leading defined work streams focused on IT risk and automation. Activities include:

Work on risk advisory engagements from beginning to end, including planning, execution, reporting, and supervision of consultants.
Apply current knowledge of IT trends, techniques, and risks to identify technology enabled opportunities to enhance value to our clients.
Identify internal controls issues within our clients’ ERP environment and design and implement solutions to mitigate risk.
Develop understanding of core ERP processes and look for opportunities to help management in gaining process efficiencies and control optimization.
Summarize and document results of ERP internal controls testing for management reporting including proper disposition of test exceptions.
Assist clients redesign and transform their ERP risk management and related technical controls to achieve their compliance goals.
Contribute to the growth of the risk advisory team to achieve key goals and initiatives.
Document and perform analysis of client environment including technology strategy, current technology architecture, organizational structure, and business processes.
Develop strategies and recommendations for technology-enabled solutions including key aspects of architecture, migration and security.
Responsible for the analysis, design and implementation of automation solutions.
Support the development of an Automation Center of Excellence to align client’s strategic priorities, develop performance/risk reporting, and support the transition to a new service delivery model (e.g. Agile).
Develop automation solutions across various platforms

What Do You Need to Succeed?

At a minimum, you will have:

2+ years of ERP, automation and data analytics experience in professional services and/or specific relevant internal audit industry experience.
CISA, CISSP, or other applicable certification.
Knowledge of ERP security and control leading practices to provide clients effective and practical recommendations.
Hands-on experience with one or more “low code” RPA, AI and/or data analytic tools and techniques.
Subject Matter Expertise on select ERP applications such as SAP, Oracle Cloud, or Workday
Ability to lead workshops, including the gathering/documenting of requirements and use-cases and recommendation of envisioned processes.
Understanding of typical software development lifecycles (Waterfall and Agile) and their associated lifecycle artifacts.
Experience with identifying and correcting problems in imperfect data and processes.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Management Information Systems or a related field.
Must be flexible for travel.

Preferably, you will have:

Experience architecting and developing AI/ML solutions.
Experience programming in Python, SQL, and/or R.
Significant experience and/or Certification Alteryx, PowerBi and UiPath.
ERP security assessment and/or design and implementation experience.
Experience with the design and implementation of ERP GRC tools and related processes.
Public accounting firm experience.

Workday

Post-secondary degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in IT business process coordination, ERP implementation, and systems integration.
Experience configuring ERP systems (Workday preferred) and working with SQL and database tools.
Strong understanding of administrative systems and cross-functional business processes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Visio, SharePoint, and project management tools.
Knowledge of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and integration technologies (e.g., APIs, XML, EDI).

Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is considered an asset.

Ability to make decisions regarding administrative systems within the current technology direction.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.

Novicon bietet mit der Munixo Business Software Plattform eine hochmoderne ERP Lösung mit klarem USP und dem „Haben-Will-Faktor“ für anspruchsvolle mittelständische Unternehmen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe ist die Gewinnung von künftigen Munixo Kunden in den Bereichen Dienstleistung oder Handel in der D-A-CH Region zwischen 15 und 500 Mitarbeitern.

Du begleitest Deine Leads vom Erstkontakt über die Discovery und Munixo Software Pitches bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

Bei weiterführenden Demos unterstützen Dich bei Bedarf unsere ERP Consultants.

In Deiner Funktion hast Du ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsfreiraum.

Wir als Sales Kollegen begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und als gegenseitige Sparringspartner. Bei Bedarf unterstützen Dich unsere Fachexperten der einzelnen Abteilungen, um potenzielle Kunden qualitativ zu überzeugen.

Du bist ein "Hunter" und Dein innerer Antrieb sowie Dein ausgeprägter Verkaufswille sind die Basis Deines Erfolgs.

Du hast einen hohen Anspruch Dir gegenüber und möchtest durch Qualität überzeugen: Du beweist ausgeprägtes Gespür für Herausforderungen und Kundenwünsche in Geschäftsprozessen. Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, diese durch Software abzubilden und zu optimieren, schafft Vertrauen und macht Dich für potenzielle Kunden zu einem geschätzten Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe.

Du hast eine hohe IT-Affinität und Du pitcht gerne Software.

Du baust Dir Deine Sales Pipeline zu einem Teil auch selbst auf.

Deine Begeisterungs- und Präsentationsfähigkeit setzt Du erfolgreich innerhalb von Kunden-Pitches ein und überzeugst in der Präsentation den Key User gleichermaßen wie das C-Level.

Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung (Hochschulstudium oder kaufmännische Ausbildung) und konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder als Anwender von ERP oder CRM Software sammeln.

Deutsch ist Deine Muttersprache oder du sprichst hervorragend deutsch.

Onboarding: Du bekommst eine gründliche und persönliche Einarbeitung, um Deine Power möglichst effizient auf die Straße zu bringen.

Package: Fixum plus ungedeckeltes OTE Package.

Unterstützung: Profitiere von unserer langjährigen Branchenerfahrung, ergänzt durch ein Produkt mit perfektem Market-Fit.

Wertschätzung: Auch wenn jeder im Vertriebsteam eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, halten wir als Mannschaft fest zusammen. Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien und sind respektvoll, loyal und anerkennend.

Purpose: Unsere Kunden stehen in den nächsten Jahren vor großen Herausforderungen. Nie war Personal so rar und teuer. Es besteht enormer Automatisierungsdruck. Dafür hat Novicon mit Munixo die Lösung. Wir helfen, den Mittelstand auch in Zukunft wettbewerbsfähig zu halten.

Wir möchten den Bewerbungsprozess so schlank wie möglich gestalten. Für einen ersten Eindruck von Dir benötigen wir:


Deinen Lebenslauf

Den frühestmöglichen Starttermin

Deinen groben Gehaltswunsch

description:
Company Description

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7500+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

Job Description

IFS Norway is seeking for a dynamic and ambitious individual to join our team as a Senior Functional Service Consultant. You will be at the forefront of IFS product implementations working directly with IFS customers and partners on cutting edge industry solutions in the Energy Utility & Resource sector.

Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to work with geographically distributed teams around the globe which will provide you with international exposure through project implementation and commercial execution.

To be successful in the role, you will have a background of successful ERP project implementations and enjoy being the key functional expert for Service in the Energy Utility & Resource domain.

You will be responsible for combining industry experience with IFS best practices to guide the customer through the implementation of our core IFS business solutions.

Qualifications

To succeed in the role as a senior consultant, we expect you are:

Experienced in guiding our customers to improve their business through a deep understanding of the core IFS solution and industry accelerators. 
An expert in Service processes and interfaces. 
Confident in designing and documenting solutions, challenge and advise customers, and deliver on expectation thus ensuring success for both parties. 
Acting as a trusted advisor in articulating and critically evaluating customer-specific business solutions. 
Seeking opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and deepen customer relationships. 
Understanding customer business needs and guiding them in the most effective usage of IFS Products. 
Conducting customer training sessions and workshops. 
Guiding and assisting the customer with testing and Go Live cut-over strategies and following rollout implementation. 
Keeping up to date with regulatory and compliance requirements of the EU&R domain in the key focus industries. 
Managing, coaching and mentoring IFS colleagues. 
Contributing to the continuous improvement of existing IFS products, processes and methodology. 

Must have:

Experience of working in ERP projects (leading workshops, writing specifications, configuring applications, conducting training, documentation) as a consultant, key user at an end customer, or other software supplier, with a minimum of 5+ years of experience. 
Proven ability to lead and influence teams, colleagues, customers, and partners. 
Ability to articulate and critically evaluate customer-specific business needs and solutions in a customer-facing role. 
In-depth knowledge of the processes in the Service area. 
Expertise in Service business process mapping and deployment. 
Strong problem-solving ability, analytical skills, and strategic thinking. 
Excellent interpersonal skills including stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills. 
Excellent communication and presentation skills at the executive level. 
Ability to work independently and within a team setting. 
Commercial focus, business acumen, and a “can-do” attitude. 
Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and prioritize actions in several projects at the same time. 
Fluent in Norwegian and English language, both oral and written. 
Ability to travel nationally and internationally (50%). 
Car driving license

Preferred to have:

An academic background with a university degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or equivalent. 
Solid knowledge of IFS products (Applications and Cloud), or similar ERP/EAM/FSM main player solutions
Industry-specific knowledge from target industries (Aerospace, Defence, Manufacturing, Engineering and Construction, Energy, Utilities and Resources)
Experience in Energy Utility & Resource domain as an End User, Customer, Business Consultant or a Service Provider. 
Experience from modern applications and mobile solutions. Understanding of relational databases, Interfaces, SQL and XML is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. 
Understanding of key modelling techniques (proficiency in the use of 2C8 scope modelling tool will be an asset)
Experience and ability to act in the role of Presales Consultant when required

Additional Information

We offer:

Great challenges in delivering projects to large customers together with an experienced IFS team and our partners. To work with a great product with good recognition in the market and amongst customers and analysts. To work in an international functional team as well as with our colleagues offshore, R&D and partner organizations.

What you get:

Flexible working hours and a possibility to work remotely every now and then. 
A nice range of employee benefits like car allowance, private medical care, life insurance and annual bonus. 
26 vacation days, as well as additional paid vacation days for your own birthday and voluntary work (CSR)
Comprehensive onboarding program and a Project Buddy guiding you through IFS implementation method and tools and how to become a successful IFS Consultant. 
A Social Buddy who will help you getting to know your colleagues - no one is left behind. 
A bunch of great colleagues and a fun group where everyone is helpful. 
You can expect an open corporate culture and a pleasant working atmosphere. 
Private medical care, multisport card, life insurance, Individual support through regular health promotion and the compatibility of work and private life and much more are part of our company practice

This opportunity is a full-time permanent position reporting to a Manager Functional Consultants. The office site is Asker. Please note that we do not offer B2B contracts.

Travel: readiness for frequent business trips (ca. 50%) and willingness to participate in international projects.

Please submit a brief cover letter telling us a bit about yourself and how you would fit into this position along with your CV and preliminary salary request. Interviews and selections can be made continuously so do apply as soon as possible.

As a step in our recruitment process, all final candidates will undergo a behavioral assessment (DISC), to get us an understanding of our future employees.

Verger is dedicated to providing the highest quality natural products sourced directly from local farmers who work closely and exclusively with us. Specializing in pure and natural flavor and fragrance ingredients, essential oils, extracts, whole spices, and coconuts (both organic and conventional), the company prides itself on its comprehensive expertise. Verger has built strong, meaningful relationships with communities involved in the cultivation and harvesting of raw materials. Our products, which include essential oils, spices, herbs, and coconut produce, are processed traditionally and exceed quality standards. We hold several certifications, including Halal, Kosher, UKAS Quality Management, and SGS ISO 9001, among others.

Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site role for an Intern ERP based in Horana. The Intern ERP will assist with the implementation and maintenance of the ERP system, support data entry and management, and collaborate with various departments to ensure seamless integration of processes. Daily tasks include troubleshooting system issues, generating reports, ensuring data accuracy, and providing user support and training as needed.

Qualifications
Knowledge of ERP systems and database management
Experience with data entry, data analysis, and report generation
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
Basic understanding of business processes and workflows
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field is a plus
Previous internship or work experience in ERP systems is an advantage
