description:
Rougeline®(www.rougeline.com) est un acteur français majeur de la filière fruits et légumes frais (90 000 tonnes de Fruits et Légumes & 204 M€ de CA en 2024), reconnu par :

Une politique d’innovation ambitieuse et structurée autour de sa marque « Les paysans de Rougeline® » et son engagement vers les démarches de progrès agricoles avec le label « Zéro Résidu de Pesticides », la décarbonation de nos systèmes de production
Une gamme étoffée de fruits et légumes frais : tomate, fraise, framboise, concombre, poivron, aubergine, courgette, asperge, produits sur 7 bassins du Sud de la France
Une belle équipe fédérée autour de 200 familles de producteurs et 6 organisations de producteurs, soit près de 3 000 emplois sur les territoires : de Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Occitanie, PACA et Rhône Alpes
Une organisation coopérative, solidaire basée sur une politique RSE avec des femmes et des hommes engagés au service du projet d’entreprise 2020-2025 soulignés par les Labels Egalité professionnelle et Diversité
Un positionnement affirmé sur la défense de notre souveraineté alimentaire, l’alimentation saine, le goût, le local, la proximité, l’origine du Sud de la France


Le service SI, composé de 6 personnes et de prestataires, a fait depuis plus de 5 ans le choix de la transformation digitale dans l’environnement Microsoft : Cloud Azure, M365, PowerApps, PowerBI et Copilot et pour sa sécurité Sophos : SDWAN, MDR

Vous coordonnez les différents intervenants du projet : prestataires externes, développeurs et les métiers internes (Key users) que vous animez dans le cadre du projet ERP

Vous effectuez de manière rigoureuse un reporting d'activité auprès du Directeur de projet sur le Suivi des budgets et le pilotage du planning du projet.
Sur le volet technique :
Vous êtes garant de la validation de la solution mise en place, de la réalisation des paramétrages, des recettes, des tests et de la reprise des données.
Vous vous assurerez de la rédaction des modes opératoires de l’ensemble fonctions en lien avec les utilisateurs, les partenaires internes et externes engagés sur le projet.
Enfin vous gérerez la mise en place de l'assistance et assurez le support opérationnel aux utilisateurs.
Après le démarrage,
Vous assurez l'implémentation des nouveaux modules et des mises à jour.
Plus largement, vous aurez la responsabilité du bon fonctionnement et du maintien en condition du back office de l’ERP et de ses satellites


Responsable du Delivery
Sous la responsabilité du Directeur Informatique, vous serez en charge de piloter le processus de livraison des applications et services techniques numériques, en lien avec les membres du Service SI, les utilisateurs métiers et les partenaires techniques.

Vous gérerez également des planning des projets avec le suivi des délais et de la Capacité à Faire.

De formation supérieure dans le domaine de l’informatique de gestion avec une première expérience avec un ERP.
Curiosité intellectuelle et agilité d’esprit seront appréciées.
Sensibilité pour l’innovation et l’adaptation aux changements.
Vous aimez travailler en équipe et êtes doté.e d’un bon sens relationnel.

Vos conditions
Statut Cadre au forfait 218 jours en CDI basé principalement à Marmande (Lot-et-Garonne). Parcours d’intégration. Possibilité de télétravail. Quelques déplacements à prévoir - Permis B obligatoire

Rémunération 45 K€ - 50 K€ suivant expérience - tickets restaurants et intéressement conditionnel.

Adressez votre CV et votre lettre de motivation à : l.cormy@rougeline.com

description:
Rural Electric Supply Cooperative (RESCO), is a wholesale distributor of high voltage electrical products. As a member-owned organization, we provide electric cooperatives and utilities in the Upper Midwest with competitive pricing, delivery and support for their electrical supply needs. We are a mid-size organization with under 100 employees in nine states and are looking for an ERP Analyst to join our team. This position can be located in Wisconsin, Minnesota or Iowa. The ERP Analyst will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our company’s Epicor Prophet 21 system and its related internal software. In this position you will analyze business processes, recommend improvements and implement critical changes to enhance our operational efficiency and effectiveness. Responsibilities include:
Manage and maintain our hosted Prophet 21 ERP system, ensuring its optimal performance and reliability.
Develop and deploy system enhancements and modifications within Prophet 21 using Business Rules and DynaChange.
Customize and create new Prophet 21 reports utilizing Crystal Reports.
Design and implement Prophet 21 reporting solutions and user portals for enhanced data accessibility.
Provide comprehensive technical support to end-users, expertly troubleshooting issues, and escalating problems to Epicor support when necessary.
Develop and maintain clear documentation and procedures for training purposes.
Conduct user training sessions as part of issue resolution and for new system functionalities.
Communicate and collaborate effectively with diverse teams across sales, purchasing, accounting, administration, and warehouse operations.
Leverage Epicor Data Analytics (EDA) to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement within our business processes.
Develop and manage Enterprise Content Management (ECM) processes to streamline document management and ensure compliance.

The successful candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, management information systems (MIS) or related field. In depth knowledge of Epicor Prophet 21 including DynaChange, Business Rules and Crystal Reports is required. Other qualifications include:
Proficiency with Microsoft Visual Studio 2019 (or newer) and C#.
Experience with Microsoft SQL Server 2016 (or newer), including Azure Data Studio.
Strong project management skills including the ability to manage time effectively, meet deadlines and prioritize tasks efficiently.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Highly detail oriented and accurate.
Demonstrated ability to solve problems effectively and creatively.

RESCO is a great place to work and offers a competitive benefits package with two retirement plans.

description:
Letar du efter en roll där du kan lägga till värde för våra kunders framtida verksamhet? Vill du få möjlighet att ligga i framkant med tekniken? Vill du arbeta nära och rådgiva kunder om deras ERP-system? Har du erfarenhet av ERP-system och förändringsprojekt? 

I EG leder vi utvecklingen inom teknologi. Den ena dagen blir inte den andra lik när du hela tiden får testa ny teknik. Våra innovativa partnerskap och kunder inom privat och offentlig sektor gör att du samtidigt får vara med och forma den digitala framtiden.

Vi söker både en konsult och en senior konsult.

Så jobbar vi 

Vi har höga ambitioner – och vi ska ligga i teknisk framkant. På EG brinner vi för kreativa lösningar och är alltid nyfikna på vad som blir nästa digitala genombrott. Eftersom teknik är en färskvara, är vårt arbetssätt agilt, vilket kräver att du har förmågan att blicka framåt.

Som ERP konsult med fokus på bygghandeln kommer du att arbeta med en av EGs branschlösningar, TRYGG/2000, som är ett komplett ERP system inriktat mot nordisk bygghandel. Vi går in i en expansiv fas där vi dels genom ny teknik och genom ny organisation har för avsikt vidareutveckla vår produkt och implementera den för att fortsatt vara förstahandsvalet inom bygghandeln.

Du kommer att arbeta i en kundnära roll med implementation, support, kravspecifikationer och utbildning. Vi ser gärna att du har tidigare erfarenhet av ERP system med inriktning mot retail segmentet. Resor förekommer då våra kunder finns över hela landet.

Din arbetsdag kommer att präglas av uppgifter som att...

Förstå kundens verksamhet, utmaningar, processer och arbetsflöden
Rådgöra och ge stöd åt nyckelpersoner hos kunderna
Facilitera och delta i workshops med kunder 
Konfigurera, leverera och implementera lösningar som automatiserar och effektiviserar kundens processer genom att använda verktyg som vårt system erbjuder 
Utbilda kundernas superanvändare
Implementera lösningar hos kunden 
Kontinuerligt underhåll av dokumentation 
Upprätta testfall och utföra tester (system-, integrations- och användartester) 
Samarbete med vår produktägare 

Är du den vi söker? 

Med vårt stora kundfokus behöver du vara serviceminded, ha en positiv inställning och god känsla för kvalitet. Vår höga förändringstakt kräver också att du är flexibel, självständig och att du motiveras av resultat.

För att lyckas i rollen är det viktigt att du:

Har en eftergymnasial utbildning inriktat på IT system/ERP eller tidigare har arbetat med ERP system i en konsultroll
Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult i liknande roller – som senior i minst 8 år. 
Drivs av att utvecklas och ständigt förbättras 
God engelska i både tal och skrift

Dokumenterad erfarenhet om standardprocesser i ERP system för handel är meriterande.

Vi erbjuder dig 

Vår storlek är vår styrka. Som ett av Nordens ledande IT-bolag erbjuder vi dig fler möjligheter än likvärdiga företag. Vi har stor geografisk spridning i Sverige och världen – våra kunder är små som stora, välkända som okända, lokala som globala. Vår bredd, tillsammans med höga förändringstakt, ger dig kraft att utvecklas. Vi strävar efter att vara en modern och attraktiv arbetsplats. Därför bygger vi arbetsgrupper med stor mångfald för att ta tillvara och utveckla kompetens och nytänkande.

Stationeringsort 

Malmö, Göteborg, Stockholm m.fl. företrädesvis södra Sverige eller Stockholmsregionen då vi inom EG är koncentrerade till dessa orter.

Låter det intressant? 

Välkommen med din ansökan i form av ett personligt brev och CV genom att klicka på “Skicka ansökan”. Vi behandlar ansökningarna fortlöpande och ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. För mer information om tjänsten, kontakta Fredrik Strömberg, tel 073-708 19 25 eller maila frest@eg.se. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

På EG utvecklar vi programvara åt våra kunder så att de kan fokusera på sin kärnverksamhet. Våra branschspecifika lösningar skapas av experter med djup insikt i sina respektive områden och drivs av EG:s styrka när det gäller stabilitet, innovation och säkerhet. Vi vill driva utvecklingen framåt genom att lösa stora utmaningar – från resursanvändning och effektivitet till hållbarhet.

Tillsammans skapar vi smart programvara som förenklar människors arbete – inte programvara som gör arbetet mer komplicerat.

Besök vår karriärsida för att möta några av dina framtida kollegor, lära känna vår kultur och se vår video "hur vi gör skillnad".

Läs mer om EG här.

The Wabtec ERP Applications team focuses on support of ERP systems and their boundary applications. Our team supports many ERPs and identifies solutions using a variety of interfaced applications. How will you make a difference? 

The Epicor ERP Analyst will lead processes and support modules related to Epicor Kinetic / Classic implementations at Wabtec organizations around the world

What will your typical day look like? 

Be the Subject Matter Expert/Solution Architect for Epicor / Kinetic modules, including collaboration with Application teams and integrated applications
Lead wing-to-wing IT projects for implementing solutions in Epicor
Collaborate with functional users to recognize business processes that deviate from standard processes, execute ERP module configurations and partner with business users for successful rollout, with focus on change management and site adoption.
Learn and understand business user requirements for Epicor project requests and enhancement requests.
Define as-is and to-be process maps in coordination with functional partners
Work with developers, architects and other stakeholders to define and plan solutions for any gaps identified

Mprise Agriware zoekt een proactieve Business Consultant die onze klanten helpt hun processen te optimaliseren met onze Agriware 365 ERP-software. In deze veelzijdige rol combineer je strategisch advies, klantrelatiebeheer en procesoptimalisatie – in een innovatieve, internationale omgeving.

Jouw impact
Als Business Consultant ben jij hét aanspreekpunt voor klanten na de livegang van Agriware 365. Je verdiept je in hun strategie & doelstellingen, signaleert verbeterkansen en vertaalt wensen naar concrete ERP-oplossingen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit sales en consultancy om duurzame groei te realiseren.

Jouw werkzaamheden:
Analyseren van klantprocessen en vertalen naar efficiënte ERP-oplossingen
Adviseren over langetermijnverbeteringen en innovaties
Begeleiden en coördineren van implementatietrajecten
Geven van demo’s aan nieuwe klanten tijdens pre-sales
Opstellen van duidelijke overdrachtsdocumentatie voor functionele consultants
Intensief samenwerken met interne teams voor optimale klanttevredenheid

Kortom, een veelzijdige rol binnen een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is binnen een innovatieve, hightech sector!

Wie jij bent
Je bent een ondernemende consultant die energie krijgt van klantcontact, procesverbetering en ERP-technologie. Dankzij je ervaring in de tuinbouwsector begrijp je de dynamiek, de uitdagingen én de taal van de branche. Je weet mensen op alle niveaus mee te nemen in verandering en bouwt sterke relaties op.

Verder heb je:

East African Smart Villages and Rural Mobility Limited (EASVRM) is a Kenya-based social enterprise with operations in Kisii, Nyamira, Bomet and Narok Counties. Our work focuses on implementing sustainability solutions, leveraging clean energy technologies, designing innovative digital tools, and applying forward-thinking business models to advance the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

We are seeking an ERPNext Specialist to lead the customization, integration, and deployment of ERPNext across our projects. This is a high-impact role that will design workflows, connect IoT devices, enable mobile/offline access, and ensure that farmers, drivers, and hub managers can seamlessly use the platform.

Responsibilities
Configure ERPNext modules for fleet, assets, inventory, service, HR, accounts, and manufacturing.
Build real-time IoT integrations (eTrike telemetry, battery sensors, GPS).
Enable hub operations workflows (aggregation, cold chain tracking, cash/in-kind transactions).

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience with ERPNext / Frappe Framework (including module customization, workflow automation, and database management).
Proven track record of ERP implementation in logistics, mobility, agriculture, or utility operations.
Demonstrated experience integrating IoT/telemetry data (e.g., GPS, sensors, batteries) into ERP systems.
Experience with mobile/low-bandwidth ERP deployments (offline-first or field-ready solutions).
Experience in training and user adoption with non-technical teams is highly desirable
Equivalent professional experience in ERP systems customization & deployment will also be considered.
Strong background in Python, JavaScript, APIs, and IoT data integration.
Familiarity with mobile ERP workflows and low-bandwidth environments.
Knowledge of financial integrations (esp. mobile money in Africa).
Ability to train and support non-technical users in rural/field contexts.
Nice to Have: Experience with fleet management, cold chain, or agricultural supply chains, and ERPNext deployments in Kenya/East Africa. 

Why Join Us?
At EASVRM, you’ll be shaping digital systems that:
Empower farmers with access to markets and payments.
Enable clean, smart mobility in rural communities.
Build Africa’s next-generation smart village infrastructure.
This role offers a chance to work on high-impact, cross-sector projects with the potential for long-term engagement.

Job Description

Are you ready to lead a long term ERP transformation at one of the world's most beloved brands? Join The LEGO Group and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our global operations, driving efficiency, innovation, and business excellence. If you're an experienced leader with a passion for SAP enabled strategic transformation, this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

Please note, we do not support relocation financially for this position.


Core Responsibilities

You will be part of a dedicated ERP team, delivering to one of The LEGO Group’s most important business transformations, impacting every one of the LEGO Groups awesome employees. In the role you will report to Head of Global ERP Transformation and have significant exposure to leaders across the LEGO Group.

The LEGO Group is on an exciting journey to transform and modernize its Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) capabilities, ensuring that our business operations remain agile, efficient, and future-ready. As the Senior Manager, ERP Data Migration, you will play a critical role in leading and driving one of the most critical workstreams in this transformation, ensuring it delivers measurable business impact. You will collaborate with key stakeholders across the organization to safeguard data quality and data ownership, enabling enhanced operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and scalability for future growth.

Lead a cross-functional team responsible for the Data migration deliverables including



Lead the data migration strategy and execution for various projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives 
Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to gather requirements and define data migration scope 
Ensure the use of best practices and tools for data migration, including data validation and testing protocols
Identify potential risks associated with data migration and develop mitigation strategies 
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies throughout the migration process
Coordinate a team of data migration specialists and analysts, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture 



Play your part in our team succeeding 

The global ERP Transformation Team is responsible for leading one of the top business priorities of the LEGO group in close collaboration with colleagues from the entire organization.

Members of the team are passionate about ensuring that our SAP S/4HANA platform enables our flow of good, flow of money – now and in future.

Together with functional ERP Partners, Process Execellence, Deployment leads and our Transformation Office you will engage with senior leaders across functional areas and geographies on ERP enabled strategic priorities.

Do you have what it takes?



A higher degree within finance, business or management in combination with your eye for business and well-developed interpersonal skills helps you to form strong working relationships across all levels and functions in the organization. Similarly, your excellent leadership and collaboration capabilities drive you to prioritize efficiently and get energized in a project-based, cross functional team environment. Moreover, the successful candidate comes with
5+ years of proven track record in leading teams in large scale SAP Transformations in a multinational environment
Strong IT acumen with expertise in driving complex data migration projects
Strong structuring, stakeholder management, and change management skills (incl. experience with executive-level communication).
Broader understanding of the entire SAP process and Data Model is required in a combination with deep functional understanding. An understanding of The LEGO Group is considered a benefit.
Strong communication skills, as you will engage as trusted ERP partners and advisors towards business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors. The role needs to be able to convert complex problems into tangible recommendation for decisions/general problem solving



Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Systems Analyst to join our Digital Transformation team as a Finance Functional Lead for our ERP implementation. The ideal candidate should have ERP implementation experience with Deltek Maconomy. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in a strategic, enterprise-wide transformation initiative, helping to shape and deliver the future of our ERP systems.

Who We Are

PM Group is an employee owned, international project delivery firm with a team of 3,800+ people. We are world leaders in the pharma, food, medtech and mission critical sectors. From our network of offices in Europe, Asia and the US, we work with the world's leading organisations. We are focused on growing a sustainable business centred around our people, our clients and trade partners.

Responsibilities

Will Include but not limited to

Functional Lead for Finance modules on ERP implementation, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
Work closely with Finance, Procurement, Operations teams to gather and validate business and system requirements
Develop and maintain documentation related to system configuration, processes, and procedures.
Coordinate UAT (User Acceptance Testing), prepare test scripts, and support system and process training.
Troubleshoot issues and coordinate resolution of bugs, defects, or process gaps.
Conduct system testing and quality assurance to ensure optimal performance.
Perform data analysis and reporting to support business decision-making.
Map and document end-to-end financial processes, identifying gaps or inefficiencies and recommending improvements to meet the business needs.
Support the migration from Legacy systems including mapping data structures, defining transformation rules and cleansing requirements, supporting ETL activities, validating data accuracy and completeness through reconsolidation and testing.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in ERP implementation or support roles, with hands-on experience in Deltek Maconomy
Strong knowledge of finance and accounting processes across:
O2C, P2P, R2R, EPM, and Time & Expense
Knowledge of SQL & Maconomy reporting tools (e.g., Maconomy BI, Cognos, Power BI)
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
Project management experience is a plus.
System integration and API experience (IPaaS e.g Workato) is advantageous but not essential.
Proficiency in documenting technical processes and specifications.

Why PM Group?

As an employee-owned company, we are inclusive, committed and driven. Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability are the heart of our new 2025 business strategy.

Click here to read more in our 2024 Environmental, Social and Governance Report.

Inclusion and Diversity are core to our culture and values. Wherever we work, we commit to a culture of mutual respect and belonging by building a truly inclusive workplace rich in diverse people, talents and ideas. Valuing the contributions of all our people and respecting individual differences will sustain our growth into the future.

PM Group is committed to ensuring our hiring process is fair and accessible to all and will provide candidates with disabilities with reasonable accommodations required to participate in the recruitment process. If you require any assistance in this regard, please let us know.

description:
Category/Area of Expertise: IT & Technology

Job Requisition: 431599

Address: USA-ME-Scarborough-145 Pleasant Hill Rd

Store Code: Office of CIO - Project Managment (5145438)

Ahold Delhaize USA, a division of global food retailer Ahold Delhaize, is part of the U.S. family of brands, which includes five leading omnichannel grocery brands - Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop & Shop. Our associates support the brands with a wide range of services, including Finance, Legal, Sustainability, Commercial, Digital and E-commerce, Technology and more.

The Agile RTE & Program Manager II - IT Agile PMO role will manage waterfall, Agile and hybrid programs. They have responsibility for financial management, scope management, risk management, dependency management, stakeholder management, and communication with exec leadership for their programs / ARTs. The role ensures execution of complex IT programs including full lifecycle execution, risks mitigating and communicating progress to all major stakeholders. They may lead a small team of internal and external project managers / scrum masters. This role plays a crucial role in the Agile transformation, in that they will coach leaders, team and Scrum Masters in Agile processes and mindsets. This role should be able to pivot between program manager and RTE role and is able to work in bi-modal fashion.

Our flexible/hybrid work schedule includes 3 in-person days at one of our core locations and 2 remote days. Our core office locations include Salisbury, NC; Quincy, MA; Chicago, IL; Carlisle, PA; and Scarborough, ME.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Duties & Responsibilities: 

Actively manage and deliver complex Agile and Waterfall programs of $20M or less while managing risks and issues to minimize scope, budget, and schedule impacts
Partner with finance, project teams, and value stream owners to ensure all financial cadences (e.g., quarterly budgeting cycles, month-end closings, etc...) are supported by and aligned to portfolio financials.
Ensure compliance to project delivery methods, tools, framework, and IT controls.
Develop plans for resource allocation, timeline, and budget to develop an overall project plan. 
Collaborate with delivery teams and Project Managers of other, related projects, to map and plan for dependencies
Outline and define clear deliverables, roles, and responsibilities for the team members to maintain clarity on requirements, through the creation of a project charter. 
Develop blueprints and roadmaps to lay down the possible failures and exceptions, to manage the risk and uncertainty associated with the launch of new solutions.
Synthesize and implement technological projects that are customized to meet an organization's needs. 
Report progress, risk mitigation, and any updates to the initial resource, timeline, and budget plans to relevant stakeholders. 
Deliver the project while meeting the expectations of relevant IT and business stakeholders. 
Run periodic meetings to monitor and track progress of project execution ensuring KPIs are being met and adherence to standard procedures for its delivery (examples include following SLAs, timelines, budget, sourcing/ partnerships needed, vendor selection & onboarding, etc.) is maintained. 
Create and drive project dashboards reflecting weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual status (as needed) to facilitate transparent and regular communication with stakeholders and focus on improving the operational performance of the project. 
Collaborate with other program managers and project managers in the process of balancing the interdependencies between the managed project and other projects to identify and plan for/ address these interdependencies 
Accountable for the managing of cross project related tasks needed to deliver the program 
Collaborates with the solution team to ensure adherence to release management practices on the program.
Holds solution teams accountable for the development of the deployment and hypercare plan 
Assists the project manager in receiving the Go/No-Go Signoff and CAB/ TAB approvals 
Responsible for program level governance and managing stakeholder expectations 
Accountable for risk management - mitigation and resolution of risk and issues 
Lead the waterfall programs and help with Agile transformation 
Facilitate SAFe Lean-Agile processes and execution of a train.
Facilitate ART events (i.e. PI Planning, key ceremonies) and assist team in delivering value.
Drive continuous improvement and collaboration among ARTs
Coach, guide and mentors project managers and scrum masters
Mentors, coaches the Business Owners, Product Owners, Scrum Masters and teams to foster agile mindset and guides the teams on the continuous improvement path 
Support Scrum of Scrums coordination to gain visibility into team progress and any impediments/blockers.
Assists as Product Management Teams and Agile Team in prioritization and sizing decisions
Manage dependencies with other ARTs/ Agile or waterfall teams and collaborates with other RTEs / Program Managers to resolve the dependencies 
Holds the Product Management team (Product Managers, Product Owners) accountable and helps them maintain a healthy prioritized backlog
Responsible for Financial Management, Risk Management and Dependency management for the Agile Teams
PMO Maturity, Process & Tools: 
Execute upon and contribute to process improvements and best practices across PMO to support delivery excellence 
Actively drive the transformation of waterfall projects to agile
Understands the RBS PMLC and Agile processes and ensures adherence to the processes. 
Ensure accurate usage of Clarity and Jira Tools
Configure SAFe to the organization's needs and standardize and document practices.
Keeps the Portfolio Lead informed of the teams progress, the risks, issues and dependencies and seeks helps when necessary
Ensure operational stability of a 24/7/365 grocery retail environment by providing PMO support to the planned and unplanned deployments which may require support during off-hours, weekends, and holidays.

Qualifications: 

Master's degree in computer science, Business or Technical field; equivalent trainings/certifications/experience equivalency will be considered.
7+ years practical experience at varying levels of project/program management in waterfall and 5+ years of experience on Agile Projects as RTE
Working knowledge of Waterfall and agile methodology
Working knowledge if PPM and agile tools (Jira)
Thorough understanding of enterprise software development lifecycle; ability to adjust and apply this knowledge in a dynamic environment using agile methodologies.
Bring a data-driven approach to decision making, both in day-to-day activities and when helping others make strategic trade-offs.
Self-starter with the ability to lead teams through ambiguity to solve problems and drive results.
Strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration; able to work well in a cross-functional environment.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a history of hands-on, detail orientated.
Ability to establish credibility and rapport with senior executives and technical and non-technical team members alike
Financial Acumen
Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.
Understands the meaning and implications of key financial indicators.
Uses financial analysis to generate, evaluate, and act on strategic options and opportunities.
Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications (verbal and written) that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. 
Demonstrated experience in servant leadership.
Key Skills: Agile Processes and procedures (including SAFe framework, metrics, and the implementation of Agile Release Train)

Preferred Qualifications:

MBA or advanced degree in relevant business-related field.
Agile / SAFe certification
Proficiency working in and managing agile, SAFe, scrum teams (scrum of scrums), lean teams.
Retail experience is a plus.

ME/NC/PA/SC Salary Range: $108,880 - $163,320

IL/MA/MD Salary Range: $125,200 - $187,800

At Ahold Delhaize USA, we provide services to one of the largest portfolios of grocery companies in the nation, and we're actively seeking top talent. Our team shares a common motivation to drive change, take ownership and enable our brands to better care for their customers. We thrive on supporting great local grocery brands and their strategies.

We offer an experience where our associates are valued; Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging are infused in our business and our employees are representative of the communities that we serve. We believe in total wellness, which encompasses a blend of physical, financial and emotional wellness.

We believe in collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning in all that we think, create and do. While building a culture where personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth, we invest in our people, empowering them to learn, grow and deliver at all levels of the business.

Experience with Infor CloudSuite (Infor LN experience strongly preferred). 
Strong skills in IPA, Configuration Console, File Creation Utility, and AIPS. 
Familiarity with CPQ scripting languages and web application styling. 
Proficiency in SQL Server development (T-SQL/SSIS) and reporting tools (SSRS). 
Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams. 
Effective communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
Adaptability and willingness to learn innovative technologies and platforms

description:
Our organization is in a critical phase of maturing our enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform. As we continue to scale and integrate new business areas, we require an experienced Product Owner to lead the strategy and development of our core ERP architecture and infrastructure. This role will bridge the gap between our business needs and core SAP technical teams, ensuring that our ERP system is not just a tool for today, but a scalable, secure, and high-performing foundation for future growth. Without a dedicated owner for this area, we risk technical debt, integration failures, and a system that can’t support our strategic initiatives. This position is essential to maximize the value of our significant investment in the ERP platform. The Product Owner for ERP System Architecture and Infrastructure will be a strategic leader responsible for defining the vision, roadmap, and successful delivery of all core SAP technical components. This includes the underlying infrastructure, integration frameworks, security protocols, and architectural standards. This person will have a broad SAP background as well as strong experience as an AGILE Product Owner (PO).

Strategic Planning:
Define and communicate the long-term vision and strategy for the ERP system's architecture and infrastructure, ensuring it aligns with business goals and enterprise-wide technology standards.
AGILE Process Management:
Lead team PI Planning quarterly
Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog for the ERP technical team
Writing clear user stories and epics that outline requirements for system enhancements, upgrades, and new integrations.
Stakeholder Communication:
Act as a primary liaison between business stakeholders, the ERP development team, and enterprise architecture.
Technical Oversight:
Work closely with ART and SCRUM Team technologists to make informed decisions on technology choices, system design, and security best practices.
Roadmap and Releases:
Manage and communicate the ERP infrastructure roadmap, coordinate system upgrades and releases, and ensure new features are deployed with minimal disruption.
Performance and Scalability:
Monitor and analyze system performance to proactively identify and address potential bottlenecks and capacity issues.
Risk Management:
Identify and mitigate technical risks, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues related to the ERP system and its integrations.

Why join us?


We offer employees a culture that emphasizes performance, productivity, and collaboration. You will be empowered and engaged working with like-minded individuals who are driven and passionate about contributing to a market-leading software organization with proven technology.

Job Details

Position Account Executive

Location Central US (we are creating a sales team to cover) particularly ND, SD, NE, KS, NM, MT, IA, MO. Travel likely 30-50% - - generally to trade shows but more likely in their particular region to local counties/cities/townships

Target Base Salary $80-90K, On target earnings $160K +

Where You Fit

Our client is currently seeking an Account Executive to focus on hunting for New Logo opportunities in the Small/Medium Government Agency arena. The Account Executive will be responsible for selling the subscription and perpetual license offerings. This individual will also have Existing accounts they will work with to upsell add on modules, cloud migrations, as well as maintaining their high level of satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is experienced at managing a sales territory and pipeline, actively engaging in outreach, and working with prospects to nurture their development into qualified opportunities. They understand that pipeline building and development is the foundation of success in this hunting role. They will understand how to use their Sales Engineer, Manager, and supporting executive team in a way that leverages those resources to gain momentum with their prospects.

Activities will include assisting with direct marketing and lead generation campaigns, working directly with marketing on events and trade shows, prospecting, contract negotiation, responding to RFP's, arranging customer references, and leading prospect meetings that include Discovery, Demonstration, and Solution Proposal. Extremely important is the dedication to clean, complete, and accurate recording and maintenance of Salesforce Account, Contact, Opportunity, Call/Email, Task and Event records.

This position is available for remote work but will require moderate travel.

Responsibilities

Achieve quarterly and annual booking targets
Identify and build relationships with key decision makers in prospect organizations
Reach out to prospects on a regular basis to develop relationships, understand their needs, and nurture them into active opportunities
Conduct business meetings via telephone and web conference
Develop an understanding of business issues and opportunities to deliver high-impact solutions and value propositions
Create strong customer loyalty with New Logo accounts
Use existing media and tools to create compelling sales presentations
Develop actionable business plans that provide you a roadmap to success
Lead the development of account plans and manage periodic account reviews
Manage an existing account and continue to build pipeline
Maintain CRM database (Salesforce) with accurate prospect information
Coordinate sales activities across many lines of business such as executive, support, delivery, and finance
Ability to accurately forecast opportunities for a rolling 12-month cycle, focusing on current quarter and next quarter forecasts
Facilitate discussions internally and externally relative to coordinating strategic leverage that will drive opportunities forward in the sales cycle, and to minimize potential objections
Provide proactive sales feedback on product roadmap, delivery, and support initiatives
Support Regional and National trade shows and industry events

Required Qualifications

Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
Minimum 2-4 years of New Logo sales experience selling ERP solutions (both software and services) to local government agencies or the private sector in a hunting role
Strong interpersonal communication skills and a proven track record of achieving set goals
Experience with the proper use of Salesforce
Strong prospecting skills
Time management, with the ability to focus on daily activities that that drive either pipeline growth or revenue generation
Outstanding interpersonal communication skills

Desired Qualifications

Industry domain knowledge, with preference given to candidates with ERP or Accounting software sales experience
Familiarity with government sales cycles

description:
The simple task of buying software, services, or tools at work has become hopelessly complicated at even the most innovative companies in the world. Today, enterprises spend $120T+ per year globally (>30 times larger than annual consumer e-commerce spend) and rely on vendors more than ever before to run their businesses.

Our cofounders started Zip in 2020 to address this seemingly intractable problem with a purpose-built procurement platform that provides a simple, consumer-grade user experience. Within the last 4 years, Zip has created a new category and developed the leading solution in this $50B+ TAM space. Today, the world’s leading companies like OpenAI, Snowflake, Anthropic, Coinbase, and Prudential rely on Zip to manage billions of dollars in spend.

We have a world-class team coming from category-defining companies like Airbnb, Meta, Stripe, Salesforce, Apple, and Google. With a $2.2 billion valuation and $370 million in funding from Y Combinator, Tiger Global, BOND, DST Global, and CRV, we’re focused on developing cutting-edge technology, expanding into new global markets, and—above all–driving incredible value for our customers. Join us!

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Consultant to help and/or lead onboarding for new customers and drive their implementation of our product. We’re also looking for someone who is excited to be hands-on and influence our product roadmap.

As every business needs our type of product, you’ll work with a variety of new clients and industries as Zip scales. Current clients include Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks, etc.

You Will

Supporting and/or leading onboarding for new customers, with a heavy emphasis on understanding requirements and creatively configuring the product to solve their problems
Responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation for new customers -- roll up your sleeves and build out the customer’s processes from scratch
Support and/or lead training and Q&A sessions with customers and key stakeholders to empower them to utilize the product without additional ongoing help from Zip
Proactive project management across many customers, to manage requirements and tasks across onboardings
Collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to determine which customer requests we should and shouldn’t support, and set expectations with customers
Do whatever it takes to make customers happy + successfully onboard them as quickly as possible
Continuously improve the post-sales processes to help our customers accelerate the time to value


Qualifications

2+ years’ experience working in one of the following roles: Procurement/Sourcing Manager, ERP/P2P Systems Consultant, or managing key customer and stakeholder relationships in a B2B SaaS company
Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP (Microsoft Dynamics, SAP Ariba, Sage, Oracle Fusion, Netsuite, etc.)
Fantastic communication skills
Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive
Experience working with product and engineering teams
You’re able to push back and still make people happy
Comfortable with software configuration (not necessarily technical skills, which would be a plus)
Willing to do whatever it takes to make Zip and its customers happy.


Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

📈 Start-up equity
🚠 Team building events & happy hours
🌴 Flexible PTO
💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget


We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university with major coursework in accounting, business, or a related field.

Benefits, Job Posting/Applications, Labor Relations, Licensing and Certification Tracking, Onboarding/Hiring, Performance Tracking and Evaluations, Recruitment and Staffing, Substitute Services, Workers Compensation, Job Description Administration, Compliance with State and Federal Laws, Self-Service Portal, Personnel Administration, and Professional Learning.

Summary of Position:
Midwest Hose & Specialty is seeking a highly skilled Pricing & Data Administrator with deep expertise in pricing strategy and data management. In this role, you will optimize our product pricing, ensure data accuracy across the organization, and serve as a key administrator of our Trulinx ERP system. This is a remote position, but occasional travel to Oklahoma City, OK will be required for in-person collaboration and training. The ideal candidate will work closely with our current Trulinx Administrator to learn existing processes. If you are a data-driven problem solver with a passion for pricing strategy and system optimization, we encourage you to apply!
Responsibilities:
• Pricing Strategy & Management: Develop and implement pricing strategies to maximize profitability while remaining competitive in the market. Manage and update all pricing data in the ERP system (price lists, customer-specific pricing, discounts) to ensure accuracy and consistency. Analyze pricing performance and margins, providing insights and adjustments as needed to meet business goals.
• Data Administration: Oversee and maintain critical business data within the Trulinx ERP, including product, customer, and sales data. Ensure data integrity through regular audits and clean-ups. Generate reports and dashboards to support decision-making in sales, finance, and operations, leveraging data analysis tools (Excel, BI software, etc.).
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, procurement, finance, and operations teams to align pricing strategies with organizational objectives. Provide training and support to team members on Trulinx functionalities and new features. Collaborate on projects that involve data migration, system enhancements, or process improvements related to the ERP.
Qualifications & Requirements:
• Pricing Expertise: Proven experience in pricing analysis or pricing management, with a strong understanding of pricing strategies, margin analysis, and competitive pricing in a B2B or manufacturing/distribution environment.
• Data & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools; able to interpret complex data sets and present actionable insights. Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools or SQL is a plus.
• ERP Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP systems is required (experience with Trulinx or similar distribution ERP software highly preferred). Ability to quickly learn new software and guide others in its use.
• Detail Orientation: High attention to detail and accuracy when managing data and configuring systems. Adept at establishing data governance practices to maintain data quality.
• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and conveying technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
• Self-Motivation: Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple priorities, and drive projects to completion. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and fixing issues.
Education & Experience:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field (preferred)
• 5+ years of experience in roles such as Pricing Analyst, Data Analyst, ERP Administrator, or similar, with a track record of driving results through pricing and data management (required)
• Direct experience with ERP administration or large-scale data management projects (required); experience with Trulinx ERP or in the industrial distribution sector (strongly preferred)
• Familiarity with the hose & fittings industry or industrial wholesale distribution is a plus, but not required
Important Notes:
• Location: Remote position (United States-based). Candidates must be willing to travel to our Oklahoma City, OK headquarters on a periodic basis (e.g., quarterly or as needed) for team meetings, training, and collaboration.
• All applicants must have authorization to work in the U.S. (sponsorship is not available for this position).
• This role may involve occasional extended hours or adjusting work times to coordinate with team members in different time zones when necessary.
About Us:
Midwest Hose & Specialty is one of the largest hose and fitting wholesale distributors in North America. Since opening our doors in 1983, we’ve steadily grown and built a loyal customer base – a testament to our enthusiasm for the future. At Midwest Hose & Specialty, we believe our employees are the fuel that drives our business, and we treat each person with the respect and value they deserve. We offer ample room for upward mobility, as we prefer to promote from within and reward our team members with opportunities for growth and advancement. We also provide a premier benefits package that includes:
• Competitive Compensation: We offer very competitive pay, commensurate with experience and expertise.
• Health & Wellness: Company-paid health and dental insurance plans, along with basic life and AD&D insurance coverage.
• Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with a generous company match to help you plan for the future.
• Paid Time Off: Paid holidays and 3 weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) within your first year, with increases over tenure .
• Work-Life Balance: We promote a great work/life balance and offer a casual dress environment when you visit the office.
• Professional Growth: Career longevity and professional development are important to us – you’ll have opportunities for training and advancement as part of our team.
• Parental Leave: We support our employees with paid parental leave and strive to create a family-friendly, inclusive environment.
Additional Information:
As part of our commitment to a safe and productive workplace, all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and drug screen . If you want to be part of a growing company and believe that Midwest Hose & Specialty is the place for you to build your career, we encourage you to apply today!

Job Summary

This role will serve as a key liaison between procurement stakeholders and the ERP implementation team, leading efforts to modernize purchasing processes, improve data analytics, and align with best practices. This role supports transformation across procurement, HR, and finance throughout the ERP implementation lifecycle. Responsibilities include automating workflows, enhancing data management, and driving change management. The position collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve processes in HR, accounting, budgeting, payroll, procurement, and other ERP functions. The ideal candidate has strong communication and project management skills, with experience in large project implementations, organizational change, and user adoption.

Requirements

Five (5) years of ERP Systems experience is REQUIRED.
Any combination of education and experience of the following that provides the necessary knowledge and skills:
Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university with major coursework in accounting, business, or a related field.
Five (5) years of professional experience in accounting, procurement and contracting, grants fiscal management, or related fields.
POSITION EXPECTATIONS

Analyzing spend data to identify cost savings and efficiencies.
Evaluating suppliers and supporting contract negotiations.
Developing and tracking procurement strategies.
Ensuring compliance with procurement policies and regulations.
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to align purchasing with organizational goals.
Providing insights and recommendations through data analysis and reporting.
Understanding of local and state procurement laws, policies, and procedures.
Proficiency in computerized business systems and personal computing.
Familiarity with accounting systems, financial reporting, auditing, asset and grant management, and cash/investment handling.
Ability to develop, compare, and analyze bids and specifications.
Skilled in negotiating and preparing annual contracts for goods and services.
Capable of evaluating supply requests and preparing technical bids.
Ability to oversee procurement compliance for school district programs and projects.
Demonstrated proficiency with one or more ERP systems.
Effective communication, collaborative, and interpersonal skills.
Effective skills in planning and organizing corresponding activities.
Familiar with the latest technology as it relates to the purchase of equipment and programs.
Ability to communicate clearly both orally and in writing.
Ability to plan, organize, and set priorities.
Ability to gain cooperation from various entities.
Ability to establish and maintain an effective working relationship with Clark County School District administrators, licensed and support professional employees, and outside agency representatives.
Ability to work well under pressure to meet mandates.
Ability to work independently with a high level of attention to detail.
Change management, including the ability to lead small groups and collaborate with all levels of impacted offices, including clerical, paraprofessional, professional, and management positions; collaborative approaches that involves listening, communicating, and negotiating; continuous efforts to resolve unyielding problems; and implementing change management strategies to ease the transition for end-users.
Other necessary skills include project management; performing mathematical calculations; using personal and enterprise resource planning computer applications (including spreadsheets, word processing, computerized payroll and general ledger), analyzing financial data; identifying and correcting inaccuracies; communicating in writing and verbally with a wide range of technical and non-technical people; interacting effectively with a wide variety of professional personnel and working independently with minimum supervision; meeting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Effective leadership, oversight, and interpersonal communication abilities.
Analytical thinking, decision-making, and project coordination capabilities.
Capacity to stay current with technology and apply new skills on the job, including learning and adjusting to new system tools and procedures implemented by the district or department.
Skill in interpreting data and making independent decisions.
Capability to rapidly acquire in-depth understanding of the District's labor agreements and manuals, especially those related to compensation compliance.
Capacity to support and comply with Board of Education rules, District regulations, and site or department protocols.
Competence in maintaining current knowledge of district regulations, expectations, and training in data integrity, privacy, and cybersecurity concerning student and employee data and related systems.
Skill in engaging, collaborating, and working well with individuals from various cultural and educational backgrounds, with a commitment to contributing to cultural diversity for educational value.
Awareness of workplace safety significance, adherence to safety procedures, practice of safe behaviors, correct use of safety gear, and reporting of hazardous conditions to the proper authority.

Project Activities to include any or a multitude of the following across the System Implementation Lifecycle:

System Design
Participation in business process analysis discovery, including input on final design of workflows to promote system automation and improved efficiency, including the use of artificial intelligence (AI) when appropriate.
Ensuring the security of sensitive personal data and compliance with data protection regulations.
Mitigating risks related to personal data gathered during the application process and the life cycle of employment.

System Configuration
Participation in iterative system configuration pilot sessions to showcase functionality during build-out.

System Testing
System Integration Testing; system testing as a technical resource working through system integrations, including external interfaces and automated workflows.
User Acceptance Testing - system testing as an end user during the final stages of testing prior to Go-Live to simulate a real-world production environment.

End User Training
Participation in the design of the Training Plan (curriculum, resources, materials, etc.) to represent the interests of the end user community based upon Human Resources' subject matter expertise.

System Go-Live
Participation is System GoLive event coordination including Helpdesk Support for ticket management.

Contribute to system enhancements, version upgrades, and ongoing process improvements.
Work collaboratively with the District's staff, ERP consultants, and vendors to resolve issues and refine business operations.

ERP Business Systems Analyst - Payroll and Benefits
Las Vegas, NV
Contract
Link Technologies (LinkTechConsulting.com), a Las Vegas-based IT consulting firm, is currently seeking an ERP Business Systems Analyst-Payroll and Benefits to join our team.

Job Summary

This role will be a key liaison between payroll and benefits stakeholders and the ERP implementation team, leading efforts to modernize and streamline processes, improve data analytics, and align with best practices. This role supports process transformation across payroll, benefits, HR, and finance throughout the ERP implementation lifecycle. Responsibilities include driving automation, enhancing data management, and leading change management. The position will work with cross-functional teams to improve processes in areas such as HR, accounting, budgeting, payroll, and procurement. The ideal candidate will have strong communication and project management skills, with experience in large project implementations, organizational change, and user adoption.

Requirements

Five (5) years of ERP Systems experience is REQUIRED.
Any combination of education and experience of the following that provides the necessary knowledge and skills:
Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university with major coursework in accounting, business, or a related field.
Five (5) years of professional experience in absence management, benefits, time and labor, payroll, position control, budgeting, or a related area.
POSITION EXPECTATIONS

This position requires subject matter expertise in the following functional areas across the Payroll and Benefits:

Payroll, Absence Management, Time & Labor, Workers Compensation, Compliance with State and Federal Laws, Self-Service Portal.
Demonstrated proficiency with one or more ERP systems.
Effective communication, collaborative, and interpersonal skills.
Effective skills in planning and organizing corresponding activities.
Familiar with the latest technology as it relates to the purchase of equipment and programs.
Ability to communicate clearly both orally and in writing.
Ability to plan, organize, and set priorities.
Ability to gain cooperation from various entities.
Ability to establish and maintain an effective working relationship with administrators, licensed, and support professional employees, and outside agency representatives.
Ability to work well under pressure to meet mandates.
Ability to work independently with a high level of attention to detail.
Payroll, payroll tax, Internal Revenue Service payroll tax code, governmental accounting practices, computerized business systems, and personal computers.
Payroll accounting information systems; methods and procedures of time reporting; auditing and financial accounting.
Budget management and controls, position control, position budgeting, and fiscal forecasting.
Local government and/or state workers' compensation and compliance with state and federal laws.
Change management, including the ability to lead small groups and collaborate with all levels of impacted offices, including clerical, paraprofessional, professional, and management positions; collaborative approaches that involves listening, communicating, and negotiating; continuous efforts to resolve unyielding problems; and implementing change management strategies to ease the transition for end-users.
Other necessary skills include project management; performing mathematical calculations; using personal and enterprise resource planning computer applications (including spreadsheets, word processing, computerized payroll and general ledger), analyzing financial data; identifying and correcting inaccuracies; communicating in writing and verbally with a wide range of technical and non-technical people; interacting effectively with a wide variety of professional personnel and working independently with minimum supervision; meeting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Effective leadership, oversight, and interpersonal communication abilities.
Analytical thinking, decision-making, and project coordination capabilities.
Capacity to stay current with technology and apply new skills on the job, including learning and adjusting to new system tools and procedures implemented by the district or department.
Skill in interpreting data and making independent decisions.
Capability to rapidly acquire in-depth understanding of the District's labor agreements and manuals, especially those related to compensation compliance.
Capacity to support and comply with Board of Education rules, District regulations, and site or department protocols.
Competence in maintaining current knowledge of district regulations, expectations, and training in data integrity, privacy, and cybersecurity concerning student and employee data and related systems.
Skill in engaging, collaborating, and working well with individuals from various cultural and educational backgrounds, with a commitment to contributing to cultural diversity for educational value.
Awareness of workplace safety significance, adherence to safety procedures, practice of safe behaviors, correct use of safety gear, and reporting of hazardous conditions to the proper authority.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Activities to include any or a multitude of the following across the System Implementation Lifecycle:

System Design
Participation in business process analysis discovery, including input on final design of workflows to promote system automation and improved efficiency, including the use of artificial intelligence (AI) when appropriate.
Ensuring the security of sensitive personal data and compliance with data protection regulations.
Mitigating risks related to personal data gathered during the application process and the life cycle of employment.

System Configuration
Participation in iterative system configuration pilot sessions to showcase functionality during build-out.

System Testing
System Integration Testing; system testing as a technical resource working through system integrations, including external interfaces and automated workflows.
User Acceptance Testing - system testing as an end user during the final stages of testing prior to Go-Live to simulate a real-world production environment.

End User Training
Participation in the design of the Training Plan (curriculum, resources, materials, etc.) to represent the interests of the end user community based upon Human Resources' subject matter expertise.

System Go-Live
Participation is System GoLive event coordination including Helpdesk Support for ticket management.
The Project Team will establish mechanisms for ongoing system enhancements and staying abreast of updates and new features within ERP payroll and benefit modules and will work with the District's management and staff, ERP consultant, and ERP vendor to identify changes to daily processes, troubleshooting, and making continuous efforts to resolve issues.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors protected by law.

description:
Resumen del Puesto
Es un rol importante por proyecto dentro del Departamento de Tecnología e Innovación de la Fundación Sur Futuro. Sus funciones se dividen en dos momentos: durante la implementación del software "Net Suite - Oracle" y post-implementación. En la primera etapa, este profesional asegurará la integridad y calidad de la información, siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos, lo cual es vital para el éxito de la operación futura del nuevo sistema. En una segunda etapa, evoluciona hacia un rol más general de integridad de información y soporte al usuario.

Responsabilidades Clave

Durante la implementación del ERP:
Carga y Depuración de Datos:
Introducir datos de manera precisa, rápida y eficiente en los formatos facilitados para cargar al sistema "Net Suite - Oracle" y otras plataformas según sea necesario.
Apoyar la migración de información y carga masiva de datos al nuevo sistema NetSuite, asegurando la integridad de la información, consistencia y el formato correcto.
Apoyar en el levantamiento y depuración de datos a ser introducidos desde las diferentes áreas, incluyendo la exportación desde los sistemas actuales.
Ejecutar pruebas de integridad post-migración y resolver anomalías en coordinación con los equipos técnicos y funcionales.
Realizar tareas de limpieza y depuración de datos, con las áreas relevantes, para eliminar duplicados o información obsoleta.
Documentar cada paso del proceso para referencia futura y auditoría.
2. Soporte General al Proyecto
Participar en configuraciones básicas de NetSuite relacionadas con la estructura de datos y los reportes, visualizaciones y otros accesos a información.
Ser enlace activo entre usuarios clave y personal técnico externo durante pruebas, capacitaciones y ajustes del sistema.
Apoyar a los líderes internos en otras tareas relevantes a la implementación.

Después de la implementación (Rol permanente en el Departamento de Tecnología):
1. Gestión y Mantenimiento de Datos:
Gestionar y mantener la integridad de las bases de datos utilizadas por la organización, tanto en NetSuite como en otras herramientas tecnológicas institucionales.
Mantener y actualizar bases de datos existentes, asegurando la integridad y la calidad de la información.
Organizar y archivar documentos digitales relacionados con los datos introducidos.

2. Soporte Técnico y Funcional a Usuarios
Supervisar y aplicar políticas de acceso, seguridad y actualización en los distintos sistemas implementados.
Asegurar el funcionamiento fluido de los sistemas tecnológicos mediante monitoreo continuo, solución de incidencias y mejoras operativas.
Proveer soporte de primer nivel a usuarios internos en el uso de NetSuite y otras plataformas digitales utilizadas por la institución.
Coordinar sesiones de capacitación y talleres para fomentar el uso efectivo de los sistemas disponibles.
Documentar procesos, soluciones comunes y buenas prácticas tecnológicas para facilitar el aprendizaje y la autonomía de los equipos.

3. Apoyo en Análisis de Datos y Generación de Información
Apoyar en la creación de reportes e indicadores que apoyen la toma de decisiones en distintas áreas, combinando información del ERP con otras fuentes.
Configurar dashboards personalizados y visualizaciones útiles para los distintos equipos.
Identificar patrones, alertas o áreas de mejora basados en el análisis de datos institucionales.

Competencias y Habilidades Requeridas
Ingeniero en Informática o Sistemas de Información. Se podrán considerar técnicos con experiencia y estudiantes de término de informática.
Experiencia demostrable de 1 año (deseable) en roles de entrada de datos o gestión de información.
Experiencia previa en manejo de sistemas ERP es altamente valorada.
Alta precisión y atención al detalle.
Habilidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información de manera eficiente.
Dominio de herramientas de Office, especialmente Microsoft Excel (intermedio) para manipulación y validación de datos.
Familiaridad con bases de datos y sistemas de gestión de información.
Disponibilidad para trabajar 100% presencial en oficina principal en Santo Domingo y para trasladarse a otras instalaciones de la institución.

Cualidades Deseadas
Organización y planificación.
Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de objetivos.
Proactividad en la identificación y resolución de problemas de datos.
Capacidad de adaptación a nuevos sistemas y procesos.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo, bajo presión y con plazos definidos.
Ética profesional y discreción en el manejo de información confidencial.
Compromiso con la misión y valores de Fundación Sur Futuro.

Solid understanding of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) concepts and project lifecycles.
Exceptional ability to create high-quality, professional project deliverables (project plans, status reports, executive presentations).
Experience managing vendors, subcontractors, or third-party delivery teams.
Based in the New York / New Jersey / Pennsylvania tristate area, with the ability to work in a hybrid model and be on-site in Central New Jersey as required.

A Strategic Leader: You can guide senior stakeholders, manage complex dependencies, and drive project success with confidence and minimal supervision.

description:
Overview 

ERP System Implementation Deputy Project Manager (HRM and/or FIN)

Overview 

Our State Government Practice Group (SGPG) is seeking an experienced Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system implementation project manager to assist our Project Manager across the Human Resource Management (HRM) and/or Financial (FIN) workstreams on behalf of our state government client in the State of Nevada. You should have experience managing teams and efforts to implement large-scale ERP solutions (e.g., CGI, Oracle, Workday, and/or SAP) and be willing to work in the Pacific time zone.

General travel expectation: 50% travel to the client site in Nevada is required (and for future projects, once this project ends).

You will apply your knowledge and experience to support our state government client in implementing its chosen ERP system (CGI Advantage 4) through helping to both support and direct the HRM and/or FIN workstream teams (depending on your skillsets/experience) comprised of state agency staff, working in collaboration with state HRM and/or FIN leads and our BerryDunn HRM and/or FIN Project Manager. This will require providing advice and guidance to our state government client and working in collaboration with the ERP system integrator (SI) vendor (CGI) and our BerryDunn-assigned team. You will bring a mix of expert-level project management capabilities, exceptional organizational and self-management qualities, strong leadership and teamwork capabilities, and effective written and verbal communication skills.

You Will 

Responsibilities 

As an ERP System Implementation Deputy Project Manager, you will:

Support the delivery of services to our current and future state government client(s) on time, within scope, and within budget, including assigning and managing the state government and BerryDunn HRM and/or FIN workstream project teams and creating project work products. 
Serve as deputy project manager to our current state government client, and as deputy project manager or project manager for future state government clients across the country — supporting client work and deepening our team’s experience and knowledge. 
Develop project deliverables for our current and future state government client(s). 
Communicate project and delivery status to our clients, team members, and other interested/involved parties—including the facilitation of client meetings. 

As an SGPG team member, you will:

In partnership with our internal team, respond to state government opportunities related to ERP systems and other enterprise-wide systems. 
Develop appropriate relationships with ERP/enterprise system Solution Integrators (SI)/Providers in the state government market. 
Collaborate with other groups within our firm that can bring ERP/enterprise system knowledge. 
Participate in marketing and business development activities, including writing blog posts and leading and participating in prospective client business development meetings. 

You Have 

Qualifications 

You have:

Three or more years’ experience managing large teams and overall efforts to implement large-scale ERP systems (state government experience a plus) in either the HRM or FIN functional area (or both). 
Demonstrated experience working with ERP systems/products (experience with CGI Advantage a plus). 
Knowledge of quality assurance/control procedures and demonstrated proactive problem management skills. 
Experience facilitating meetings and public speaking with large groups. 
Proficiency in all Microsoft (MS) applications. 
Ability to balance multiple assignments and achieve quality results in a timely manner.

En central rolle i en spændende Business Unit med fokus på Business Central, Fashion, Produktion, Retail og den offentlige sektor

description:
Acerca del empleo 

Profesional especializado en proyectos de implementación, configuración, instalación, y personalización de sistemas contables y de planificación de recursos empresariales (ERP) en diversos tipos de empresas. 
Su función principal es asegurarse de que la implementación del software contable y ERP se realice de manera efectiva y satisfactoria para cubrir las necesidades específicas de cada organización. Esto incluye: levantamiento de procesos operativos y contables de la empresa, configuración de módulos especializados, integración con otros sistemas, migración de datos, capacitación del personal técnico, y soporte post-implementación. 
El consultor de implementación de software ERP también colabora estrechamente con los equipos internos multidisciplinarios de la empresa para garantizar que el proyecto se desarrolle según lo planeado y que se cumplan los objetivos establecidos. Es crucial que el consultor tenga un profundo conocimiento del software ERP y del software contable, así como habilidades técnicas de levantamiento y entendimiento de procesos y de comunicación efectiva para llevar a cabo la implementación de manera exitosa. 
Requisitos deseables: 

1. Conocimiento técnico: 
Entendimiento y manejo profesional de software contable (QuickBook, CashFlow, Alegra, Dynamics etc…). 
Entendimiento y manejo profesional de software ERP (SAP, Odoo, Oracle Netsuite etc..). 
Buen entendimiento de software CRM (Salesforce, Monday, ClickUp, Zoho CRM, Hubspot etc…). 
2. Conocimiento del negocio: Debe comprender los procesos y operaciones de las empresas para poder adaptar el software ERP a las necesidades específicas de cada cliente. 

3. Contabilidad y finanzas: Debe tener conocimiento comprensivo y profundo del Ciclo Contable de las empresas dominicanas. 

4. Experiencia en implementación de software: Debe tener experiencia previa liderando o participando directamente en la implementación de software contable, ERP o sistemas empresariales similares. 

5. Habilidades de comunicación: Debe ser capaz de comunicarse eficazmente con los clientes para comprender sus requerimientos y explicarles cómo funciona el software ERP. 

6. Capacidad de capacitación: Debe poder capacitar a los usuarios técnicos y finales del software para que puedan utilizarlo de manera efectiva en su trabajo diario. 

7. Bases de datos: Preferible conocimiento de herramientas como SQL o Power BI 
Requisitos: 
Licenciatura en Contabilidad o carreras afines. 
Dos (2) años de experiencia manejando o implementando software contable y software ERP. 
Dos (2) años de experiencia en el ciclo contable de empresas. 
Dos (2) años de experiencia en mejora o administración de procesos contables.

We are seeking a proactive and versatile IT Systems Administrator to manage and maintain our company's IT infrastructure and provide hands-on technical support.
