Solid knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.

Experience with Google Workspace administration, including user and group management.

Proven experience in a generalist IT role, preferably in a small to medium-sized enterprise. 

Proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in the Odoo ERP system (Odoo 16/18 knowledge is a strong plus). 

You communicate fluently in English and are able understand complex topics in German.

A valid Swiss work permit.


Additionally, any of the following are considered nice to have:


Familiarity with cloud systems, servers, and backup solutions.

Knowledge of system security practices and data protection.

Familiarity with version control and deployment practices (basic DevOps tasks).

Competitive salary.

Opportunities to work in a collaborative and innovative work environment.

A young team, flat hierarchies and direct communication.

Motorway connection (300m), train station (300m).

Location: Remote - Ireland or Northern Ireland (occasional client travel)

We're working with a leading software company who are seeking a Senior ERP Finance Consultant to join their Professional Services team.
This role is all about delivering end-to-end ERP finance implementations for a newly launched, cloud-first ERP platform. You'll partner directly with Finance Directors and business owners, guiding them through complex implementations, ensuring best practice, and configuring systems to meet real-world financial needs.
This is a remote-first role for someone based in Ireland or Northern Ireland, with travel to client sites across Dublin, Cork, and Northern Ireland when required.

Lead full-cycle ERP finance implementations, from scoping through to go-live.
Configure, modify, and integrate ERP finance modules (GL, AR/AP, reporting, data migration).
Build strong relationships with Finance Directors and senior stakeholders, becoming a trusted advisor.
Deliver multiple projects simultaneously (typically 6-12 months, €250k-€500k in value).
Drive best practice in implementation and data migration (ETL), ensuring smooth client onboarding.
Provide expert input on finance processes and influence customer decision-making.

We're looking for candidates who are proven specialists in ERP finance implementation - not just finance professionals who have "been through" an implementation.

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation. 

Building Strong Data

Led by the Director, ERP- ETL and Data Governance this opportunity will best suit someone who enjoys collaborating and can design, document and implement data governance policies. 

Ready to make an impact? Here’s how: 
Design, implement, and maintain data governance policies, standards, and procedures.
Monitor and enforce data quality standards (accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness) across D365 ERP datasets. Develop and manage data cleansing and validation processes.
Oversee the creation, maintenance, and governance of master data (e.g., customer, vendor, product, and financial data) to ensure consistency and reliability within D365.
Ensure data governance practices comply with Canadian regulations and industry standards; collaborate with IT to implement data access controls and protect sensitive information.
Work with key stakeholders and technical teams to define data requirements, map data flows, and resolve data-related issues during the D365 implementation.
Provide training to end-users and stakeholders on data governance best practices and D365 data usage.
Support data migration, integration, and transformation activities during the D365 implementation, ensuring minimal disruption and adherence to governance standards.
Create and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for data quality and governance. 
Provide regular reports to leadership on data governance progress and risks.

We’re looking for: 
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or Data Management with 3-5 years of experience. 
Expertise in designing and implementing data governance policies for D365 F&O and SCM, ensuring compliance with Canadian privacy laws (e.g., PIPEDA).
Proficiency in managing data quality, defining KPIs, and authoring governance reports.
In-depth knowledge of D365 F&O and SCM data structures, workflows, configurations, and master data management (MDM).
Experience with data governance tools (e.g., Microsoft Purview) for policy enforcement and metadata management.
Familiarity with data modeling, mapping, and ETL processes to support D365 migration and integration.
Strong analytical and communication skills to identify data issues, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and deliver training on governance best practices.
Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power Query, SQL, Power BI) and exposure to Azure DevOps.
Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced ERP environment, using Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid methodologies.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.

Competitive earnings opportunity.

Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discounts from our corporate retail stores.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Bring your unique skills, thrive with interesting and challenging work, and experience what it’s like at Home. 

Apply today - this is a great opportunity to join a proudly Canadian company that is 100% ready to help you build your future.

description:
Description générale du rôle
Le Développeur(euse) PGI (C#) développe, modifie et maintient de manière indépendante des programmes complexes qui produisent plusieurs produits interdépendants mais différents, par exemple les achats, les ventes, les finances, la production, etc.
Le Développeur(euse) PGI (C#) effectue des analyses de programmation, par exemple en étudiant la faisabilité du développement de programmes alternatifs, en aidant les utilisateurs à définir leurs besoins ou en participant à une proposition de modification technique (ECP) et à une équipe d'utilisateurs travaillant sur des programmes volumineux et complexes.

Principales responsabilités
Confirme les exigences du projet en examinant les objectifs du programme, les données d'entrée et les exigences de sortie avec l'analyste, le superviseur et le client.
Encode les exigences du projet en convertissant les informations sur le flux de travail en langage informatique.
Confirme le fonctionnement du programme en effectuant des tests et en modifiant la séquence et/ou les codes du programme.
Rédige des instructions d'utilisation pour les utilisateurs. Présente un plan clair du processus, estime le nombre d'heures nécessaires pour le projet et fixe la date de son achèvement.
Archive les données historiques en documentant le développement du programme et les révisions apportées.
Analyse les applications logicielles existantes pour les efforts d'intégration. Dirige la résolution des problèmes d'intégration des systèmes et des applications. Agit en tant qu'expert en intégration technique et plans de mise en œuvre.
Définit les échéanciers de développement des produits.
Fournit une formation aux utilisateurs au besoin.
Identifie tôt les défauts en effectuant des inspections de code, réduisant ainsi le nombre de défauts.
Participe aux revues de conception, améliorant ainsi la qualité du code.

Éducation
DEC ou BAC en informatique, mathématiques ou systèmes d'information, ainsi que des connaissances en langages de programmation.

Expérience
3 ans ou plus d'expérience en programmation (y compris une expérience PGI), de préférence dans un environnement de fabrication.

Logiciels
C# ; Visual Studio ; SSRS ; SQL Server ; Microsoft Office ; Crystal Report, PGI.
Epicor et HTML sont un atout.

Compétences
Capacité à prêter une attention particulière aux détails et à être précis et exact.
Capacité à communiquer clairement et de manière concise des idées de conception et des solutions à l'oral et par écrit.
Capacité à comprendre rapidement les concepts techniques.
Français et anglais*
*La maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour communiquer, soutenir et fournir des services aux individus, employés ou partenaires qui ne parlent pas français, en particulier lorsqu'ils se trouvent à l'extérieur de la province de Québec.

EN

General Description of the Role
The role of the ERP (C#) Programmer independently develops, modifies, and maintain complex programs that produce several interrelated but different products e.g., Procurement, Sales, Financials, Production Etc. 
The ERP (C#) Programmer performs programming analysis such as investigating the feasibility of developing alternate programs, assisting users in defining needs, or participating in an engineering change proposal (ECP) and user team working on large and complicated programs.

Key Responsibilities

Confirms project requirements by reviewing program objectives, input data, and output requirements with analyst, supervisor, and client. 
Encodes project requirements by converting workflow information into computer language. 
Confirms program operation by conducting tests, and modifying program sequence and/or codes. 
Prepares reference for users by writing operating instructions. Presents a clear plan of how the process will proceed and estimates the number of hours the project will take and when it should be completed.
Maintains historical records by documenting program development and revisions. 
Analyzes existing software applications for integration efforts. Leads the resolution of systems and applications integration issues. Acts as subject matter expert for technical integration and implementation plans
Defines product development timelines
Provides user training as needed.
identifies defects early by conducting code inspections – reduces the number of defects
Participates in design reviews – improves quality of code

Education
DEC or BAC degree in computer science, mathematics, or information systems, as well as knowledge of programming languages

Experience
3+ years of programming (including ERP experience) preferably in a manufacturing environment

Software
C#; Visual Studio; SSRS; SQL Server; Microsoft Office; Crystal Report, ERP. 
Epicor and HTML an asset. 

Skills
Ability to pay close attention to detail and be precise and accurate.
Ability to communicate design ideas and solutions clearly and concisely orally and in writing.
Aptitude for mathematics. 
Quickly grasp technical concepts
French and English*
* English is essential to communicate, support and provide services to individuals, employees or partners who do not speak French, particularly when they are outside the province of Quebec.

description:
Organizational Context

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian organization, with a network of 191-member National Societies. The overall aim of the IFRC is “to inspire, encourage, facilitate, and promote at all times all forms of humanitarian activities by National Societies with a view to preventing and alleviating human suffering and thereby contributing to the maintenance and promotion of human dignity and peace in the world.” The IFRC works to meet the needs and improve the lives of vulnerable people before, during and after disasters, health emergencies and other crises.

IFRC is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement (Movement), together with its member National Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The work of the IFRC is guided by the following fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality.

IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. The Headquarters are organized into three main Divisions: (i) National Society Development and Operations Coordination; (ii) Global Relations, Humanitarian Diplomacy and Digitalization; and (iii) Management Policy, Strategy and Corporate Services.

IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegation and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat.

Background to the position

In virtually all countries, people increasingly rely on and expect a diverse range of digital services (e.g., through their mobile devices) to interact with local government, companies, and community organizations and services. This disruption is already happening to humanitarian assistance. Yet, the Digital Divide remains a persistent and significant challenge at both national and local levels.

The need for a successful and large-scale digital transformation is urgent. And Digitally Transforming the IFRC and its 192 members is a complex process which requires collaborative action and support across the membership.

Therefore, the IFRC recently developed a Digital Transformation Strategy which was approved by the IFRC Governing Board in May 2021.

The Digital Transformation Department (DTD) has full leadership responsibility for the implementation of the digital transformation strategy and the positive impact it will have on the 192 National Society members of the IFRC. The DTD provides strategic leadership and guides the IFRC Secretariat as well as the members network to adapt and innovate humanitarian services, drawing on digital services, data-enabled decision-making, and other opportunities for digital transformation in support of the IFRC’s Strategy 2030. In addition, the DTD is responsible for the development and implementation of business transformation, information technology and digitalization services throughout the IFRC Secretariat, thereby supporting the same transformation in 192 national societies, setting the vision, and drawing stakeholders together on this digital journey.

Job Purpose

The position holder is a specialist in Information Systems used by Enterprise Resource Planning solutions of the D365 suite of products and other specific systems used by all IFRC employees.

Deliver a high quality of business application support services.
Guarantee data information security, availability and integrity through strong operational competencies

description:
Job Title: Oracle ERP Administrator

Job Summary:
The Oracle ERP Administrator will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting Oracle ERP applications and databases. This role involves installation, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, patch management, and performance optimization to ensure smooth and secure operation of Oracle ERP systems. The administrator will also collaborate with development teams and provide 24/7 support when required.

Key Responsibilities:
Install, configure, and upgrade Oracle server software and related products.
Start, stop, and monitor application-related components (oacore, oafm, apache, etc.).
Perform application restarts (bouncing apache, oacore, oafm) when required.
Establish and maintain database backup and recovery policies and procedures.
Design and implement database structures to support ERP applications.
Implement and maintain database security, including user creation, roles, and privilege management.
Provide technical troubleshooting and consultation to development teams.
Interface with Oracle Support for technical issues and resolutions.
Manage patching, upgrades, and version control of ERP environments.
Perform database and application tuning for optimal performance.
Clone development and test environments from production databases.
Provide 24x7 support as part of the ERP support team.
Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 4+ years of experience in Oracle ERP administration.
Strong knowledge of Oracle ERP architecture, database design, and performance tuning.
Hands-on experience in patch management, backup/recovery, and cloning.
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in English (reading and writing).

You are a self-motivated team player with the ability to easily network in an international and cross-cultural environment, working in line with Alfa Laval drivers; Action, Interaction, and Satisfaction. You are driven and see solutions rather than problems, effectively prioritizing and executing tasks. A focus on continuous improvement is in your DNA. If the above sounds like you, this position might be just what you’re looking for!

About The Job

The ERP Application Analyst is responsible for the operational excellence and optimization of our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system in the Southeast Asia region. This role goes beyond traditional support by actively contributing to business value through process automation and data analysis.

Job Description

Application Management & Support: Serve as the regional subject matter expert for the ERP system, providing advanced technical and functional support to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.
Business Process Insight: Develop a foundational understanding of core business processes, especially in finance and supply chain, to effectively address user needs and provide actionable solutions within the ERP environment.
Automation & Process Improvement: Actively identify opportunities to reduce manual work and automate repetitive tasks. This includes understanding business requirements and using tools to create automation workflows for reporting and data management.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Create and maintain reports to provide business stakeholders with actionable insights. This includes proficiency in using advanced Excel functions (e.g., formulas, PivotTables) and VBA scripting to analyze and manipulate ERP data.
Low-Code Solution Development: Utilize knowledge of low-code platforms such as Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) to design and implement application-based solutions that streamline manual workflows and enhance business efficiency.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate effectively with regional stakeholders to gather requirements, communicate system changes, and manage expectations. Build strong relationships to ensure IT solutions are aligned with business objectives.
Guidance and Skill Development: Work under the guidance of a senior analyst to expand expertise in ERP functionality, project management, and strategic business analysis.

What You Know

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Minimum of 3 - 5 years’ working experience within application support or IT operations role.
Prior hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g., SAP, Oracle, iScala, Microsoft Dynamics) is highly desirable.
A basic understanding of core business functions such as Finance, Supply Chain, or Operations is a plus.
Proven ability to work with an ERP system while understanding its impact on business workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas and VBA for data analysis.
Knowledge or demonstrated familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) is a significant advantage.
Ability to leverage AI-powered tools and solutions to add business value and enhance processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations effectively.
A proactive, growth-oriented mindset with a strong desire to learn and contribute to business transformation.

What’s In It For You

We offer a challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we help each other to develop and create value. Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval’s future success.

We care about diversity, inclusion and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

We are looking for experienced Oracle ERP Finance and/or Supply Chain lead consultants to help sell and deliver Oracle transformation programmes at some of our key clients across UKI and Western Europe, with proven experience and capability in some of these areas:

Taking a key delivery role of Oracle ERP (Finance and/or Supply Chain) solutions, in a functional and/or workstream management capacity, on large-scale transformation programmes
Operating across different phases of the consulting lifecycle - working with stakeholders in the client organisation across requirements analysis, functional design, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), and fit-gap recommendations, through to deployment and business readiness support
Shaping and selling Oracle ERP (Finance and/or Supply Chain) solutions by engaging with senior stakeholders to help solve their business challenges in the relevant market segment
Actively engaging in the definition and creation of Oracle ERP (Finance and/or Supply Chain) solutions. You will play an important in shaping and identifying new and expansion business opportunities on these programmes
Managing and supporting proactive Oracle proposal development, focusing on the Infosys Consulting value proposition, key differentiators, and win themes
Assuming the role of trusted advisor to clients providing guidance in matters relating to Oracle Applications within relevant industries
Coordinating relationship building activities across teams on each client engagement to help ensure they are well advised on important matters
Collaborating with Oracle ERP colleagues in a multi-geography, hybrid delivery environment to deliver successful outcomes for our clients. 

Requirements

The following requirements are important for the role, and we would expect candidates to demonstrate capability across many of these areas:

Established knowledge & experience in Oracle ERP (Finance and/or Supply Chain) functional roles in a services firm or large enterprise as a consultant or business process specialist
Track-record of at least two successful end to end Oracle ERP (Finance and/or Supply Chain) Cloud implementations in the relevant business domain within enterprise-level organisations
Well established networks, relationships and involvement in the Oracle ecosystem
Ability to work in at a senior client-facing level within complex organisations, able to build empathy, credibility, and trust with key customers
Recognised expertise in Oracle Applications, able to demonstrate the ability to align the functional area with the business requirements to support the company vision
Strong presentation skills, experienced and comfortable presenting to large groups and delivering inspiring and engaging presentations
Collaborative team player, with a willingness to lead by example and roll up their sleeves
Mature interpersonal and influencing skills, especially at senior client levels
Ability to travel as/when required

We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

About Infosys Consulting

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our careers page.

Within Europe, we are recognized as one of the UK's top firms by the Financial Times and Forbes due to our client innovations, our cultural diversity and dedicated training and career paths. Infosys is on the Germany's top employers list for 2023. Management Consulting Magazine named us on their list of Best Firms to Work for. Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.

We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal ambitions. Curious to learn more? We'd love to hear from you.... Apply today!

description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en forretningskritisk ERP-platform og være drivkraften bag Plus Packs digitale udvikling? Plus Pack A/S søger en ambitiøs og forretningsorienteret ERP Process & Platform Manager, der kan tage det samlede ejerskab for virksomhedens ERP-platform og sikre, at systemet skaber maksimal værdi på tværs af hele organisationen.

Plus Pack designer, udvikler, producerer og sælger emballageløsninger til fødevarer. De primære forretningsområder er emballager i aluminium og plast til frosne, kolde og varme fødevarer samt færdigretter, der sælges inden for segmenter som industri, foodservice, Horeca og detailhandel.

Nøglerolle i Plus Packs digitale transformation
Som ERP Process & Platform Manager bliver du bindeleddet mellem IT, forretningen og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du vil:

Sikre stabil drift, governance og videreudvikling af ERP-platformen.
Drive procesforbedringer og sikre, at forretningen får maksimal værdi af systemet.
Lede initiativer inden for automatisering, EDI, RPA og datakvalitet.
Have en central rolle i den kommende migrering til Infor M3 CloudSuite – et af Plus Packs største digitale initiativer de kommende år.
Samarbejde tæt med interne superbrugere, procesejere og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Din indsats bliver direkte synlig i virksomhedens effektivitet, kundeværdi og vækst – og du får en unik mulighed for at præge Plus Packs digitale fremtid.

Forretningsorienteret og teknisk stærk profil
Vi søger dig, der har solid erfaring med ERP – gerne Infor M3 – og som kan kombinere drift, governance og udvikling af systemer med en stærk forretningsforståelse. Du kan navigere i komplekse processer inden for produktion, logistik, supply chain, salg og finans, og du forstår at bygge bro mellem IT og forretning.

Du trives med ansvar og tager naturligt ejerskab for både opgaver og resultater. Med dine stærke samarbejdsevner og tydelige kommunikation kan du skabe ejerskab hos både brugere, ledere og eksterne partnere. Har du erfaring med cloud-migrering, projektledelse eller automatiseringsinitiativer, er det en klar fordel.

Plus Pack: Pionerer i overgangen til cirkulær emballage
Hos Plus Pack vil de vise vejen for fødevareemballageindustrien – de vil drive transformationen fra lineær til cirkulær emballage. Siden 1914 har deres dedikation været drevet af deres grundmotto: ’Man skal gøre en forskel’. Fire generationer senere er drivkraften stærkere og mere relevant end nogensinde før. De ved, at fødevareemballage spiller en afgørende rolle i at skabe en mere bæredygtig fremtid. Ved konstant at designe og udvikle cirkulære emballager gør de det muligt for deres kunder at beskytte fødevaren og få den til at skille sig ud, og samtidig bruge endnu mindre af vores planets’ ressourcer.

For people. For planet. For profit. For good.

About the role
TravelPerk is on a mission to automate travel and spend management. Accounting integrations are a strategic product area, connecting TravelPerk with globally operating ERP systems for seamless accounting, reimbursement and payment processing. Our integrations help customers onboard faster, drive accounting automation and ensure accurate financial reporting, reducing manual repetitive tasks, so that finance teams can focus on strategic work.
This isn’t just about connecting systems; as a Senior Product Manager for Accounting Integrations, you will drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a product that is fundamental to our global growth and our promise of radical efficiency. You will turn deep customer insights and complex technical challenges into an elegant, scalable integration platform that delights finance leaders and becomes a key driver of our competitive advantage. This is a mission-critical role with a direct line to shaping how thousands of businesses manage their spend at scale.

What You’ll Do
Dig into Insights: Use data and user feedback to uncover the biggest opportunities for impact. Share findings with the team and turn them into actionable strategies.
Share the Vision: Clearly communicate the “why” and “where” behind your product areas to keep your team inspired and stakeholders aligned.
Define Strategies: Lay out clear plans for tackling the right problems—explain why they matter, how you’ll solve them, and how success will be measured.
Collaborate and Execute: Work with developers, designers, and other functions like Implementation, Sales Engineering, and Account Managers to bring your strategy to life. Deliver value incrementally.
Be the Go-To Expert: Provide answers, create training materials, and ensure product documentation is up-to-date.
Empower Your Team: Lead with a servant-leadership approach, helping the team stay focused, remove distractions, and foster creativity and collaboration.
Level Up the Product Function: Continuously learn and share insights with colleagues to help build a world-class product team.

What You’ll Need
Experience That Counts: At least 7 years in a tech company, with at least 5 years as a Product Manager. Experience working on accounting integrations is a strong plus. Bonus if you have experience in development, design, or business roles (though not a must).
Finance and accounting: You have a working knowledge of accounting reconciliation and finance operations. You bring knowledge of SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft BC or F&O.
A Sharp Eye for UX: You understand what makes a great user experience and have experience creating customer-facing products that are intuitive and impactful.
SaaS-Savvy: Comfortable working on B2B platforms and collaborating with finance stakeholders, especially in areas like finance, tax, and compliance.
A Drive for Execution: You break down complex projects into smaller steps that deliver value quickly.

Competitive compensation including equity in the company
Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge

"Flexible compensation plan" to help you diversify and increase the net salary

Mental health support tool for your wellbeing
Exponential growth opportunities

Our Vision is for a world where TravelPerk is the platform for human connection in real life (IRL). We take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, and creativity, ultimately making us a great workplace.

TravelPerk is a global company with a diverse customer base—and we want to ensure that the people behind our product reflect that. We're an equal opportunity employer, meaning you're welcome at TravelPerk regardless of your appearance, where you're from, or anything else that makes you.
All official communication from TravelPerk comes from @travelperk.com email addresses, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask candidates to pay for equipment or make any kind of payment during the hiring process. If you receive an unexpected message claiming to be from TravelPerk and asking you to take action, please forward it to security@travelperk.com and we’ll confirm whether it’s legitimate.

Kenyon College, one of the nation’s finest liberal arts colleges, is a small school where academic excellence and a strong sense of community go hand in hand. Kenyon enrolls 1800 undergraduate students, all of whom live on campus the entire time they are students at Kenyon.

We provide creative solutions, responsive services, and reliable, secure access to an enabling infrastructure. The IT team is an encouraging environment where we grow, learn, and pursue our craft. We are helpful, kind, friendly, and respectful of all. We enjoy a sense of humor--something we find essential to our success. We make our work fun whenever possible! Work/life balance is valued here: we love our work but understand that there is more to life. Professional development and diversity are also valued here: we continually learn new skills, grow in our understanding of the world around us, and explore new technologies.

About the Position: Do Work that Matters!

Are you a versatile IT professional with a knack for tackling a wide range of technical challenges? If you're adept at managing complex systems, diving into server logs, and assisting partners with innovative solutions, we invite you to join our team.

The ERP Programmer Analyst reports to the Director for Institutional Data Systems and primarily supports the college’s enterprise data system, Ellucian Banner, and its data integrations. The ERP Programmer Analyst will interact regularly with other departments to support the mission of the College, collaborating extensively with other members of the IT team.

The major functional areas for the ERP Programmer Analyst includes database and server management, integration and analysis. The ERP Programmer Analyst supports the ERP system used for Finance, Human Resources, and Academics. The ERP Programmer Analyst also creates and maintains custom system integrations that connect and synchronize data between the enterprise software system and performs the detailed analysis needed to implement these integrations effectively across a combination of campus and cloud infrastructure.

IT team members are encouraged and expected to develop and grow their skills to match the needs of the institution, and to help others grow, too. Recognizing that technology is continually changing, the ERP Programmer Analyst participates in regular professional development and in the larger professional community as well.

We value both education and experience. A successful candidate should be comfortable with technology, be curious, and love to learn. These are the minimum requirements for a successful candidate:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field or a combination of relevant education and experience.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills.Preferred Qualifications

These Are The Preferred Qualifications For a Successful Candidate

Three (3) years of professional experience with management, operation, and support of computing systems, preferably within a higher education environment.

Experience with Higher Education ERP Systems, specifically Ellucian Banner: Student, Finance and Human Resource (HR) modules.

Knowledge of or experience with common programming languages and ability to utilize APIs.

Knowledge of database and application upgrades and testing.

Knowledge of SQL programming - design, coding and testing.

Knowledge of scripting languages - Python, PowerShell, Perl, etc.

Knowledge of Oracle DBMS and Microsoft SQL Server DBMS database administration.

Knowledge of Windows server and Linux server operating systems .

Experience with authentication and authorization. Working Conditions: 

Kenyon is an employer that understands the complexity of modern life. Our IT team works flexible hours and can function in a hybrid environment.

Application Process

Applicants should submit a cover letter and a resume. 

For full consideration, please submit your materials by June 20th, 2025. Compensation and Benefits:

Salaries at Kenyon are competitive and commensurate with experience. In addition to an attractive salary, Kenyon offers excellent benefits for employees and their family members. Children of employees are eligible for 100% tuition waivers at Kenyon, and through the Great Lakes Colleges Association, children of employees are eligible for 90% tuition waivers at nineteen other of the nation's finest liberal arts colleges.

We also offer health, dental and vision insurance, TIAA retirement, and many other benefits, including provisions for a spouse, families, and domestic partners. Details about benefits as well as conditions of employment are described more fully in our Staff Handbook.

Kenyon is a unique place to live and work. To discover why it should be your next home, click here.

Kenyon College is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from all qualified individuals. It is the College's policy to evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, physical and/or mental disability, age, religion, medical condition, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by institutional policy or state, local, or federal law. Formulates and recommends to higher management policies and procedures required to provide efficient and effective software applications support to the division’s technology customers.

Advises higher management regarding current trends in application development.

Johns Hopkins Sightline: Unleash Your Impact

The Johns Hopkins Sightline Business Modernization Project is more than just a job - it's a mission. We're tearing down walls to unleash the full potential of our people. Baltimore, ranked a top 2024 destination by the New York Times, is your backdrop as you join a dynamic and entrepreneurial team to reimagine the way Johns Hopkins works. We're not just simplifying processes and transforming technology - we're empowering people to focus on what matters most: research, teaching, patient care and community impact.

Does this sound like you?

Thrive in fast-paced environments with daily new challenges and opportunities.
Are passionate about simplifying complex systems to change people's lives.
Believe in transformation that empowers, not hinders, the front-line people.
Have experience in process improvement, technology implementation, or project management.
Enjoy analytical thinking and problem solving.
Communicate clearly with a team.
Possess a desire to grow and learn.

Joining Sightline means you'll

Work with cutting-edge technology.
Join a collaborative team of experts in higher education and healthcare.
Build new skills with a team that encourages creativity, innovation, and personal growth.
Gain valuable experience and expertise in process improvement, technology implementation, and change management.
Enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package that includes health insurance, retirement savings plans, telework options, and generous paid time off.

Become an architect of change and help shape the future of Johns Hopkins University and Medicine alongside a passionate team in Baltimore's vibrant hub.

Sightline is seeking a Sightline Testing Team ERP Manager who will be responsible for overseeing the testing strategy, execution, and reporting for Workday applications. This position requires a strong understanding of Workday (or similar ERP) functionalities, testing methodologies, and project management skills. The ideal candidate will lead a team of testing coordinators, collaborate with various stakeholders, and ensure that all testing activities are conducted efficiently and effectively.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Workday testing coordinators, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
Testing Strategy Development: Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies and plans for Workday modules, ensuring alignment with project timelines and business objectives.
Test Planning and Execution: Oversee the creation of test cases, test scripts, and test data, ensuring thorough testing of all Workday functionalities, including functional, regression, user acceptance, and performance testing.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business analysts, project managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure that testing aligns with business needs.
Defect Management: Manage defect tracking and resolution processes, ensuring timely communication of issues and status updates to stakeholders.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements in testing methodologies and tools, implementing best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
Reporting and Metrics: Provide regular updates and reports on testing progress, results, and quality metrics to senior management and project teams.
Training and Development: Facilitate training and knowledge-sharing sessions for team members and stakeholders on testing processes, tools, and Workday functionalities.

Specific Devices, Software, Projects

Workday's suite of applications will be the focus of this position.

Scale/size of Area, Project and/or System Supported

Works in a highly complex 70+ server environment supporting Johns Hopkins Enterprise Employee Resource Planning (ERP) solutions.
Workday software is an integrated development solution incorporating JH's key business functions of Human Resources (Payroll, Benefits), Materials Management (Purchasing, and Inventory Management), Grants/Funds Management, Finance and Accounting.
The Workday system will support over 60,000 users with the HCM module through payroll and benefits.
Workday will interface to over 450+ other internal and external systems including student services, banks, benefit providers, clinical applications, and e-commerce hubs to support the daily functions of the university and health system organizations. 

On-call Requirements

Manages a team with members that may be required to be on-call during specific time periods during the implementation and go-live of the Workday environment.

Special Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of Workday or similar HR/Financial systems modules and functionalities, along with testing methodologies and best practices.
Proven experience in leading testing teams and managing complex testing projects.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with testing tools and automation solutions.

Supervisory Responsibility 

Position manages a team of Sr. Testing Software Engineers and Testing Software Engineers

Additional Information

The work hours will primarily be regular day shift office hours. However, there may be times when employees are required to work off hours to respond to project inquiries, adhere to project deadlines and meet the overall needs of a 24/7 health system/university.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business Administration, or relevant functional area.
Ten years broad experience in a senior level position with a combination in IT and business best practices.
Demonstrated experience in testing management or similar ERP experience, preferably with a focus on Workday or similar HR/Financial systems.
Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond HS Diploma/Graduation Equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with the full life cycle of software development projects (analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and maintenance).
Workday certification.
Familiarity with Workday Testing functionality. 
Kainos experience.

We have all come across that individual who doesn't really doesn't do much unless they are told to do things. This is not really the kind of person we are seeking for this role. We are looking for that person that takes that self-motivated mindset and goes to town.
This is the kind of role where everyone really shares their knowledge and we are seeking that person - as you might have guessed - that likes to share their knowledge as well. This is the kind of organization that only thrives if everyone works together.

This is a contract role that will go for at least 6 months. The role is being done remotely. However, preference will be given to candidates on the East Coast or Central Time Zone.

This role is a 80/20 split of 80% functional and 20% technical. So, as you might have guessed, this is a solid functional role as opposed to a technical one. You will be working with internal user groups focused on finance. So, a solid understanding of how balance sheets work, how income statements work, and so on, will be very important to success in this role. You will be working, hand-in-hand, with the business side of the house as they go live with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP. Early in September, the entire firm will be live on Oracle Fusion. If you have 'held court' with financial teams in your past, that is spot on with regards to what we are seeking in this role. You will be driving decision making, getting answers (as opposed to just waiting to get those), and work on getting consensus in terms of decisions to move forward.

Serve as the main 'go to' functional resource for finance.
Configuration & optimization of Oracle EPM Cloud Modules. This will include Planning & Budgeting (PBCS and EPBCS), Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), and Account Reconciliation (ARCS) and Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS).
Functional support and configuration of GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash Management, Cost Management & Tax.
Collaborate with supply chain & finance teams to align ERP configs with product lifecycle, inventory and procurement processes.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional specs and sys configs.
Support integrations with order management, inventory & procurement.
Develop & execute test plans, support UAT, and ensure successful deployments. This will also include - as you might guess - ongoing support, training & documentation for end users & stakeholders.

At last 6 years of experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials (so, it will be very important that your resume specifically states what modules within Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP you have experience with). At least 5 years or more of functional finance experience. This experience should be gained during ERP implementation or support projects you have either led or been a part of.
At least a couple years of experience with Oracle Cloud integrations & reporting tools (OTBI, BI Publisher & Smart View are examples).

description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION 

The ERP Systems Administrator plays a critical role in managing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) applications, encompassing security administration and both technical and functional responsibilities.

In this position, the individual will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications. They will design, develop, and implement solutions within the ERP software environment while ensuring accuracy through technical design documentation and unit testing. Additionally, this role involves providing customer support, troubleshooting and resolving both functional and technical issues, and fostering strong relationships to enhance user experience and system efficiency.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Administers security, provides functional support, and assists with development for ITC’s ERP systems, with a primary focus on PeopleSoft Financials, Supply Chain modules, Canon Imaging Solution, and other integrated platforms. 
Collects and documents both technical and functional details to support user requests related to PeopleSoft Financials, Supply Chain modules, Canon Imaging Solution, and associated ERP applications. 
Develops and maintains configuration guides, design documentation, and user knowledge resources. 
Conducts fit-gap analyses and suggests options for product changes and resolving issues. 
Supports system functionality through regression, patch, and user acceptance testing. 
Manages security configurations, system setups, and data structures for PeopleSoft, Canon, and other ERP systems. 
Designs and configures workflows and user groups based on business needs. 
Works collaboratively with team members to troubleshoot issues, plan application support, and resolve complex problems involving Canon, PeopleSoft Financials, Supply Chain, and related ERP systems. 
Ensures compliance with company policies, industry standards, and best practices while maintaining the ITC environment. 
Applies approved project management methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle. 
Safeguards ERP system data integrity in accordance with Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) controls and prepares documentation and reports for internal and external audits. 
Updates and maintains system support documentation, operational procedures, and user training materials. 
Participates in round-the-clock support for ERP systems 

Requirements

Associate II Level

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or Computer Information Systems, with at least one (1) year of professional application administration experience, including experience in targeted high availability environments, as identified in job posting supplement, or relevant, equivalent experience and/or education. 

Intermediate Level

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science or Computer Information Systems with a minimum of three (3) years of professional application administration experience, including experience in targeted high availability environments, as identified in job posting supplement, or relevant, equivalent experience and/or education. 

For Both Levels

Demonstrates strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a sharp aptitude for resolving technical issues efficiently. 
Communicates effectively, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
Brings a collaborative spirit and a constructive attitude to team efforts and cross-functional initiatives. 
Performs well in dynamic, high-pressure environments and remains flexible to work extended hours when required. 
Understands and applies Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) controls in support of audit-related activities. 
Experienced in using ticketing systems for managing change requests and tracking support issues. 
Possesses hands-on experience with ERP platforms or has previously managed system/server administration tasks aligned with the role’s responsibilities. 
Has a solid grasp of Windows server environments. 
Maintains working knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MS SQL. 
Skilled in SQL scripting for data manipulation, reporting, and process automation. 
Capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritizing work based on business objectives. 
Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. 
Demonstrates a strong aptitude and enthusiasm for learning new technologies as needed. 

Supplement: Additional Responsibilities and Qualifications for Job Posting

ERP Applications: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain modules or other ERP Systems.

Databases: MS SQL, Oracle

Languages: SQL, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, Rest API, PowerShell.

Tools: SQL Developer, Query tools.

Operating System: Windows 10, Windows Server 2019, SQL Server 2019 or higher

Office Tools: MS Outlook, Excel, Visio, Word, PowerPoint.

About Us

From electric vehicles to renewables, the world is looking at electricity in a whole new way, and ITC is focused on building and maintaining a power grid that can handle it all. We are looking for individuals who are ready to work with us to build a greater grid for a greener future. In return, ITC is proud to offer industry-leading compensation, benefits and opportunities to channel your energy into community-changing solutions . As an equal opportunity employer, we feel it’s crucial to honor our differences, be inclusive, engage as a team, and maximize our individual strengths.

Please take a moment to review our Diversity Statement .

And above all, it means exceptional care, simply delivered — and we couldn’t do it without you.

Make a Difference

Community Health Network is seeking an IT Solutions Team Lead who will assist leadership in leading a team within our ERP Solutions Department. This team will support our Community of Caregivers utilizing the Workday Platform in design and maintenance of integrations and our UKG Pro Workforce Management solution. This role will lead their team through the software life cycle from discovery to maintenance and support.

A day in the life of this role includes working alongside the team to support our Caregivers and solutions which keep our business running. Working directly with leadership to plan for coming projects, address technology concerns, and assist in transforming the future for solutions within your domain. In this role you will mentor your team and enable success through your experience in enterprise solution support. Build relationships with your business partners to grow trust in our solutions and help enable business processes, optimizations and create solutions to our challenges.

Our Analyst Team Lead will become a knowledgeable authority in our ERP Solutions, Workday Integrations and provide support to other teams and Community Health Network Caregivers as appropriate. This will be accomplished through defined methodology to independently perform software life cycle tasks. Consistently demonstrates effective communication and team building skills. These tasks may include planning, system analysis, design, application building, testing, maintenance, and support and completing or facilitating special project work. The Analyst Team Leads will also be a systems thinker, understand the interdependencies of the applications they support, understand performance improvement and project management methodologies, and model those skills.

Candidates for this role should expect to be on-site once a week and as needed for leadership collaboration and team support.

Exceptional Skills And Qualifications

Applicants for this position should be able to collaborate with others in a team setting, have excellent communication skills, and a positive attitude toward problem-solving.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information systems or other technically relevant degree required.
In lieu of the above education requirements, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Five (5) or more years of application design, implementation and support experience is required.
Possess prior experience of supporting large scale organizations with successful ERP implementation(s) strongly preferred.
Solution design, configuration, and support.
Solution user security setup and design.
Database structures, report creation and query languages such as SQL.
Experience in data conversion, data mapping, data structures, and data transfers.
Ability to lead project work through project management methodologies.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with a strong focus on customer service and solution ownership.
Ability to work in a team environment consisting of technical and non-technical members.
Ability to manage software vendor accounts as a representative of Community Health Network for assigned solutions.
Present strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to share knowledge and mentor other employees.
Assist in planning production roll-out and deployment related activities.
Excellent written and verbal skills, including conducting/leading customer meetings, conducting presentations, and advising support and implementation team on technical issues.
Create and maintain documentation and standards.
Create and maintain thorough and complete technical documentation of all supported solutions.

Why Community? 

At Community Health Network, we build teams that deliver exceptional care through empathy, communication and collaboration. We consider ALL an integral part of the exceptional patient experience. We PRIIDE ourselves on not having employees but Caregivers. Join our Community as we make a difference in your community.

Caring people apply here.

Apply Today!

Through strategic acquisitions of specialised metals software providers such as Metalogic, PCI, and Compusource, we have established a strong presence in the UK, North America, and other international markets.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

We are seeking a highly experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Functional Administrator to join our team. This role is pivotal in the implementation and ongoing success of our Oracle Fusion ERP application and related integrations. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of technical and functional expertise, with a particular focus on Financials, Supply Chain Management (SCM), and other operations-related modules. Additionally, experience with Functional Setup Manager (FSM) and resolving issues related to product management and finance configurations will be critical.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of ERP technology, supporting critical business processes in a dynamic and innovative environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in optimizing our Oracle Fusion ERP system and enabling efficient, scalable operations. If you are passionate about applying your Oracle Fusion expertise to support the mission of a pioneering technology company, we encourage you to apply for this strategic role.

WHAT YOU"LL DO:

Conduct regular system health checks to ensure scheduled jobs, FBDI loads, and OTBI/BIP reports are optimized.
Maintain administrator profile values and environment sizing parameters (e.g., ESS job threads) and ensure they are configured appropriately for the environment based on user and transaction volume.
Extensive experience with scheduled jobs and file import/export functionality.

Backend Expertise 

Manage and optimize queries to Oracle Fusion ERP's backend tables.
Develop and maintain complex SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures.
Troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues.
API and Integration 

Oversee the implementation and management of Oracle Fusion APIs.
Assist developers in associating API endpoints with specific backend Oracle Fusion tables and columns.
Ensure seamless integration between Oracle Fusion and other systems.
Data Import and Reporting 

Manage and optimize File-Based Data Import (FBDI) processes for SCM, Financials, and other modules.
Develop and maintain FBDI templates and troubleshoot import issues.
Manage and optimize Business Intelligence Cloud Connector (BICC) processes.
Develop and maintain Public View Objects (PVOs) for both BIP and OTBI reporting and integration purposes.
Provide guidance on best practices for utilizing PVOs in custom development.
Functional Setup Manager (FSM) 

Utilize FSM to configure and manage Oracle Fusion ERP applications and move configurations between dev/test and prod environments.
Address and resolve problematic configurations, particularly related to DTB items and financial modules such as Projects, General Ledger (GL), and Purchase Orders (POs).
Performance Tuning and Quality Assurance 

Monitor and optimize database performance.
Implement indexing strategies and query optimization techniques.
Assist in the development and execution of test plans to ensure system functionality and performance.
Identify and resolve defects, ensuring high-quality system performance.
Technical Expertise and Support 

Provide technical support for end-users, troubleshooting and resolving ERP-related issues.
Develop and maintain technical documentation for system configurations, processes, and procedures.
Collaborate with developers to design and implement custom applications and integrations.
Collaboration and Communication 

Work closely with ERP analysts, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Communicate system changes and updates to relevant teams.
Participate in cross-functional team meetings to align on objectives and deliverables.
Maintain a “work in public” philosophy to prevent siloed conversations or implementation efforts.
Required Qualifications

Extensive experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP (not EBS), with a strong focus on backend administration and functional responsibilities.
Experience working in Oracle Fusion ERP environments for publicly traded companies.
Experience in navigating SOX compliance policies and ensure they are satisfied as part of IPO readiness.
In-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion's backend tables, views, APIs, and FBDI processes.
Expertise in BICC and PVO development and management.
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export-controlled data.
Ability to work in-office part time and willingness to travel up to 25%.

Preferred Qulifications

Oracle Certified Master (OCM) in Oracle Fusion Applications.
Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of additional programming languages (e.g., Java, Python).
Experience in manufacturing-focused ERP implementations.
Familiarity with cloud development and CI/CD pipelines.
Advanced skills in OTBI and BI Publisher, including custom report development and dashboards.

US Salary Range

$154,000—$231,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Platinum Healthcare Benefits: For U.S. roles, we offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans at little to no cost to you.
For UK roles, Private Medical Insurance (PMI): Anduril will cover the full cost of the insurance premium for an employee and dependents.
For AUS roles, Private health plan through Bupa: Coverage is fully subsidized by Anduril.
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance 100% covered by Anduril, plus the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents.
Extremely generous company holiday calendar including a holiday hiatus in December, and highly competitive PTO plans.
16 weeks of paid Caregiver & Wellness Leave to care for a family member, bond with your baby, or tend to your own medical condition.
Family Planning & Parenting Support: Fertility (eg, IVF, preservation), adoption, and gestational carrier coverage with additional benefits and resources to provide support from planning to parenting.
Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy, life coaching, and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, available to you as well.
A professional development stipend is available to all Andurilians.
Daily Meals and Provisions: For many of our offices this means breakfast, lunch and fully stocked micro-kitchens.

description:
L'entreprise

Envie de rejoindre un expert de son domaine, s’appuyant sur une marque synonyme de qualité ? Tendriade est fait pour vous !

Fort de ses 650 collaborateurs, TENDRIADE est le leader de la viande de veau en France. Nos deux sites de production, situés à Châteaubourg (35) et à Saulce Sur Rhône (26), produisent 35 000 tonnes de produits finis chaque année pour un chiffre d’affaires de 290 Millions d’Euros.

Nous proposons une large gamme de produits frais et surgelés, adaptés aux particuliers comme aux professionnels. Intégré au Groupe néerlandais VAN DRIE, nous maîtrisons l’ensemble de la filière, afin de garantir les meilleurs produits à nos clients !

Description Du Poste

Au sein du service informatique, composé de 5 collaborateurs, vous serez placé sous la responsabilité du Responsable des Systèmes d’Information.

À L'occasion D'un Projet De Transformation Majeure Incluant L'implémentation D'un Nouvel ERP, Vous Serez Le Point De Référence Pour L'ERP En Étant Garant(e) De La Gestion, De L'évolution Et Du Bon Fonctionnement De L'application, En Lien Avec Les Équipes Métiers Et Techniques. Vos Principales Missions à Ce Poste Seront Les Suivantes 

Mise en place du projet ERP : en lien avec l’éditeur/intégrateur et les membres de l’équipe projet vous participez à la conception, la planification et le pilotage des phases de build pour le nouveau projet de transformation du SI.
Recueil des besoins : travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers pour comprendre leurs besoins, formaliser les demandes et les prioriser.
Intégration des systèmes : garantir l'interconnexion de l'ERP avec les autres systèmes pour assurer la cohérence et les performances de l'ensemble de l'écosystème applicatif.
Configuration et paramétrage: traduire les besoins métiers en solutions concrètes et fonctionnelles.
Gestion des intégrations : assurer la coordination des intégrations avec les autres systèmes applicatifs de l'entreprise, en garantissant leur cohérence avec l'environnement technique global.
Coordination des parties prenantes : animer les échanges entre les équipes internes, les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes.
Pilotage des développements externes : participer à l’encadrement des prestataires externes dans la phase de réalisation, tout en s’assurant du respect et de la qualité des livrables.
Mise en œuvre du plan de recette de la solution: en lien avec les référents métiers
Formation et support utilisateur : former et accompagner les utilisateurs sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités, garantir un support de qualité.
Documentation : assurer la rédaction et la mise à jour des documentations techniques et utilisateurs.
Assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles : fonctionnalités, mises à jour, suivi des incidents.
Piloter les projets d'évolution :
Gérer le backlog et prioriser les fonctionnalités en accord avec les enjeux métiers.
Organiser et suivre la réalisation des évolutions avec les équipes techniques.
Piloter les phases de recette et de validation des nouvelles fonctionnalités.
Assurer une veille technologique : Suivre les évolutions du marché des ERP pour proposer des améliorations et rester compétitif.
Cette liste de missions est non exhaustive, ce poste sera amené à évoluer en fonction de vos compétences et appétences professionnelles.

Profil recherché

Issu(e) d’une formation supérieure en informatique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience réussie dans la gestion d'applications ERP, idéalement acquise en tant que Responsable d'Application ou Chef de Projet ERP.

Votre capacité à dialoguer avec les équipes métiers (finance, commerce, production, logistique, etc.) est un atout essentiel pour comprendre leurs attentes et traduire leurs besoins en spécifications techniques.

Vous connaissez l’architecture applicative d’un ERP et maitrisez son intégration au sein de l’écosystème technique global ?

Vous possédez une expérience dans le déploiement, la gestion et l'évolution d'un ERP ?

Votre agilité vous permet d’évoluer dans un environnement complexe et en constante évolution, en s’adaptant rapidement aux enjeux et contraintes ?

Rigoureux(se), méthodique et pédagogue, vous possédez un sens aigu de l’écoute et de la satisfaction des utilisateurs ?

Si la réponse est oui à toutes ces questions, vous êtes fait pour nous rejoindre !

Les Plus De Tendriade

Une ambiance de travail positive et dynamique.
Un rôle clé, avec une forte dimension stratégique et opérationnelle.
Des projets stimulants pour vous élever professionnellement.
Des avantages sociaux: 13èmemois, Primes, Plan Epargne Entreprise, Compte Epargne Temps, Restaurant d’entreprise, CSE, mutuelle…

Con sus 650 empleados, Terriad es el líder de la carne de ternera en Francia. Nuestros dos sitios de producción, ubicados en Châteaubourg (35) y Saulce Sur Rhône (26), producen 35,000 toneladas de productos terminados cada año para una facturación de 290 millones de euros. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de productos frescos y congelados, adecuados para individuos y profesionales. Perfil buscado de una mayor capacitación en computadora en informática o equivalente, justifica al menos 5 años de experiencia exitosa en la gestión de aplicaciones ERP, idealmente adquiridas como gerente de aplicaciones o gerente de proyectos ERP. Work Schedule: Day Shift

Overview:
Join a mission-driven team where your expertise goes beyond technology — it drives meaningful change across a large, dynamic organization. We're looking for a strategic ERP Solutions Architect with deep knowledge of Workday to help steer enterprise digital transformation efforts. In this role, you'll be instrumental in aligning Workday solutions with business goals, delivering measurable outcomes across multiple departments.

Key Responsibilities:
Take ownership of the solution design and end-to-end implementation of Workday modules within your assigned domain.
Act as the subject matter expert for Workday, guiding the ERP architecture team in creating scalable and efficient configurations.
Lead the optimization of existing systems and processes to improve performance, user experience, and business value.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to influence technical decisions, system architecture, and investment priorities.
Ensure that design and documentation practices follow internal standards and regulatory guidelines.
Partner with QA and operational teams to support testing, change management, and smooth deployment of ERP enhancements.
Conduct market and technical research to recommend best-in-class ERP practices in areas like HCM, Finance, Grants, and Supply Chain.
Support long-term strategic planning for ERP systems, including policy development and roadmap alignment.

Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline (Master’s preferred).
A minimum of 10 years’ experience delivering full life cycle ERP implementations, with at least 2-3 years working hands-on with Workday platforms.
Demonstrated success in leading configuration and deployment efforts across multiple Workday modules such as HCM, Financials, Grants, and Supply Chain.
Experience in Workday Security Administration is a plus.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Proven leadership in cross-functional team environments with a track record of delivering results.

Nous sommes un groupe industriel pharmaceutique français, reconnu pour rendre accessible au plus grand nombre des solutions de santé qui améliorent et simplifient la vie des patients.
Riche de 30 ans d'expertise technologique, nous nous positionnons comme leader mondial de l'unidose stérile avec 10 sites répartis sur 4 continents et plus de 2000 collaborateurs.
Notre site Unither Pharmaceuticals basé à Paris rassemble les fonctions supports liées à l'activité du Groupe. Il compte plus de 60 collaborateurs.
Le Groupe Unither recrute un(e) Architecte Solution ERP pour rejoindre notre équipe DSI sur un périmètre France et International. En tant qu'Architecte, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'analyse et la conception des architectures des solutions ERP, garantissant ainsi la cohérence et l'efficacité de nos systèmes. 

Vos missions principales sont :
Analyser et concevoir les architectures des solutions ERP JDE en fonction des besoins des utilisateurs.
Réaliser l'analyse des besoins en vous basant sur votre expertise multi métiers.
Définir les exigences et les spécifications techniques du système ERP.
Élaborer des choix de conception structurants pour assurer la cohérence de l'ensemble de la solution.
Analyser les écarts en avant-projet pour le déploiement de la solution sur des sites non équipés.
Définir la feuille de route fonctionnelle de l'ERP, y compris la rédaction du Business Case.
Mener les déploiements des architectures JDE sur les différents sites du Groupe.
Configurer l'ERP (paramétrage) et assister au recettage des paramétrages et des développements.
Participer à la définition et à la création des livrables autour de la solution (documents, migration de données, formations, gestion du changement, etc.).
Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et l'équipe technique pour recueillir les besoins et prioriser les mises en œuvre.
Coordonner les différentes équipes (techniques, développement) pour assurer une mise en œuvre efficace des solutions.
Évaluer les arbitrages nécessaires au déploiement des solutions et assister au support post-démarrage pour la résolution des incidents.
Le poste peut être basé sur l'un de nos sites (Amiens, Coutances, Paris).
Vous justifiez de plus de 5 ans d'expérience sur SAP, dont au moins 2 ans en tant qu'Architecte Solution SAP.
Vous avez participé à au moins un cycle complet d'implémentation ERP, de la phase de Business Case jusqu'au Go Live.
Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme Bac +5, généraliste ou spécialisé en systèmes d'information.
Vous avez une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
Vous êtes prêt à effectuer des déplacements en France et à l'international, en fonction des projets.
Le poste peut être basé sur l'un de nos sites (Amiens, Coutances, Paris).

APICS CPIM or CSCP; and, 
Microsoft Azure DevOps.

Coaching staff including providing timely and meaningful written and verbal feedback.

ISO 9001 / ISO 27001 / cyber security policies.
