description:
About Justrite Safety Group

At Justrite Safety Group, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet. Our ever-growing portfolio of companies collaborates to deliver advanced industrial safety solutions that set the standard for excellence.

As our business continues to grow, we continue to look for top talent to join our team as we lead the charge in revolutionizing industrial safety, ensuring that every worker returns home safe, every workplace remains secure, and our environment thrives for generations to come. With Justrite Safety Group, safety isn't just a priority—it's our passion.

The Contribution You’ll Bring To This Role

The Lead Business Systems Analyst – ERP, EDI & Automation plays a critical role in partnering with business stakeholders to streamline processes, define best practices, and enhance system functionality across all customer service areas. This role will be the key functional expert for EDI integrations and automation initiatives, working across multiple ERP systems (Infor XA, Syteline, Frontier) and collaborating with managed services providers to support and improve daily operations.

In this role, you will report directly to the Senior Director of ERP and AI, setting the stage for your career to soar! This role is your gateway to opportunities for advancement, with the potential to grow within the organization in 3-5 years as you make meaningful contributions to our organizational goals.

About The Team

Our IT team is composed of talented professionals who are recognized as some of the best in the industry. They bring a wealth of experience and innovation, ensuring that we remain at the forefront of technology. With a collaborative mindset and a commitment to excellence, the team continuously drives success by creating solutions that power our operations. Whether developing cutting-edge tools or supporting our infrastructure, the IT team is integral in helping us achieve our business goals.

What You’ll Do At Justrite

Business Partnership & Process Improvement: Collaborate with customer service, supply chain, IT, and finance teams to understand business needs and identify opportunities to streamline processes using EDI and ERP automation. 
EDI Strategy & Support: Guide the direction and daily operations of EDI across all business units. Work with managed services providers to ensure timely resolution of EDI issues and high system reliability. 
Best Practice Guidance: Act as a trusted advisor to business units by recommending and implementing EDI and automation best practices. 
Conexiom Workflow Management: Oversee and optimize Conexiom automation for quote and order processing to enhance efficiency and accuracy. 
System Architecture & Design: Evaluate and improve architecture for scalability, consistency, and ease of maintenance across platforms. 
Trading Partner Onboarding: Lead the onboarding of new EDI trading partners, including requirement gathering, mapping, testing, and go-live support. 
Vendor Management: Manage relationships with VANs and external service providers to ensure high service quality and alignment with business needs. 
Documentation & Training: Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation for ERP processes and mappings. Support internal teams through knowledge sharing and training. 
Project Leadership: Drive small-to-medium ERP and automation projects from initiation to delivery, including requirements, testing, and stakeholder alignment. 

Your Skills And Expertise

To ensure your success from day one in this role, Justrite requires the following qualifications at a minimum:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field. 
5+ years of experience supporting or managing EDI in a multi-ERP environment (Infor XA, Syteline, and/or Frontier preferred). 
Deep knowledge of EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and protocols (AS2, FTP, SFTP). 
Hands-on experience with automation platforms like Conexiom. 
Strong collaboration and communication skills with business and IT stakeholders. 
Ability to drive process improvement initiatives and manage vendor relationships. 
Project management and problem-solving skills. 

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

Background in manufacturing or distribution. 
Experience with EDI platforms such as TrueCommerce, SPS Commerce, or similar. 
Experience in different ERP systems like Infor Syteline, SAP, etc. 
Familiarity with API/web service integrations relevant to automation tools. 

Compensation

The position offers a competitive base salary ranging from $140,000 to $160,000.

Actual base salaries will vary and may be above or below the recommended pay range based on factors such as but not limited to location, relevant experience and performance. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan to enhance their overall total compensation package when Justrite Safety Group and their business units achieve annual business and financial targets.

Benefits

Our benefits package at Justrite Safety Group is designed to be the best in the industry, offering everything you need to support your career and personal well-being. You’ll receive a competitive salary paired with an extensive benefits package that includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. We provide flexible hours and alternative work arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance. These options vary depending on the specific roles and business needs.

Your financial future is secure with our 401K plan, complete with a company match, and you’re protected with company-paid short and long-term disability insurance. To ensure you’re at your best, we also offer generous paid time off, personal days, and a robust employee wellness program that supports your overall health and happiness. At Justrite, our benefits package is designed to help you thrive both in and out of the workplace.

Why Choose Justrite Safety Group?

As a leading name in the safety industry, Justrite provides a platform where you can collaborate with some of the best professionals in the field, learning from experts and contributing to cutting-edge solutions. The company's commitment to excellence and innovation ensures that you’ll be part of a team that is making a real impact. With a strong focus on career advancement, Justrite empowers its employees to thrive both personally and professionally, making it an ideal workplace for those looking to grow their careers in a meaningful and rewarding environment.

Join us and be part of a team dedicated to product excellence and making a positive impact in our company, and in our community!

Supplier Portal

Map legacy data to the new ERP structure

Cleanse and standardize master data (e.g. customers, vendors, materials, GL accounts)

Support data enrichment, transformation logic, validation, and reconciliation

Ensure data integrity and consistency across systems

Design and prototype dashboards and reports using BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Infor EPM)

Translate business needs into data models and queries

Ensure master data supports accurate and actionable reporting

Define and document data standards, naming conventions, and validation rules

Support the implementation of master data governance frameworks and tools

Collaborate with data stewards and business data owners to maintain data quality


Testing & Validation


Conduct testing and validation of reports and dashboards

Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in ERP and reporting systems


Documentation & Training


Document data definitions, business rules, and reporting logic

Provide training and guidance to end-users on data usage and interpretation


Post-Go-Live Support


Monitor data quality and reporting effectiveness post-implementation

Identify and resolve data-related issues

Propose continuous improvements in data management and reporting


Requirements

Strong data analysis skills with proficiency in SQL and Power BI (or similar tools)

Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor)

Deep understanding of master data management and data governance principles

Knowledge of data migration, cleansing, and validation

Familiarity with ETL processes, data quality tools, and reporting best practices

Understanding of financial and supply chain data structures

Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills 

Fluent in Hungarian and English

Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. description:
About Justrite Safety Group

At Justrite Safety Group, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet. Our ever-growing portfolio of companies collaborates to deliver advanced industrial safety solutions that set the standard for excellence.

As our business continues to grow, we continue to look for top talent to join our team as we lead the charge in revolutionizing industrial safety, ensuring that every worker returns home safe, every workplace remains secure, and our environment thrives for generations to come. With Justrite Safety Group, safety isn't just a priority—it's our passion.

The Contribution You’ll Bring To This Role

The Lead Business Systems Analyst – ERP, EDI & Automation plays a critical role in partnering with business stakeholders to streamline processes, define best practices, and enhance system functionality across all customer service areas. This role will be the key functional expert for EDI integrations and automation initiatives, working across multiple ERP systems (Infor XA, Syteline, Frontier) and collaborating with managed services providers to support and improve daily operations.

In this role, you will report directly to the Senior Director of ERP and AI, setting the stage for your career to soar! This role is your gateway to opportunities for advancement, with the potential to grow within the organization in 3-5 years as you make meaningful contributions to our organizational goals.

About The Team

Our IT team is composed of talented professionals who are recognized as some of the best in the industry. They bring a wealth of experience and innovation, ensuring that we remain at the forefront of technology. With a collaborative mindset and a commitment to excellence, the team continuously drives success by creating solutions that power our operations. Whether developing cutting-edge tools or supporting our infrastructure, the IT team is integral in helping us achieve our business goals.

What You’ll Do At Justrite

Business Partnership & Process Improvement: Collaborate with customer service, supply chain, IT, and finance teams to understand business needs and identify opportunities to streamline processes using EDI and ERP automation. 
EDI Strategy & Support: Guide the direction and daily operations of EDI across all business units. Work with managed services providers to ensure timely resolution of EDI issues and high system reliability. 
Best Practice Guidance: Act as a trusted advisor to business units by recommending and implementing EDI and automation best practices. 
Conexiom Workflow Management: Oversee and optimize Conexiom automation for quote and order processing to enhance efficiency and accuracy. 
System Architecture & Design: Evaluate and improve architecture for scalability, consistency, and ease of maintenance across platforms. 
Trading Partner Onboarding: Lead the onboarding of new EDI trading partners, including requirement gathering, mapping, testing, and go-live support. 
Vendor Management: Manage relationships with VANs and external service providers to ensure high service quality and alignment with business needs. 
Documentation & Training: Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation for ERP processes and mappings. Support internal teams through knowledge sharing and training. 
Project Leadership: Drive small-to-medium ERP and automation projects from initiation to delivery, including requirements, testing, and stakeholder alignment. 

Your Skills And Expertise

To ensure your success from day one in this role, Justrite requires the following qualifications at a minimum:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field. 
5+ years of experience supporting or managing EDI in a multi-ERP environment (Infor XA, Syteline, and/or Frontier preferred). 
Deep knowledge of EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and protocols (AS2, FTP, SFTP). 
Hands-on experience with automation platforms like Conexiom. 
Strong collaboration and communication skills with business and IT stakeholders. 
Ability to drive process improvement initiatives and manage vendor relationships. 
Project management and problem-solving skills. 

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

Background in manufacturing or distribution. 
Experience with EDI platforms such as TrueCommerce, SPS Commerce, or similar. 
Experience in different ERP systems like Infor Syteline, SAP, etc. 
Familiarity with API/web service integrations relevant to automation tools. 

Compensation

The position offers a competitive base salary ranging from $140,000 to $160,000.

Actual base salaries will vary and may be above or below the recommended pay range based on factors such as but not limited to location, relevant experience and performance. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan to enhance their overall total compensation package when Justrite Safety Group and their business units achieve annual business and financial targets.

Benefits

Our benefits package at Justrite Safety Group is designed to be the best in the industry, offering everything you need to support your career and personal well-being. You’ll receive a competitive salary paired with an extensive benefits package that includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. We provide flexible hours and alternative work arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance. These options vary depending on the specific roles and business needs.

Your financial future is secure with our 401K plan, complete with a company match, and you’re protected with company-paid short and long-term disability insurance. To ensure you’re at your best, we also offer generous paid time off, personal days, and a robust employee wellness program that supports your overall health and happiness. At Justrite, our benefits package is designed to help you thrive both in and out of the workplace.

Why Choose Justrite Safety Group?

As a leading name in the safety industry, Justrite provides a platform where you can collaborate with some of the best professionals in the field, learning from experts and contributing to cutting-edge solutions. The company's commitment to excellence and innovation ensures that you’ll be part of a team that is making a real impact. With a strong focus on career advancement, Justrite empowers its employees to thrive both personally and professionally, making it an ideal workplace for those looking to grow their careers in a meaningful and rewarding environment.

Join us and be part of a team dedicated to product excellence and making a positive impact in our company, and in our community!

description:
Werde Teil der aiconomy AG – einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden SaaS-ERP-Startup aus der Schweiz.

aico ist eine All-in-One SaaS-ERP-Plattform, die speziell für Handelsunternehmen entwickelt wurde, die Shopify im E-Commerce einsetzen. Unsere Lösung vereint Auftragsabwicklung, CRM, PIM, Kommissionierung, 360°-Kundenansicht sowie Lohn- und Finanzbuchhaltung – ergänzt durch eine moderne Collaboration-Plattform. Alles cloudbasiert, automatisiert und optimal vernetzt.

Der Name aico steht für unseren Fokus auf AI. Schon lange vor dem AI-Hype 2023 war Künstliche Intelligenz ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Plattform – tief integriert, um unseren Kunden nachhaltige Wettbewerbsvorteile zu ermöglichen.

Mit automatischen Workflows und umfassender Prozessautomatisierung helfen wir unseren Kunden, komplexe Insellösungen und überholte ERP-Systeme abzulösen und deutlich effizienter zu arbeiten. Unsere Plattform zeigt schon heute, wie modernes Arbeiten morgen aussieht: vernetzt, effizient und benutzerfreundlich.

Unser Team besteht aus rund 60 Mitarbeitenden, die grösstenteils remote arbeiten. Ein kleines Team in der Schweiz trifft sich ein- bis zweimal monatlich in Roggwil (TG) am Hauptsitz oder im Office in Wallisellen. Die Entwicklung erfolgt in unserem eigenen Büro in Cluj, Rumänien – mit einem Team von 35 Entwicklern. Weitere Teammitglieder sind international verteilt.

Wir denken ERP neu: leistungsstark, intuitiv und perfekt abgestimmt auf die Bedürfnisse von Handel und E-Commerce. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem innovativen, agilen Team mitzugestalten und die Digitalisierung im Handel aktiv mit voranzutreiben, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

-----

Kernverantwortlichkeiten im Überblick
In Ihrer Rolle als Senior ERP Delivery Manager & Product Owner verantworten Sie die erfolgreiche Einführung unserer SaaS-Lösungen bei Neukunden – ab Übergabe durch das Sales- und Beratungsteam bis hin zum produktiven Go-Live. Sie übernehmen die fachliche und technische Leitung der Projektumsetzung, koordinieren cross-funktionale Teams und sorgen dafür, dass Lösungen im vereinbarten Zeit-, Budget- und Qualitätsrahmen bereitgestellt werden. Dabei haben Sie nicht nur ein tiefes Verständnis für ERP-Prozesse, sondern auch das nötige Gespür, um Kundenanforderungen in skalierbare Produktlösungen zu überführen.

End-to-End Projektverantwortung bei Neukunden
Sie übernehmen die Gesamtverantwortung für Neuimplementierungen ab der Übergabe durch Sales/Beratung. Basierend auf vorliegenden User Stories und Anforderungen steuern Sie die Umsetzung bis zum Go-Live – inklusive Anforderungsvalidierung, Planung, Entwicklung, Testing, Rollout und Kundenabnahme.

Anforderungsanalyse & Lösungsdesign
Sie prüfen die gelieferten User Stories auf Vollständigkeit, Machbarkeit und Konsistenz, klären offene Punkte direkt mit dem Kunden, priorisieren Anforderungen und entwickeln gemeinsam mit den Entwicklungsteams tragfähige Umsetzungskonzepte.

Technische & ausführende Projektleitung
Sie koordinieren interne Spezialisten (z. B. Head-of-Module, Entwickler, QA), erstellen technische Spezifikationen und stimmen Aufwand, Zeitplan und Abhängigkeiten übergreifend ab. Sie behalten stets die Kontrolle über Scope, Ressourcen und Meilensteine.

Kommunikation & Stakeholder Management
Sie sind zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden im Projektverlauf, sorgen für klare Kommunikation, leiten Workshops und Abstimmungen, und stellen sicher, dass alle Stakeholder intern wie extern auf dem gleichen Stand sind.

Scope- und Vertragsmanagement
Sie prüfen, ob Projektinhalte innerhalb der vereinbarten Leistungen und Lizenzen liegen, und identifizieren frühzeitig Erweiterungsbedarfe oder notwendige Zusatzleistungen. Bei Bedarf schnüren Sie gemeinsam mit Sales passende Folgepakete.

Budgetverantwortung

Company, Department: Nova Scotia Power, Business Transformation

Nova Scotia Power is seeking an experienced Integration Lead to oversee the design, development, and delivery of integration solutions for the cloud ERP implementation project.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Technology & Transformation, this role will be responsible for ensuring seamless data flow between Oracle Fusion and internal/external systems using scalable, secure, and supportable integration patterns. The Integration Lead will work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and vendors to ensure integration solutions meet business needs and align with enterprise architecture standards.

Key Elements Of This Role Include

Collaborating with the architecture and integration teams to define integration architecture, select appropriate integration patterns, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance standards

5+ years of experience in systems integration, including at least 2 years in a lead role on projects

description:
Werde ERP-Consultant für den Handel!

Als Teil der GRÜN Software Group ist die GRÜN raw GmbH eines der führenden Software- und Serviceunternehmen für den Großhandel und Verbundgruppen in Deutschland. Mit innovativen, branchenspezifischen Digitalisierungslösungen helfen wir unseren Kunden, ihre Geschäftsprozesse nachhaltig zu optimieren und zukunftssicher aufzustellen.

Seit über 50 Jahren stehen wir für Qualität und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit. Werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und bringe deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten ein, um die digitale Transformation aktiv mitzugestalten – für uns und unsere Kunden!

Deine Zukunft Bei Uns

Wir glauben fest daran, dass der Einklang von Beruf, Familie und Freizeit der Schlüssel für langfristiges Glück, Gesundheit und Erfolg ist. Work-Life-Balance ist bei uns gelebte Realität: Bei uns stehst Du als Mensch im Mittelpunkt – auch in einer dynamischen und innovativen Branche.

Warum solltest Du Teil unseres Teams werden?

Langfristige Perspektive: Suchst Du spannende Aufgaben mit Verantwortung und ein sicheres, unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis? 
Familienfreundlichkeit & Flexibilität: Möchtest Du geregelte, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten mit attraktiver Kernarbeitszeit von 9-12 Uhr und der Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit genießen? Wir sind ausgezeichnet als „Familienfreundliches Unternehmen“. 
Schnelle Entscheidungen und Möglichkeit zur Mitgestaltung: Schätzt Du kurze Informationswege und flache Hierarchien, bei denen Deine Ideen aktiv eingebracht werden können, um gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickelt? 
Angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld: Genieße frisches Obst, eine Kaffee- und Wasser-Flat sowie 28 Urlaubstage – plus arbeitsfreie Tage an Weihnachten und Silvester sowie freiwillige Sonderurlaubstage. 
Teamorientiertes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima Du möchtest Teil eines Teams werden, in dem Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Wertschätzung an erster Stelle stehen? Freue Dich auf regelmäßige Team-Events, sowie Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern oder monatliche Pizza-Days.

Kurz gesagt: Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur einen Job - hier findest du deinen Platz zum Wachsen und Wohlfühlen!

Deine Mission

Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter der erfolgreichen Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und Pflege unserer ERP-Software – speziell entwickelt für den Handel. Du begleitest unsere Kunden dabei, ihr Business auf das nächste Level zu heben.

Beratung & Umsetzung: Du berätst Handelsunternehmen bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung unseres ERP-Systems (Warenwirtschaft, Lagerwirtschaft, Finanzbuchhaltung, Archiv) und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Prozess.
Problem-Lösungs-Profi: Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und bringst sie durch gezielte Anpassungen im ERP-System zum Laufen.
Testing & Optimierung: Du testest die Software, entdeckst Verbesserungspotenziale und packst aktiv mit an, um unser System noch besser zu machen.
Training & Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst alle Abläufe und gibst dein Wissen in Schulungen weiter.

Dein Profil

Erfahrung & Wissen: Du hast ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaft oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung (idealerweise im Handel) und mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Branche.
Tech-Affinität: Du hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis und gehst mit Software, deren Entwicklung und Systemen sicher um.
Prozess-Profi: Du kannst komplexe Abläufe schnell erfassen und mit unserer ERP-Software abgleichen.
Kommunikation: Du erklärst Dinge klar und verständlich, bleibst auch in stressigen Situationen ruhig und arbeitest gerne im Team.
Motivation: Du denkst bereichsübergreifend und bist hochmotiviert, dich in neue und komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Handels – mit dir an unserer Seite.

Jessica Krämer

description:
Contexte Client
Notre client, acteur reconnu du secteur de l’assurance, mène actuellement un projet stratégique visant à la fois la maintenance et le déploiement progressif d’un ERP métier. Ce programme s’inscrit dans un partenariat long terme et couvre notamment le développement de nouveaux modules spécifiques (cotisations, contrats).
L’ERP est un ERP Tryton (un ERP open source, modulaire et robuste, particulièrement apprécié pour sa flexibilité et sa fiabilité écrit en Python) et s’intègre dans un environnement applicatif déjà en production. L’équipe projet est constituée d’un développeur confirmé en interne, et bénéficie ponctuellement du support d’une équipe élargie de 17 développeurs basée en Alsace.
Contexte du besoin
Afin de renforcer ses capacités de développement et d’accélérer la mise en place de nouveaux modules ERP, notre client fait appel à ECARIS. Dans ce contexte nous recherchons un consultant qui pourrait travailler pour nous en tant que développeur expérimenté (expertise requise) en langage Python. La connaissance de Tryton n’est pas obligatoire mais une expérience préalable avec un ERP Open Source type Odoo ou encore ERPNext serait fortement apprécié.
L’objectif est d’apporter une expertise technique de haut niveau, d’assurer un pilotage technique auprès du développeur interne et de l’équipe élargie, et de garantir la qualité globale des développements autour de l’ERP.
Le contexte ne demande pas un consultant Tech Lead mais plutôt développeur de haut niveau. La mission est néanmoins ouverte à un Tech Lead ou selon les appétence du consultant la mission pourrait évoluer à terme vers un rôle de Tech Lead.
Description de la mission à prester
La mission consiste à :
· Assurer le développement de nouveau modules pour un ERP (plateforme Tryton). Il y aura spécifiquement 2 modules à développer (un module « cotisations » hors primes d’assurance et un module « contrats »).
· Contribuer à la maintenance corrective et évolutive de l’existant.
· Collaborer avec un développeur interne et assurer une coordination ponctuelle avec l’équipe de 17 développeurs basée en Alsace.
· Définir et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de développement (tests, revue de code, documentation, CI/CD).
· Être un référent technique Python / ERP pour l’équipe projet.
· Garantir la cohérence et la qualité des livrables techniques.
Missions principales
· Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en spécifications techniques claires et exploitables.
· Concevoir et développer de nouveaux modules ERP sous Python (framework Tryton).
· Assurer la maintenance et les évolutions des modules ERP existants.
· Définir et maintenir une architecture applicative claire et évolutive.
· Assurer le mentorat technique et le support auprès des développeurs impliqués.
· Mettre en place et suivre des standards de qualité (tests unitaires, intégration continue).
· Intervenir comme point d’escalade technique en cas de problématiques complexes.
Compétences requises
· +10 ans d’expérience en développement, dont minimum 5 ans sur Python (le nombre d’années est indicatif – le plus important est l’expertise en Python).
· Expérience confirmée en tant que Developer dans des contextes ERP ou applicatifs complexes similaires.
· Maitrise de PostgreSQL ou autre forme de SQL serait fortement appréciée
· Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement et de l’industrialisation logicielle obligatoire
· Familiarité avec des applicatifs Open Source en Python (connaissance de l’ERP Tryton ou autre ERP en Python sera appréciée mais non obligatoire).
· Solide compréhension des environnements ERP (architecture, cycle de vie, intégration).
· Forte autonomie, capacité à piloter et à transmettre les bonnes pratiques.
Profil du consultant recherché
· Tech Lead orienté excellence technique et encadrement.
· Pédagogue et capable d’apporter du mentorat technique.
· Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’initiative et sens de la qualité logicielle.
· Expérience significative dans des environnements exigeants et en évolution.
· Bon relationnel et capacité à interagir avec des équipes locales et distantes.
Conditions de la prestation

· Déplacements : ponctuellement à Strasbourg ou à Paris (1 à 2 fois sur la durée de la mission) – frais pris en charge
· Démarrage : ASAP
· Durée : mission initiale de 6 mois, renouvelable selon avancement du projet

description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Power BI Developer with strong expertise in Oracle ERP, Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Fabric Data Lake. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in migrating QlikView reports to Power BI, delivering optimized, scalable, and interactive BI solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and deploy Power BI reports, dashboards, and datasets for business users.
• Lead the migration of QlikView reports to Power BI, ensuring accurate data mapping, visualization alignment, and performance optimization.
• Integrate and transform data from Oracle ERP and FAW into Power BI for analytics and reporting.
• Build and maintain ADF ETL pipelines to load data from multiple sources into the Azure Fabric Data Lake and Power BI datasets.
• Develop optimized data models, DAX measures, and Power Query transformationsto meet reporting requirements.
• Implement row-level security (RLS) and governance best practices for data access control.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Optimize report performance through semantic model design, query tuning, and incremental data refresh strategies.
• Troubleshoot data refresh issues, performance bottlenecks, and report errors.
• Document technical specifications, migration processes, and data flow diagrams.

Required Skills & Experience:
• 5–8 years of experience in Power BI development and data modeling.
• Strong knowledge of Oracle ERP data structures and reporting integration.
• Hands-on experience with Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW).
• Expertise in ADF (Azure Data Factory) and Azure Fabric Data Lake.
• Proven experience in QlikView-to-Power BI migration projects.
• Strong skills in ETL development, data transformation, and integration.
• Proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M language), and SQL.

We are seeking an experienced ERP Project Manager to lead the final stages of a Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) implementation across our organization. Oversee and actively participate in data migration efforts—ensuring accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data.

Manage change across people, processes, and technology, ensuring user adoption and operational readiness. 
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk logs, and status reports; communicate updates to leadership and stakeholders. 
Ensure training plans and user support structures are in place for a smooth transition at go-live. 
Serve as the point of contact between the business, IT, and the implementation partner.

Proven experience as a Project Manager leading D365 ERP implementations (at least one full lifecycle implementation required). 
Strong knowledge of data migration planning and execution in the context of ERP systems. 
Familiarity with business process mapping, workflow design, and user role configuration within D365. 
Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills. 
Ability to navigate the complexities of change management involving Data, Process, and People. 
Experience working with external vendors or implementation partners. 
Must be local to Southwest Virginia and able to work onsite as needed.

PMP certification or similar project management credentials. 
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, or a similar industry using D365.

This is a unique opportunity to be at the heart of a transformative ERP project with a company committed to leveraging technology to improve operations and empower its people. If you thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy leading projects that deliver real value, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

Senior ERP Finance Consultant (Remote)

A dynamic and well-established software company is seeking a Senior ERP Finance Consultant to support the implementation of its cutting-edge, cloud-native ERP platform across a growing customer base.

With decades of innovation behind them, this client is widely recognised in their sector for developing robust, highly configurable ERP solutions tailored to complex industries. The company has a loyal and expanding customer base of over 2,000 businesses, and is investing heavily in digital transformation across finance, operations, and reporting.

This role offers the opportunity to join a forward-thinking, product-led team delivering solutions that modernise and streamline financial processes for mid-sized to enterprise-level organisations across Ireland and beyond.

About The Role

You will act as a subject matter expert on financial modules within the ERP, leading workshops, configuring software, and supporting end-users from implementation through to post go-live support. You’ll work closely with internal teams including development, support, and project management to ensure seamless delivery for customers across diverse industries.

The role is remote-first within Ireland (both ROI and NI), but will involve occasional travel to customer sites for discovery sessions, training, or go-lives.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique?

Be part of a high-growth product team that has just launched a next-generation ERP platform designed for browser-based, cloud-native deployment. 
Work with a company that balances modern tech with deep sector expertise, ensuring customer success in complex industries such as distribution, wholesale, and construction supply. 
Join a collaborative culture with long-standing leadership, where innovation, flexibility, and people-first values are core. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead financial process discovery workshops and blueprint design sessions with clients. 
Configure and deploy ERP finance modules, covering GL, AP, AR, chart of accounts, reporting, and tax compliance. 
Act as the finance SME across the full implementation lifecycle—from scoping through to post go-live. 
Collaborate with development teams to customise or extend platform functionality based on client needs. 
Deliver user training and prepare documentation to support adoption and operational continuity. 
Support data migration efforts, ensuring integrity of historical financial data during transition. 
Provide post-implementation support, guiding customers through any issues and further system optimisations. 
Contribute to project plans, task estimates, and risk assessments. 

What You’ll Bring

5+ years in ERP finance consulting, implementation, or systems analysis. 
Strong knowledge of core financial processes and accounting principles. 
Previous hands-on ERP configuration experience. 
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills – able to work with stakeholders from finance teams to C-suite. 
Strong analytical and documentation skills. 
Comfortable working remotely, but willing to travel to client sites on an irregular basis

This is a rare chance to join a product-focused ERP provider that genuinely values its people, embraces remote-first ways of working, and invests in long-term customer relationships. If you're passionate about ERP, finance transformation, and delivering value through technology—this could be the role for you.

Must Have

The candidate must have proven experience with Epicor.

Overview

The Business Analyst Developer plays a critical role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions within an organization. This position combines the responsibilities of a business analyst, who identifies and defines business requirements, with those of a developer, who designs and implements software solutions to meet those requirements. The Business Analyst Developer collaborates with various stakeholders to ensure that software applications align with business goals and operational needs.

Responsibilities ~ Essential Job Functions 

Requirements Gathering:**
Collaborate with business units, stakeholders, and end-users to gather, document, and refine business requirements.
Analyze and understand business processes and workflows to identify improvement opportunities.
System Design and Development:**
Design and develop software solutions that address identified business needs and requirements.
Configure the enterprise resource planning system to meet operational needs. If needed, utilize development tools, programming languages, and databases to create custom applications or modify existing systems.
Data Analysis:**
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data as necessary to support business analytics, reporting, and decision-making processes.
Implement data validation and quality control measures to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Testing and Quality Assurance:**
Develop and execute test plans to validate software solutions against business requirements.
Debug and resolve software defects and issues to ensure optimal performance.
Documentation:**
Create comprehensive documentation, including functional specifications, technical specifications, and user manuals.
Maintain accurate records of system changes and updates.
Technical Support:**
Provide technical support to end-users, troubleshooting issues and resolving problems in a timely manner.
Collaborate with IT teams to ensure system availability and reliability.
Collaboration and Communication:**
Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and the development team, facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
Present findings, progress, and proposed solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
Continuous Improvement:**
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to propose innovative solutions and process improvements.
Suggest enhancements and modifications to existing systems to optimize business operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business.

Proven experience in business analysis, software development, or a related role.

Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, SQL) and development tools.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).

Familiarity with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL).

Understanding of data modeling and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Proven experience with Epicor

Project management skills are a plus.

Relevant certifications (e.g., CBAP, PMI-PBA, ScrumMaster) are a plus.

Conclusion

The Business Analyst Developer plays a crucial role in aligning technology solutions with business objectives, ensuring that software applications meet the needs of the organization. Pay Range

Pay Range Details

Actual compensation will depend on factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal equity, business needs, and local market conditions. Extensive JD Edwards ERP expertise with a proven track record in implementations, upgrades, and optimisation.
Strong ERP programme/project management experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams and mentor consultants.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Competencies

Leadership – Inspire, motivate, and lead by example.
Technical Depth – Expert understanding of JD Edwards ERP.
Innovation – Leverage AI and modern practices to transform delivery.
Problem-Solving – Tackle challenges with creativity and pragmatism.
Collaboration – Work seamlessly with customers, partners, and internal teams.
Commercial Awareness – Understand the bigger business picture and contribute to growth.

Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance and leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development review

Kearney & Company is seeking a highly skilled DOD SAP ERP Consultant to join our team supporting one of the Federal government’s largest agencies!

Duties include but are not limited to:

Investigating and analyzing unmatched transaction errors within the SAP ERP system, pinpointing root causes and identifying corrective actions
Working closely with cross-functional teams, including finance, procurement, and IT, to understand transaction workflows and error origins
Demonstrating excellent writing and communication skills as significant time is spent drafting/updating communication artifacts (e.g., Standard Operating Procedures, Desktop Guides, white papers)
Documenting error resolution steps and outcomes to support knowledge sharing and process improvement
Developing and maintaining user guides, FAQs, and other resources to aid in understanding and addressing unmatched transaction issues
Providing training and support to end-users on SAP ERP transaction processing and error resolution techniques
Demonstrating strong customer service skills and the ability to work in occasional high-pressure situations with short deadlines
Directing and reviewing the work of Senior Associates
Communicating status of project-related tasks to Team Lead and client
Travel is estimated to be less than 25%

Qualifications

BA/BS/BBA degree from an accredited college/university
Minimum of 4 years of progressive, relevant experience
Active Interim Secret Clearance (or higher, such as Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI) (requires U.S. citizenship)

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience researching and resolving unmatched transactions within Navy ERP
Experience working with DoD’s Advanced Analytics (Advana) platform
Experience collaborating with the Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS), including familiarity with DFAS processes, procedures, and correction processing
Experience working with DoD collection and disbursing operations
Ability to independently research data reconciling variances
Highly proficient skills in MS Excel
Experience with SQL, Python, and Databricks for data querying and scripting
CPA or eligibility to sit for CPA certification
Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM), Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or other professional certification

KCO1701

The expected salary range for this position is between $80,000 and $140,000. Reports to: Head of Projects

Contract: Fixed Term Contract – 10 months

We are looking for a candidate with a proven track record delivering ERP and/or CRM projects, strong knowledge of project governance, change control, and risk management and experience in business analysis.

Job Description

Lead the Future of JD Edwards at Version 1 

Are you a visionary JD Edwards leader ready to take ownership of a thriving ERP practice?

At Version 1, we’re looking for a JD Edwards Capability Manager to shape strategy, drive delivery excellence, and inspire a high-performing team of consultants.

This is more than a management role — it’s your chance to:

✨ Set the vision for our JDE capability and drive innovation with AI, automation, and modern practices.

✨ Lead from the front – coaching, mentoring, and stepping into projects to ensure delivery success.

✨ Build and grow talent – attract, develop, and retain the very best consultants.

What You Will Do

Build & Lead Talent – Recruit, develop, and retain best-in-class JDE consultants who embody Version 1’s core values.
Drive Delivery Success – Provide proactive governance, risk management, and quality assurance across projects. Personally step in where needed to accelerate delivery and enhance quality.
Optimise Resource Utilisation – Ensure strong chargeability and utilisation across the JDE practice.
Champion Innovation – Embed AI-driven tools, automation, UDOs, Orchestrations, and modern practices into delivery to accelerate cycle times and improve right-first-time outcomes.

Retain Top Talent – Identify and nurture high performers while creating rotation opportunities to broaden experience and maintain delivery velocity.
Support Sales & Growth – Actively contribute to bids, solution design, estimations, PoCs, and proposal reviews.
Lead Thought Leadership – Share expertise through blogs, white papers, and speaking at industry events.
Continuously Improve – Measure and drive improvements in delivery, process, people, and technology.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Extensive JD Edwards ERP expertise with a proven track record in implementations, upgrades, and optimisation.
Strong ERP programme/project management experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams and mentor consultants.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Commercial acumen with experience supporting bids, pre-sales, and estimation.
Certification in JD Edwards EnterpriseOne is a plus.
Willingness to travel as needed and work within Version 1’s hybrid working model.

Key Competencies

Leadership – Inspire, motivate, and lead by example.
Technical Depth – Expert understanding of JD Edwards ERP.
Innovation – Leverage AI and modern practices to transform delivery.
Problem-Solving – Tackle challenges with creativity and pragmatism.
Collaboration – Work seamlessly with customers, partners, and internal teams.
Commercial Awareness – Understand the bigger business picture and contribute to growth.

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance and leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development review

A large training budget for accreditations and educational assistance for courses relevant to your role.

Version 1 Annual Excellence Awards & our ‘Call-Out’ platform where performance is called out and recognised.

Moments that matter & our enhanced maternity & paternity leave policies for life’s journey.

Our active ESG & CSR initiative allows you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion, and belonging schemes.

Quarterly performance-related profit share
Certified Great Place to Work for 10 years in a row
Flexible mix of Remote/Hybrid working options
Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance plus 

This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing Oracle ERP Consultancies in Ireland & the UK.

PLUS, many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

This is hybrid based with occasional travel to your nearest base office.

description:
Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated over 28 years in Technology Services and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver solutions that drive customer success. Version 1 has several strategic technology partners including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems and Snowflake. We’re also an award-winning employer reflecting how employees are at the heart of Version 1.

We’ve been awarded: Innovation Partner of the Year Winner 2023 Oracle EMEA Partner Awards, Global Microsoft Modernising Applications Partner of the Year Award 2023, AWS Collaboration Partner of the Year - EMEA 2023 and Best Workplaces for Women by Great Place To Work in UK and Ireland 2023.

As a consultancy and service provider, Version 1 is a digital-first environment and we do things differently. We’re focused on our core values; using these we’ve seen significant growth across our practices and our Digital, Data and Cloud team is preparing for the next phase of expansion. This creates new opportunities for driven and skilled individuals to join one of the fastest-growing consultancies globally.

UK & Ireland’s premier Oracle, Microsoft & AWS partner 
Market leader in Oracle ERP and Cloud Applications 
Consulting, implementation, and support services 
3300+ strong, €347m/£302m revenue business 
ERP Partner of the Year & 10 years as GPTW to work in Ireland & UK 

Job Description

JD Edwards Capability Manager

Lead the Future of JD Edwards at Version 1 

Are you a visionary JD Edwards leader ready to take ownership of a thriving ERP practice?

At Version 1, we’re looking for a JD Edwards Capability Manager to shape strategy, drive delivery excellence, and inspire a high-performing team of consultants.

This is more than a management role — it’s your chance to:

✨ Set the vision for our JDE capability and drive innovation with AI, automation, and modern practices.

✨ Lead from the front – coaching, mentoring, and stepping into projects to ensure delivery success.

✨ Build and grow talent – attract, develop, and retain the very best consultants.

✨ Influence growth – play a key role in bids, solutions, and thought leadership across the market.

✨ Make an impact – at one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, trusted by global brands.

What You Will Do

As JD Edwards Capability Manager, you will:

Build & Lead Talent – Recruit, develop, and retain best-in-class JDE consultants who embody Version 1’s core values.
Drive Delivery Success – Provide proactive governance, risk management, and quality assurance across projects. Personally step in where needed to accelerate delivery and enhance quality.
Optimise Resource Utilisation – Ensure strong chargeability and utilisation across the JDE practice.
Champion Innovation – Embed AI-driven tools, automation, UDOs, Orchestrations, and modern practices into delivery to accelerate cycle times and improve right-first-time outcomes.
Develop People – Build a motivated, inclusive, and engaged team, driving upskilling, certifications, and career progression.
Retain Top Talent – Identify and nurture high performers while creating rotation opportunities to broaden experience and maintain delivery velocity.
Support Sales & Growth – Actively contribute to bids, solution design, estimations, PoCs, and proposal reviews.
Lead Thought Leadership – Share expertise through blogs, white papers, and speaking at industry events.
Continuously Improve – Measure and drive improvements in delivery, process, people, and technology.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Extensive JD Edwards ERP expertise with a proven track record in implementations, upgrades, and optimisation.
Strong ERP programme/project management experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams and mentor consultants.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Commercial acumen with experience supporting bids, pre-sales, and estimation.
Certification in JD Edwards EnterpriseOne is a plus.
Willingness to travel as needed and work within Version 1’s hybrid working model.

Key Competencies

Leadership – Inspire, motivate, and lead by example.
Technical Depth – Expert understanding of JD Edwards ERP.
Innovation – Leverage AI and modern practices to transform delivery.
Problem-Solving – Tackle challenges with creativity and pragmatism.
Collaboration – Work seamlessly with customers, partners, and internal teams.
Commercial Awareness – Understand the bigger business picture and contribute to growth.

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance and leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development review

A large training budget for accreditations and educational assistance for courses relevant to your role.

Version 1 Annual Excellence Awards & our ‘Call-Out’ platform where performance is called out and recognised.

Moments that matter & our enhanced maternity & paternity leave policies for life’s journey.

Our active ESG & CSR initiative allows you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion, and belonging schemes.

Quarterly performance-related profit share
Certified Great Place to Work for 10 years in a row
Flexible mix of Remote/Hybrid working options
Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance plus 

This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing Oracle ERP Consultancies in Ireland & the UK.

PLUS, many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

This is hybrid based with occasional travel to your nearest base office.

Ashley Billington, Head of Talent Acquisition – Enterprise Applications (Oracle Cloud - ERP, HCM, EPM)

+447840839370

We are an equal opportunities employer. Please refer to our Diversity & Inclusion statement located at: Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging | Version 1 Careers

Please note: We have an internal recruitment team and do not accept agency candidates. If you want to join the team here at Version 1, get in touch with us directly!

Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated over 28 years in Technology Services and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver solutions that drive customer success. Version 1 has several strategic technology partners including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems and Snowflake. We’re also an award-winning employer reflecting how employees are at the heart of Version 1.

We’ve been awarded: Innovation Partner of the Year Winner 2023 Oracle EMEA Partner Awards, Global Microsoft Modernising Applications Partner of the Year Award 2023, AWS Collaboration Partner of the Year - EMEA 2023 and Best Workplaces for Women by Great Place To Work in UK and Ireland 2023.

As a consultancy and service provider, Version 1 is a digital-first environment and we do things differently. We’re focused on our core values; using these we’ve seen significant growth across our practices and our Digital, Data and Cloud team is preparing for the next phase of expansion. This creates new opportunities for driven and skilled individuals to join one of the fastest-growing consultancies globally.

UK & Ireland’s premier Oracle, Microsoft & AWS partner 
Market leader in Oracle ERP and Cloud Applications 
Consulting, implementation, and support services 
3300+ strong, €347m/£302m revenue business 
ERP Partner of the Year & 10 years as GPTW to work in Ireland & UK 

Job Description

JD Edwards Capability Manager

Lead the Future of JD Edwards at Version 1 

Are you a visionary JD Edwards leader ready to take ownership of a thriving ERP practice?

At Version 1, we’re looking for a JD Edwards Capability Manager to shape strategy, drive delivery excellence, and inspire a high-performing team of consultants.

This is more than a management role — it’s your chance to:

✨ Set the vision for our JDE capability and drive innovation with AI, automation, and modern practices.

✨ Lead from the front – coaching, mentoring, and stepping into projects to ensure delivery success.

✨ Build and grow talent – attract, develop, and retain the very best consultants.

✨ Influence growth – play a key role in bids, solutions, and thought leadership across the market.

✨ Make an impact – at one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, trusted by global brands.

What You Will Do

As JD Edwards Capability Manager, you will:

Build & Lead Talent – Recruit, develop, and retain best-in-class JDE consultants who embody Version 1’s core values.
Drive Delivery Success – Provide proactive governance, risk management, and quality assurance across projects. Personally step in where needed to accelerate delivery and enhance quality.
Optimise Resource Utilisation – Ensure strong chargeability and utilisation across the JDE practice.
Champion Innovation – Embed AI-driven tools, automation, UDOs, Orchestrations, and modern practices into delivery to accelerate cycle times and improve right-first-time outcomes.
Develop People – Build a motivated, inclusive, and engaged team, driving upskilling, certifications, and career progression.
Retain Top Talent – Identify and nurture high performers while creating rotation opportunities to broaden experience and maintain delivery velocity.
Support Sales & Growth – Actively contribute to bids, solution design, estimations, PoCs, and proposal reviews.
Lead Thought Leadership – Share expertise through blogs, white papers, and speaking at industry events.
Continuously Improve – Measure and drive improvements in delivery, process, people, and technology.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Extensive JD Edwards ERP expertise with a proven track record in implementations, upgrades, and optimisation.
Strong ERP programme/project management experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams and mentor consultants.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Commercial acumen with experience supporting bids, pre-sales, and estimation.
Certification in JD Edwards EnterpriseOne is a plus.
Willingness to travel as needed and work within Version 1’s hybrid working model.

Key Competencies

Leadership – Inspire, motivate, and lead by example.
Technical Depth – Expert understanding of JD Edwards ERP.
Innovation – Leverage AI and modern practices to transform delivery.
Problem-Solving – Tackle challenges with creativity and pragmatism.
Collaboration – Work seamlessly with customers, partners, and internal teams.
Commercial Awareness – Understand the bigger business picture and contribute to growth.

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance and leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development review

A large training budget for accreditations and educational assistance for courses relevant to your role.

Version 1 Annual Excellence Awards & our ‘Call-Out’ platform where performance is called out and recognised.

Moments that matter & our enhanced maternity & paternity leave policies for life’s journey.

Our active ESG & CSR initiative allows you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion, and belonging schemes.

Quarterly performance-related profit share
Certified Great Place to Work for 10 years in a row
Flexible mix of Remote/Hybrid working options
Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance plus 

This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing Oracle ERP Consultancies in Ireland & the UK.

PLUS, many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

This is hybrid based with occasional travel to your nearest base office.

Ashley Billington, Head of Talent Acquisition – Enterprise Applications (Oracle Cloud - ERP, HCM, EPM)

+447840839370

We are an equal opportunities employer. Please refer to our Diversity & Inclusion statement located at: Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging | Version 1 Careers

Please note: We have an internal recruitment team and do not accept agency candidates. If you want to join the team here at Version 1, get in touch with us directly!

description:

Indgå i dialog med kundens forretning og sikre kobling mellem behov og teknisk løsning
Planlægge ressourcer, budgetter og tidsplaner samt følge op på risici og afvigelser
Afholde løbende statusmøder og styregruppemøder
Deltage aktivt i videreudviklingen af vores projektmetoder og PMO-praksis

Mindst 3–5 års erfaring som projektleder med ansvar for mellemstore til store IT-projekter
Erfaring med projekter på tværs af forretningsenheder og komplekse kundemiljøer
Erfaring med ERP-løsninger – gerne med kendskab til Microsoft Business Central (ikke et krav)
Kendskab til klassiske og gerne agile projektmetoder (PRINCE2, PIM, Scrum, eller tilsvarende)
Skarpe kommunikationsevner og evne til at lede uden formelt personaleansvar
Du arbejder struktureret, løsningsorienteret og trives i et miljø med høj kompleksitet

Vi tilbyder

En central rolle i en spændende Business Unit med fokus på Business Central, Fashion, Produktion, Retail og den offentlige sektor
Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dedikerede projektlederkolleger i et professionelt PMO
Varierede og komplekse projekter i tæt samarbejde med kunder og interne specialister
Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling og certificering
Fleksible arbejdsforhold og en åben kultur med plads til både faglighed og humor
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår, der matcher dine kvalifikationer

Our ERP & Platforms practice design and implement transformational and innovative solutions for some of the worlds' largest organisations. Joining our team means that you'll share a passion for strategy, architecture and the latest SAP technology. We are looking for experienced consulting account anchors, responsible for sales and delivery of Oracle ERP programmes at key clients, with proven experience and capability in some of these areas:
Shaping and selling Oracle ERP solutions by engaging with senior stakeholders to help solve their business challenges in the relevant market segment.
Overseeing delivery of Oracle ERP solutions, in a programme and/or workstream management capacity on large-scale transformation programmes.
Identifying new and expansion business opportunities on these programmes to help ensure Infosys Consulting is positioned to provide additional high-quality services
Managing proactive Oracle proposal development, focusing on the Infosys Consulting value proposition, key differentiators, and win themes.
Assuming the role of trusted advisor to clients providing guidance in matters relating to Oracle Applications within relevant industries.
Operating successfully within a service and/or consulting organisation, mentoring, and guiding teams of consultants in direct, indirect, and matrixed structures.
Coordinating relationship building activities across teams on each client engagement to help ensure they are well advised on important matters.
Taking accountability for consulting revenues and operating margins at the key account(s) for which the individual is responsible.
Providing stewardship to subordinate managers, taking an active role in guiding their professional growth, through coaching, mentoring and performance development 


Requirements


The following requirements are important for the role, and we would expect candidates to demonstrate capability across many of these areas:
Strong commercial acumen, sales capability, and negotiation skills.
Extensive programme and delivery management skills.
Well established networks, relationships and involvement in the Oracle ecosystem.
Ability to work at a senior level within complex organisations, able to build empathy, credibility, and trust with key customers.
Proven track record of achievement in selling and delivering consulting and technology services, whilst delivering business objectives within large corporate environments.
Recognised expertise in Oracle Applications, able to demonstrate the ability to align the functional area with the business requirements to support the company vision.
Strong presentation skills, experienced and comfortable presenting to large groups and delivering inspiring and engaging presentations.
Collaborative team player, with a willingness to lead by example and roll up their sleeves.
Proven ability to inspire direct and indirect internal teams, as well as clients, to push the boundaries of what they thought was possible.
Passionate about disruptive innovation and transformational ideas.
Mature interpersonal and influencing skills, especially at senior client levels.
Ability to travel as/when required.


Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our careers page.

Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.
We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal ambitions. Curious to learn more? We'd love to hear from you.... Apply today!

About us
Do you want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? The Team
Our ERP & Platforms practice design and implement transformational and innovative solutions for some of the worlds' largest organisations. Joining our team means that you'll share a passion for strategy, architecture and the latest SAP technology. You'll have exposure to strategic projects, you'll be part of a multi-cultural collaborative team, and your great work will be noticed. The Role 
SAP Consultant FI/CO
Managing full life cycle implementations of S/4 HANA in the area of SAP Finance and/or Controlling
Evaluation of business requirements, identification of relevant SAP capabilities and best practices
Planning, preparation and execution of Fit-Gap / Fit-to-Standard Workshops
Solution Design & Adoption for identified GAPs and business process improvement measures
Ensuring system implementation together with near-/offshore team members
Sparring partner for the client and project management responsibilities

Have at least 8-10 years of experience in this area.
At least 3-5 Full Project Lifecycles of work experience in the area of SAP FI/CO /FSCM; 
Profound Finance and Controlling process experience combined with the ability to translate business requirements into system design specifications
S/4HANA project experience and/or certification
Preferably experienced in international template rollout projects
Higher education degree in Economics, Information Technology or equivalent
Have experience in gathering, validating, synthesizing, documenting, and communicating data and information for a range of audiences
Have a broad business skill set including stakeholder management, problem-solving, and resilience
Have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and verbal communication skills.
Project-related mobility/willingness to travel

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

About Infosys Consulting
Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.
Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our careers page.

Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.
We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal ambitions. Curious to learn more? We'd love to hear from you.... Apply today!

description:
Building the people that build the world. 
With platforms in HVAC and Detection and Measurement, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world.

TAMCO is an innovative manufacturer of high-end, superior quality dampers and air control products that serve commercial, industrial, and institutional markets. With its high attention to detail for products that are durable, maintenance free, energy efficient, and unparalleled in performance, companies rely on TAMCO to provide comfort and mission critical and industrial cooling solutions.

How You Will Make An Impact (Job Summary)
SPX is a diverse team of unique individuals who all make an impact. As an ERP Application Analyst, you will be responsible for solving business problems by adapting ERP, product configurator, and other business software to fit the needs of the business. You will be part of a team working directly with end users, management, and independent sales representatives on resolution of business concerns and plant related needs. The successful Analyst possesses a strong technical background within IT and expertise in the support of end users with both application and technical issues.

What You Can Expect In This Role (Job Responsibilities)
While each day brings new opportunities at SPX, your core responsibilities will be:

ERP and Business systems
Support business processes including product and job costing, accounting, order entry, MRP, shipping, purchasing, product structures and routing, and inventory management
Provide business and shop-floor solutions, working with end users
Adapt ERP systems to meet business requirements
Collaborate with management and independent sales representatives on needs and special projects
Participate in IT requirements determination and solution selection
Documentation of process flows and application updates

Custom Application Development
Work with contract programmers to solve business requirements in custom applications
Programming experience beneficial, but not required, including: Delphi, ABAP, C#, VB, General Web Development (HTML/CSS/JavaScript)
Factory CNC equipment

Continuous Improvement:
Contribute to the continuous improvement of IT infrastructure and processes by providing feedback and recommending solutions.
Prioritize tasks, coming from multiple areas of the business.
Aid in the development and/or implementation of IT policies, procedures, and best practices.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, actively seeking opportunities for development and knowledge enhancement.
Participate in other projects as assigned that relate to the overall goals of the department and organization.

What we are looking for (Experience, Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education)
We each bring something to the table, and we are looking for someone who has:

Required Experience
At least 5 years’ IT experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment
General database knowledge and data manipulation for purposes of creating executive reports and dashboards (Power BI, SQL Server, InterBase, etc.
ERP Systems, with at least 2 years in production areas; SAP ERP required
Basic working IT knowledge including networking, active directory, printers, etc. that is needed in support of applications.
Preferred Experience, Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Product configurators (CPQ systems), especially in a made-to-order manufacturing environment.
Ability to work with engineering requirements to set up dynamic BOM configurator rules
Server Management / Hypervisor

Education & Certifications
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or another related field preferred
APICS CPIM Certification a plus

Travel & Working Environment
This is an in-person position
Occasional travel, including Canada (less than 25%)

Do you want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready?
The Team
Our ERP & Platforms practice design and implement transformational and innovative solutions for some of the worlds' largest organisations. Joining our team means that you'll share a passion for strategy, architecture and the latest SAP technology. You'll have exposure to strategic projects, you'll be part of a multi-cultural collaborative team, and your great work will be noticed. In this role you'll be able to see your own ideas transform into breakthrough results - this is an opportunity to make a real difference.

SAP Consultant FI/CO
Managing full life cycle implementations of S/4 HANA in the area of SAP Finance and/or Controlling
Evaluation of business requirements, identification of relevant SAP capabilities and best practices
Planning, preparation and execution of Fit-Gap / Fit-to-Standard Workshops
Solution Design & Adoption for identified GAPs and business process improvement measures
Ensuring system implementation together with near-/offshore team members
Sparring partner for the client and project management responsibilities




Requirements


Have at least 8-10 years of experience in this area.
At least 3-5 Full Project Lifecycles of work experience in the area of SAP FI/CO /FSCM; 
Profound Finance and Controlling process experience combined with the ability to translate business requirements into system design specifications
S/4HANA project experience and/or certification
Preferably experienced in international template rollout projects
Higher education degree in Economics, Information Technology or equivalent
Have experience in gathering, validating, synthesizing, documenting, and communicating data and information for a range of audiences
Have a broad business skill set including stakeholder management, problem-solving, and resilience
