Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready?
The Team
Our ERP practice helps some of the largest global firms and most recognizable brands deliver value and business transformation enabled by digital ERP solutions and services. Our ERP services covering strategy, implementation and innovation help clients delivering true value and achieve their transformation agenda.
We help globally renowned clients improve their Finance and Accounting operations by devising strategies and enabling Oracle Cloud capabilities that support enterprise-wide decision-making, improve operational efficiencies, and transform / reposition the role of Finance within the enterprise. You'll have exposure to strategic projects, you'll be part of a multi-cultural collaborative team, and you'll be able to see your own ideas transform into breakthrough results.
The Role
We are looking for consulting account anchors, responsible for sales and delivery of Oracle ERP programmes at key clients, with proven experience and capability in some of these areas:
Shaping and selling Oracle ERP solutions by engaging with senior stakeholders to help solve their business challenges in the relevant market segment.
Overseeing delivery of Oracle ERP solutions, in a programme and/or workstream management capacity on large-scale transformation programmes.
Identifying new and expansion business opportunities on these programmes to help ensure Infosys Consulting is positioned to provide additional high-quality service
Managing proactive proposal development, focusing on the Infosys Consulting value proposition, key differentiators, and win themes.
Assuming the role of trusted advisor to clients providing guidance in matters relating to Oracle Applications within relevant industries.
Being responsible for consistent delivery of services, solutions & products on time and within cost and for developing processes that ensure business risks are evaluated, understood, and factored into client solutions and services.
Operating successfully within a service and/or consulting organization, mentoring, and guiding teams of consultants in direct, indirect, and matrixed structures.
Coordinating relationship building activities across teams on each client engagement to help ensure they are well advised on important matters.
Taking accountability for consulting revenues and operating margins at the key account(s) for which the individual is responsible.
Providing stewardship to subordinate managers, taking an active role in guiding their professional growth and development, through coaching, counselling, performance development and mentoring.


Requirements

The following requirements are important for the role, and we would expect candidates to demonstrate capability across many of these areas:
Strong commercial acumen, sales capability, and negotiation skills.
Extensive programme and delivery management skills.
Well established networks, relationships and involvement in relevant activities, industry conferences, forums, thought leadership articles etc.
Ability to work at a senior level within complex organisations, able to build empathy, credibility, and trust with key customers.
Proven track record of achievement in selling and delivering consulting and technology services, whilst delivering business objectives within large corporate environments.
Ability to operate and excel in a changing and dynamic environment.
Recognised expertise in Oracle Applications, able to demonstrate the ability to align the functional area with the business requirements to support the company vision.
Strong presentation skills, experienced and comfortable presenting to large groups and delivering inspiring and engaging presentations.
Intuitive ability to represent complex concepts in a clear, concise, and compelling way.
Collaborative team player, with a willingness to lead by example and roll up their sleeves.
Inspiring leadership style with a proven ability to inspire direct and indirect internal teams, as well as clients to push the boundaries of what they thought was possible.
Passionate about disruptive innovation and transformational ideas.
Mature interpersonal and influencing skills, especially at senior client levels.
Committed to advancing the Infosys brand through personal and professional growth.
An internal talent champion across all sectors; not only directly involved in recruitment, but also in developing the sector-specific skills relative to Infosys' current service offerings.
Ability to travel as/when required.


Benefits

Why Join Us?
Infosys Consulting strives to empower their employees from all backgrounds to thrive, to grow in their careers, and to make a real, visible impact within the organization and beyond. You will become an integral part of a diverse and creative team within a genuinely innovative practice. You'll discover an inclusive and collaborative culture, working alongside highly motivated colleagues within a learning focused work environment. By joining Infosys Consulting you'll play a critical role in our successful growth story - we're looking forward to taking this journey with you.

description:
Are you an ambitious student looking to gain hands-on experience in the IT field while contributing to real-world projects? We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Working Student to join our ERP System team. In this role, you will support various aspects of service management and gain valuable insights into IT.

What you will do

Service Management Support: Assist in managing and coordinating IT service processes, ensuring smooth operations and effective incident resolution.
Incident and Requirement Analysis: Analyze incidents and requirements to support decision-making and issue resolution.
Bug Fix Management: Monitor and manage the progress of Bug Fix RFCs (Request for Changes) to ensure timely and efficient resolutions.
Focus Incident Coordination: Support the coordination and communication of focus incidents, ensuring relevant stakeholders are informed and involved.

What you bring

Field of Study: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program, preferably in Information Technology or a related field.
Language Skills: Proficiency in English
Experience: Prior experience or internships in IT Service Management is highly desirable.
Skills: Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Who You Will Work With

Internal Stakeholders: Collaborate with Customer Service departments, European Distribution/Manufacturing centers, and IT quality and project management teams.
External Stakeholders: Engage with external partners, including Infor IMS, and coordinate with IT colleagues globally and across the EMEA region.

If you are passionate about IT and eager to grow your skills in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

Join us and take the first step towards a promising career in IT!

What we offer

We are driven by innovation and development so working with us is a constant learning curve. You will be located in our site in Erlangen/Stuttgart/Löhne, Germany with dynamic and progressive colleagues, who are highly skilled and empathetic.

Flexible working hours (15 hours/week)
Attractive salary package
Early Talent Community
Modern workspaces and international working environment
Corporate and Company Benefits
Flexible adaptation of your working hours to your studies, e.g. full-time during the semester holidays
Good public transport connections and free parking spaces
Subsidised canteen

What You Should Know About Us

As part of the medical system-relevant industry, we are crisis-proof and sustainably positioned in the German and international market.
Our corporate DNA is characterized by high-tech, agility and continuous forward thinking.
Our products are benchmarks for customers and competitors. In technology, product introduction, value creation, adaptability - trendsetters!
An established network of distribution structures, owner-managed retail chains and buying groups are a guarantee for our success

What you can expect

Individual and intensive training and coaching measures
An attractive compensation package
Modern IT equipment
Exciting customers, self-determined work, absolutely open communication

Who we are

Our products - help millions of people regain their hearing and quality of life. This is what drives us every day!

Our social responsibility - sustainability is not just an idea for us, it is part of our business purpose. Together with you, we can continue to make the world a better place!

Creative freedom - your ideas are welcome and you can try out new solutions.

Individual responsibility - you can actively shape, decide and, most importantly, move things forward with us.

Personal development - trying, learning and reflecting are part of our DNA.

Internationality - as a global player, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues in different parts of the world.

At WS Audiology, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world. With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful?

We can't wait to hear from you!

Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

description_final: ¿Eres un estudiante ambicioso que busca obtener experiencia práctica en el campo de TI mientras contribuyes a proyectos del mundo real? Estamos buscando un estudiante de trabajo motivado y orientado a los detalles para unirse a nuestro equipo del sistema ERP. En este rol, apoyará varios aspectos de la gestión de servicios y obtendrá información valiosa sobre ello. Lo que hará soporte de gestión de servicios: ayudar a administrar y coordinar los procesos de servicio de TI, garantizar operaciones sin problemas y una resolución de incidentes efectiva. Análisis de incidentes y requisitos: analizar incidentes y requisitos para apoyar la toma de decisiones y la resolución de emisión. Gestión de corrigiones de errores: monitoree y administre el progreso de RFC de corrección de errores (solicitud de cambios) para garantizar resoluciones oportunas y eficientes. Coordinación de incidentes de enfoque: apoya la coordinación y la comunicación de los incidentes de enfoque, asegurando que las partes interesadas relevantes estén informadas e involucradas. Lo que trae un campo de estudio: actualmente inscrito en un programa de licenciatura o maestría, preferiblemente en tecnología de la información o un campo relacionado. Habilidades lingüísticas: Competencia en la experiencia en inglés: experiencia previa o pasantías en la gestión de servicios de TI es altamente deseable. description:
Who We Are

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled ERP Architect to work alongside our current ERP staff and help guide systems integrations and optimization of existing processes in Infor Syteline ERP. This individual will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-wide integrations that enable seamless data flow between Syteline and other core business systems (CRM, CPQ, BI tools, etc.). Administer, configure, and maintain the ERP system to ensure optimal performance.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements for system enhancements and customizations and maintain a roadmap of future ERP system projects.
Implement and test ERP system updates, patches, and new modules.
Ensure data integrity and security within the ERP system.
Analyze existing business processes and workflows to identify areas for improvement.
Contribute as a key member of various continuous improvement, business process improvement, and new business integration/ERP implementation projects.
Recommend and implement process enhancements to maximize efficiency and productivity.
Work closely with end-users to understand their needs and translate them into ERP system solutions.
Provide technical support to end-users, troubleshooting issues, and resolving system-related problems.
Develop and deliver training programs and materials to educate employees on ERP system usage and best practices.
Manage the planning, evaluation, design, development and implementation of information systems and programs.
Evaluate, recommend, and assist with software solutions to integrate with existing software.
Engage with outside service providers, software providers, and programming consultants.
Assist in the administration and documentation of all IT processes.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on experience with Infor Syteline ERP (Cloud or On-Premise).
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, business processes, and manufacturing/distribution workflows.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficient in integration technologies such as REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, SQL, and middleware platforms.
5+ years of experience in ERP architecture, with a strong emphasis on integrations in a manufacturing environment. 
Experience integrating ERP with CRM (HubSpot), CPQ (Xait), BI platfor ms (e.g., Power BI, Data Rails), and other finance tools. 
Experience developing business reports with Mongoose Reporting, Data Views and Crystal reports.

Closing Date: August 30th, 2025. While we anticipate keeping this position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed earlier depending on applicant volume and hiring needs.

Compensation: The expected base compensation range is $119,000-$150,000. This role is also eligible to receive bonuses and benefits.

Location: This role is located on-site in Longmont, CO and may be eligible for hybrid work after training period.

We offer an exciting and competitive total compensation package designed to inspire! This includes generous paid time off, holidays, as well as comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-term disability, life insurance, and an outstanding 401k matching program where employees are instantly vested.

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: “Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”. Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every requirement listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

description:
Overview

This role is responsible for the configuration, provisioning, security, and maintenance of Oracle Cloud environments across all modules (FIN, SCM, HCM). The individual will ensure secure, efficient, and compliant Oracle Cloud operations through the implementation of best practices in environment management and security controls.

Essential Duties And Job Functions

Plan, coordinate, and manage the provisioning, maintenance, and refresh of Oracle Cloud environments across all project phases (e.g., development, testing, production). 
Define and implement an environment usage plan that aligns with the overall project timeline and Oracle implementation methodology. 
Coordinate with Oracle Cloud Operations and Customer Success Managers for environment updates, patches, and clone activities. 
Track configuration progress and data setup milestones to ensure environments are ready for RICEW development and testing. 
Oversee integration activities during cutover and go-live, ensuring a stable and secure production landscape. 
Administer user access, role provisioning, and segregation of duties across Oracle Cloud applications (FIN, SCM, HCM). 
Establish and enforce security controls, including audit trails, role-based access controls (RBAC), and least privilege models. 
Continuously monitor application and environment security for vulnerabilities and compliance with organizational policies. 
Support internal and external audits by managing access logs, control documentation, and remediation follow-ups. 
Manage and maintain folder structures and access controls for reporting tools such as FDI, OTBI, and BI Publisher. 
Ensure appropriate security configuration for reporting layers, including role-based data access and segregation by business unit or legal entity. 
Provision and maintain secure access for integration users, including SFTP, SSH keys, and service accounts. 
Configure and troubleshoot Oracle PaaS/SaaS technical components related to security, integrations, and environment performance. 
Collaborate with IT, functional leads, and external partners to align environment and security practices with business needs. 
Stay current with Oracle Cloud security updates, new features, and best practices to enhance protection and compliance posture. 

Qualifications

4+ years of combined experience in ERP environment and security administration (preferably in Oracle). 
BS/BA degree in IT or related field, or equivalent work experience. 
Hands-on experience in ERP cloud architecture (Oracle preferred). 
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC). 
Demonstrated capability to assess complex system and data security needs. 
Experience in environment lifecycle management, cloud provisioning, and data protection. 
Certifications in cloud architecture or Oracle Security preferred. 

Skills And Attributes

Proficiency in Oracle PaaS & SaaS security and environment configuration. Oracle Fusion Certifications preferred.
Effective communicator with both technical teams and business stakeholders. 
Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills. 
Independent and proactive with a high level of accountability. 
Detail-oriented with a bias toward execution and continuous improvement. 
High personal integrity consistent with corporate values.

Plus de 1 000 collaborateurs répartis sur 30 sites en Suisse et en Europe : le groupe CSD est une entreprise dynamique et en constante croissance. Grâce à l’ingéniosité, la compétence et la pluridisciplinarité qui caractérisent nos équipes, CSD offre des solutions innovantes et durables pour nos clients avec un « plus » pour la qualité de vie et l’environnement.

Nous recherchons pour notre Service Digitalisation à Givisiez (FR), un Gestionnaire ERP (f/h/d) à 80-100%

Vos tâches

En collaboration avec le Responsable ERP et les utilisateurs clés, vous participez activement au bon fonctionnement et à l'optimisation de nos systèmes ERP ainsi qu'à la transformation digitale du Groupe CSD.

Administration technique : Vous prenez part à la gestion et à l'administration des solutions Microsoft Dynamics 365 et des systèmes connexes, garantissant leur bon fonctionnement et leur évolution continue
Support N2 : Vous interviendrez sur les incidents complexes liés au système ERP et fournirez un support fonctionnel avancé aux utilisateurs finaux, assurant ainsi une résolution rapide et efficace des problèmes
Testing : Vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans les tests de non-régression lors des montées de version, en vous assurant que les aspects techniques et fonctionnels sont conformes aux attentes, et en testant les correctifs ou les packages évolutifs
Documentation et suivi : Vous rédigerez et maintiendrez à jour la documentation technique, tout en participant au suivi et au respect des budgets, garantissant ainsi une gestion rigoureuse et transparente des ressources
Projets : Vous prenez part à des projets d'évolution, d'amélioration et d'optimisation des fonctionnalités du système, ainsi qu'à des projets d'intégration (M&A), contribuant ainsi à l'innovation et à la croissance de notre entreprise

Votre profil

Diplôme supérieur en informatique de gestion (ES, HES, Uni) ou formation jugée équivalente
Minimum 2 ans d'expérience en gestion de systèmes ERP et plus particulièrement sur Dynamics 365 (F&O et CE)
Expertise concrète des tâches et processus fonctionnels dans les domaines RH, Finances et Marketing 
Expérience dans la gestion et suivi de projet
Expérience idéale dans une société de services
De langue maternelle française avec de bonnes connaissances en anglais. La maitrise de l’allemand (niveau B2) serait un atout

Connaissances 

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Power Plateform, Microsoft Azure, Regression suite automation tool (RSAT)
Capacités rédactionnelles pour la création de documentations techniques et fonctionnelles
Capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques et à collaborer avec les équipes métiers pour répondre à leurs besoins
Connaissances techniques et fonctionnelles des systèmes Abacus et SharePoint Online ainsi que des API REST seraient un plus.

Les offres d’agences de placement ne sont pas prises en considération dans le cadre de ce recrutement. Dès lors, CSD n’entrera d’aucune manière en négociation pour le versement d’une quelconque prétention.

CSD INGÉNIEURS SA, entreprise fondée en 1970, fournit des prestations de conseil et développe des solutions économiques pour les projets d’ingénierie de ses clients, toujours avec un « plus » pour la qualité de la vie et de l’environnement.

Toujours proche des clients, au niveau national et international

CSD connaît les conditions locales et les besoins des clients grâce à une présence locale. Avec plus de 1000 collaborateurs, le Groupe bénéficie d’un réseau de 30 succursales en Suisse, en Belgique, au Luxembourg, en Allemagne, en Italie et en Lituanie.

Une équipe pluridisciplinaire et performante

Le succès de CSD provient de la disponibilité de spécialistes aux compétences variées. En travaillant ensemble, ils développent des solutions complètes dans les domaines de l’environnement l’eau, l’énergie, la route et le rail, le bâtiment et les gravières et carrières. CSD collabore volontiers en consortium avec des partenaires ou des sous-traitants et accompagne les réalisations de ses clients durant tout leur cycle de vie. CSD gère des projets complexes pour les clients privés, l’industrie ainsi que pour les administrations publiques (fédérales, cantonales et communales).

Créons l’avenir – avec un environnement intact et une bonne qualité de la vie

Une planification anticipée permet de réduire les impacts environnementaux sur les hommes et la nature. Ainsi, CSD conseille par exemple ses clients au sujet des dangers naturels, du bruit, des vibrations, des polluants, des risques et de la sécurité, de la biodiversité ou du réchauffement climatique. Afin d’améliorer la qualité de la vie, CSD prend en compte la lumière, l’acoustique, les rayonnements, la chaleur et l’humidité dans les bâtiments.

Amélioration continue et engagement écologique certifiés, employeur au top

Par ses certifications ISO 9001 et ISO 14001, CSD aspire à l’excellence et l’amélioration continue au niveau économique et écologique. Elle est également certifiée EcoEntreprise depuis 2007. Depuis 2018, CSD possède un certificat attestant de l’égalité de salaires entre hommes et femmes pour un travail de valeur égale.

Do whatever it takes to make customers happy + successfully onboard them as quickly as possible
Continuously improve the post-sales processes to help our customers accelerate the time to value


Qualifications

4+ years’ experience working in one of the following roles: Procurement/Sourcing Manager, ERP/P2P Systems Consultant, or managing key customer and stakeholder relationships in a B2B SaaS company
Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP - Oracle Fusion or SAP Ariba
Fantastic communication skills
Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive
Experience working with product and engineering teams
You’re able to push back and still make people happy
Very comfortable with software configuration (not necessarily technical skills, which would be a plus)
Willing to do whatever it takes to make Zip and its customers happy.


Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

📈 Start-up equity
🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage
🚍 Commuter benefit
🚠 Team building events & happy hours

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

As part of our digital transformation and scale-up journey, we are implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (F&SCM) to integrate and optimize our finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, and project delivery processes.

The ERP Implementation Manager will be responsible for leading, owning, and delivering ReOrbit’s enterprise ERP program, with a strong initial focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM. This role will oversee the successful execution of Phase 2 of our ERP roadmap and ensure the platform evolves to support our accelerated growth. You will work closely with the CFO (Program Sponsor), COO, CTO, and functional leaders across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, HR and Project Delivery.

Lead the strategic direction and execution of ReOrbit’s ERP implementation program.
Serve as the primary owner of Dynamics 365 F&SCM implementation across all modules.
Drive alignment between ERP capabilities and ReOrbit’s business model and scaling needs.

Evaluate partner performance and negotiate future ERP service agreements.

Manage ongoing ERP roadmap, upgrades, and optimization projects.

Develop a key-user network across functions.
Oversee ERP training programs for end-users. 

Governance & Reporting
Establish ERP governance structure, KPIs, and dashboards.

job_title: ERP O&M System Integration (Batch) Engineer / SW Dev Analyst, Staff
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a skilled ERP Batch Job Engineer to join our operations team. This role is responsible for integrating, scheduling, and optimizing ERP batch jobs developed by product teams, ensuring seamless execution of mission-critical business cycles. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of ERP functional flows and the technical expertise to integrate and monitor jobs across multiple teams and systems.

This position requires on-call availability to address production issues and ensure uninterrupted operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Batch Job Integration & Management: Integrate, schedule, and manage batch jobs developed by product and application teams to support critical processes such as MRP runs, month-end financial closure, quarterly close, and year-end activities.

Functional Job Flow Creation & Maintenance:

Develop, document, and maintain functional job flow maps for critical weekend, monthly, quarterly, and yearly ERP processes.
Ensure these flows are kept up to date with system changes, business process updates, and new integrations.

Functional Flow Understanding: Collaborate with functional and product teams to map end-to-end ERP process flows, ensuring integrated jobs align with operational requirements.

Dependency & Sequencing Management: Maintain job dependencies and sequencing across ERP modules and interfacing systems for smooth execution.

Collaboration with Technical Foundation & Integration Teams:

Partner with technical foundation teams to configure, set up, and operate batch job environments.
Work closely with integration teams to ensure cross-system data flows and interfaces are aligned with job execution schedules.

Alert System Operations:

Operate and enhance an automated alerting system for job failures, delays, and anomalies.
Leverage AI-based monitoring tools to improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and enable predictive issue prevention.

Operational Excellence:

Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in production batch job runs.
Identify opportunities to streamline operations through automation and process optimization.

On-Call Support: Provide timely resolution of issues during on-call rotations, minimizing business disruption.

Collaboration: Partner with release management, product development teams, technical foundation, and infrastructure groups to coordinate updates, integrations, and system changes impacting batch operations.

Documentation: Maintain comprehensive records of job configurations, workflows, alert mechanisms, recovery procedures, and functional job flow maps.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience.

Proven experience in ERP environments (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) with a strong grasp of core functional flows (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing).

Hands-on experience with batch job scheduling/orchestration tools (e.g., Control-M, Redwood, Autosys, SAP SM37/SM36).

Knowledge of general integration points between ERP modules and external systems.

Understanding of financial closing cycles, MRP, and other critical ERP processes.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly resolve production issues.

Familiarity with automation, scripting, and alert system operations.

Experience with ServiceNow (Service Central) experience: 2+ years of experience with ServiceNow platform, including incident, problem, and change management, as well as experience with ServiceNow modules such as IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

Agile Project Management Tools experience: 2+ years of experience with Atlassian Jira for project planning, tracking, and management, and Zephyr for test management, including creating and managing projects, workflows, and test cases, as well as experience with agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.

Exposure to AI/ML-driven monitoring tools (preferred).

As our new IT Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving the successful planning, execution, and delivery of our ERP implementation and upgrade projects. You will be responsible for coordinating cross-functional teams, managing project timelines and budgets, and ensuring smooth integration of ERP systems.

You will join Terma’s Global IT organization, consisting of approximately 80 employees working across Denmark and internationally. The department is organized into dedicated teams covering infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and ERP solutions, enabling close collaboration with business units across Terma.

Your role will involve working closely with various stakeholders, both internally across global teams and externally with implementation partners. Therefore, it is essential that you have excellent communication skills to effectively translate complex technical requirements into clear and actionable plans.

This position is primarily based at our headquarters in Lystrup, and candidates able to work from this location are preferred.

Lead full lifecycle ERP implementation projects including planning, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and risk management strategies
Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Finance, Operations, HR, Supply Chain, etc.) and external vendors to ensure project requirements are met
Facilitate communication between technical teams, business users, and executive sponsors

Bring your world class expertise into play

Proven experience with ERP systems

Practical experience applying project management methodologies and tools

description:
Du willst erleben, wie moderne Unternehmensprozesse funktionieren? Du magst Effizienz und hast Freude daran, Prozesse zu optimieren? Du hast eine Affinität zu IT? Du arbeitest lieber in einem kleinen Team mit grossen Zielen als in einem Grossunternehmen? Du willst hautnah dabei sein, wenn sich ein Startup entwickelt?
Dann ist dieser Job etwas für dich! Wir implementieren Odoo für unsere Kunden und digitalisieren, vereinfachen und beschleunigen damit ihre Prozesse.

Was dich erwartet
Du lernst, wie Unternehmen funktionieren. Nicht einfach eine Abteilung, sondern die ganze Kiste. Finanzen, Verkauf, HR, Beschaffung, Lager, Produktion, Controllingstrategie – alles ist drin. Du lernst auch, wie Projekte agil und strukturiert geführt werden und wie neue Software entsteht. Wir begleiten und unterstützen dich, übergeben dir aber auch schnell Verantwortung für einzelne Herausforderungen. Das kann jeden Tag eine andere sein, z.B.: Lösungsvarianten entwerfen und vergleichen, Unternehmensprozesse neu designen, Geschäftsfelder integrieren, Logistikflows optimieren, mit Kunden und Entwicklern über neue Features sprechen, Programmierungen konzeptionieren und testen, kleinere Projekte managen.

Wir bieten
Du willst mit Leuten arbeiten, die etwas bewegen wollen im Leben: Wollen wir auch
Langweilig ist nicht so deins: Bei uns siehst du in die unterschiedlichsten Branchen
Du lebst nicht (nur) von Luft und Liebe: Fix 85k + klar definierte Erfolgsbeteiligung
Du willst auch mal was anderes machen: 5 Wochen Ferien
Du bist Sprinter, brauchst aber auch mehr Pausen: Bis zu 10 Wochen Ferien möglich
Zwei Tage Wochenende sind einfach nicht genug: Teilzeit möglich
Dir gefällt deine Wohnung eigentlich ganz gut: Teilzeit Homeoffice auch
Ein Büro in der Stadt ist trotzdem cool: Zentraler Arbeitsplatz im Toro 1 in Oerlikon inkl. Dusche falls du über den Mittag Sport machen willst
Am Wochenende gratis Zug fahren ist nice: Du bekommst ein Abo für alle Zonen des ZVV

Über dich
Du bist neugierig und lernst schnell, du bist kreativ und trotzdem strukturiert. Du bist kurz vor oder nach deinem Abschluss mit überdurchschnittlichen Noten in einem wirtschaftlichen oder technischen Fach an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule. Wenn du etwas anderes studiert hast, aber stark an der Digitalisierung von Unternehmensprozessen interessiert bist, melde dich auch. Pluspunkte gibt's für: Bis zu drei Jahre Berufserfahrung, Erfahrung im Business Consulting und/oder mit Business Software.

So geht's weiter
Damit du einen informellen Eindruck von uns erhältst, kannst du dich zuerst mit jemandem aus unserem Team bei einem (virtuellen) Kaffee austauschen.
Wenn dir das gefällt, schickst du uns den Rest deiner Unterlagen und wir geben dir innerhalb einer Woche Bescheid. In der zweiten Runde sprechen wir dann per Teams miteinander, damit du und wir herausfinden, ob wir grundsätzlich zusammenpassen.
Falls das so ist, gehen wir in der dritten Runde ein paar Cases zusammen durch. Wenn das auch passt, klären wir noch die vertraglichen Details und schon kann's losgehen!

description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we’ve become the world’s largest D2C sleep brand, available in over 35 countries with more than 25 stores across Europe. Recommended by leading consumer associations in EMEA, APAC, and the Americas, we develop the best sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day.

At Emma, we are a community of smart, driven people, united by a strong culture of collaboration, teamwork, and knowledge sharing. We think big, take ownership, and are empowered to drive meaningful impact. Through hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning, we drive our own growth and learning. With Emmies from over 60 nationalities and offices across multiple regions, our diverse perspectives enrich our workplace culture. Ready to shape the future of sleep with us? Let’s make it happen!

What you'll do:

As the ERP Functional Team Lead, reporting to the ERP Group Product Manager, you will lead a team composed of ERP functional specialists who support design, configuration, and deployment across the Record to Report (RTR), Order to Cash (OTC) and Procure to Pay (P2P) domains. 
Working closely with a dedicated ERP Product Manager, focused on driving the roadmap and prioritization, you’ll focus on ensuring the team executes effectively, grows professionally, and delivers quality outcomes through structured processes and cross-functional collaboration. 
You’ll play a key role in people development, capacity planning, team operations, and delivery consistency. 


Your responsibilities include: 

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of ERP functional analysts across Finance and Supply Chain domains (R2R, O2C, P2P).
Identify skill gaps and provide training, coaching, and professional development opportunities.
Oversee workload distribution, capacity planning, and resource prioritization across the team.
Support the adoption of delivery frameworks (Agile, hybrid) and ensure team participation in delivery ceremonies. 
Act as a liaison between the ERP Product Manager and the functional team, ensuring alignment on scope, acceptance criteria, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
Support team members in collaborating with business users to validate processes and requirements, ensuring consistency, completeness, traceability and adherence to best practices.
Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of business process documentation, configuration inputs, and functional testing support.
Oversee and ensure that configuration decisions are future-proof—designed for scalability, reusability, and ease of maintenance across business units and geographies. 
Help manage escalations and cross-functional dependencies related to ERP configurations and testing.


Who we are Looking for:

5+ years of experience in ERP environments, with at least 2 years leading or managing functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to guide team delivery, manage escalations, and coordinate cross-functional workstreams.
Proven ability to predict capacity needs, strategically allocate resources, and balance assignments for on-time delivery 
Experience working in large ERP environments (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics is a plus).
Strong and practical knowledge of business processes in R2R, O2C, and P2P domains, with the ability to accurately identify gaps or inefficiencies and drive application or process improvements.
Ability to translate complex business issues into clear, actionable deliverables for the team. 
Skilled in BPMN or equivalent process-modeling tools; comfortable creating clear, cross-functional artifacts. 
Skilled in reviewing and validating business process documentation, configuration decisions, and functional test plans.
Effective communicator with the ability to tailor the speech to suit different audiences and effectively conveying key points, facilitating collaboration across business, product, and technical teams.
Professional Business English is a must.
Familiarity with delivery in Agile or hybrid project environments.
Comfortable managing multiple workstreams and coordinating with external implementation partners.


What we offer:

A combination of personal and company growth to accelerate your career and help you reach your goals. 
The chance to work on exciting and challenging projects either independently or as part of a dedicated, international team. 
Responsibility and decision-making authority from day one—you'll create an impact with new, innovative ideas and help shape our company DNA. 
To work and learn from experts in diverse fields and get to know your team members at exciting company events. 


Become an Emmie

Emma is transforming the world of sleep - and we want the highest-performing people to help us pull it off. We want you. But only if you're willing to go all in. Only if you're willing to question, disrupt, innovate, and create from the ground up.

We proudly celebrate diversity. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting inclusion in our workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.

Our aim is to get back to you in a couple of days, however, we are currently receiving a large number of applications and this might lead to a delay in the process. We will get back to you as soon as possible!

Tickets restaurant, prime vacances, 50% transport (abonnement transport public), mutuelle.

Fort de son partenariat GOLD avec l’éditeur Oracle, Talan s’inscrit comme acteur majeur autour des solutions Oracle EBS R12 et/ou ERP Cloud que ce soit en France ou à l’international. Cette position, nos futurs projets et ceux en cours nous amènent à accroître nos effectifs autour de profils variés.

Vous disposez d’une forte expérience autour de l’implémentation de l’ERP EBS R12 et/ou ERP Cloud dans un ou plusieurs domaines de la comptabilité/finance, ainsi que des compétences en gestion d'équipe et en communication.

Devenez les nouveaux Talan managers et rejoignez notre équipe ERP Oracle !

Au sein de l’équipe ERP, vous apporterez votre expertise sur les fonctions suivantes :

Réalisation de missions en lien avec les directions métiers et DSI de nos clients dans le cadre de leurs transformations ;
Encadrement d’une équipe fonctionnelle et la faire évoluer sur un projet ou un ensemble de projets : coordination des activités et tâches de chacun ;
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la conformité des livrables avec les exigences et besoins du client en collaboration avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes ;
Suivi des projets, reporting des éventuels problèmes et proposition de solutions ;
Contribution au développement des compétences des collaborateurs ;
Participation aux actions commerciales et aux dossiers d'avant-vente ;
Développer votre expertise sectorielle appliquée aux ERP Oracle (EBS et Cloud) et la partager au sein de nos communautés ;
Développer l’offre ERP Oracle EBS R12 et/ou ERP Cloud. 

Qualifications

De formation BAC+5 (école de commerce, école d’ingénieur, formation universitaire), vous justifiez d’une solide expérience d’au moins 5 ans acquise sur plusieurs projets d’implémentation de l’ERP Oracle EBS R12 et /ou ERP Cloud, ou sur un poste similaire.

Vous bénéficiez d’une expertise reconnue sur plusieurs domaines suivants, par profil :

Finance : comptabilité générale, comptabilité fournisseurs, comptabilité clients, contrôle de gestion, immobilisations
Supply : Gestion des données techniques, Planification industrielle (PIC, PDP, MRP), Costing, Sourcing et Approvisionnements, Gestion des stocks et d’entrepôts, Gestion des commandes clients en PTO, CTO, ETO, Flux de préparation et d’expédition, Intégration des flux logistiques avec la comptabilité…

Une expérience en tant qu’architecte fonctionnel autour des solutions ERP serait un plus :

Définition des processus métier et des flux pour s'assurer que le système est efficient ;
Préserver la cohérence entre les différentes composantes du système et la compatibilité avec les normes et les réglementations en cours et à venir ;
Vérification des capacités de flexibilité et d’évolution du système. 

Mais également :

De compétences en gestion de projet, planification, suivi de projet… ;
D’excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec l’ensemble des membres de l'équipe et des parties prenantes d’un projet ;
De capacités à gérer et à motiver une équipe ;
D’une ouverture d’esprit portée sur le partage des compétences et des connaissances. 

L’équipe recrutement s’engage à vous proposer un processus de recrutement fluide :

Un premier échange de 30 min en visio avec le recruteur pour vous présenter le poste et comprendre votre projet professionnel.

Un à deux entretien métier dans nos locaux, pour entrer dans les détails du poste et rencontrer votre futur manager.

#TalanFrance

Talan est un groupe international de conseil et d’expertises technologiques qui accélère la transformation de ses clients par les leviers de l'innovation, la technologie et la data.

Depuis plus de 20 ans, Talan conseille et accompagne les entreprises et les institutions publiques dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation et d'innovation en France et à l'international.

Présent dans 20 pays, le Groupe, certifié Great Place To Work, qui compte plus de 7200 collaborateurs, ambitionne de dépasser la barre du milliard d'euros à horizon 2025.

Nous accompagnons les entreprises dans des secteurs variés : énergie, industrie, transport, finance, luxe… à travers 3 grandes expertises :

Le Conseil en Management et Innovation (320 Consultants en France)
La valorisation des données, leurs structurations, et leurs usages (Data et Technologies)
L’intégration de solutions logicielles (Cloud et Applications Services)

Nos valeurs : engagement, respect, partage, esprit d’équipe et optimisme.

Nos avantages :

Télétravail jusqu’à 4 jours selon les missions, prime d’équipement de 100 €
Offre de formation complète sur site et à distance. 
Proximité et convivialité cultivées à tous les niveaux de l’entreprise (Great Place to Work depuis 10 ans, Top 5 des entreprises où il fait bon travailler depuis 5 ans)
Tickets restaurant, prime vacances, 50% transport (abonnement transport public), mutuelle. 

Talan est une entreprise responsable, attachée à la diversité. Des aménagements de poste peuvent être organisés pour tenir compte des personnes en situation de handicap.

Retrouvez nos engagements RSE ici et nos actions en faveur de la diversité ici

Job Description

Pour accompagner sa forte croissance et le développement de ses activités, nous recherchons plusieurs Consultant(e)s Fonctionnel(le)s sur les solutions Oracle EBS R12 et/ou ERP Cloud.

Le périmètre de nos projets actuels et des nouvelles signatures nous amènent

à rechercher tous type de profils :

Consultant expérimentés (jusqu’à 5 années d’expérience sur l’ERP)
Consultants Seniors (plus de 5 années)
Consultants Managers

La dimension Métier des candidats et une bonne capacité d’analyse sont des atouts importants pour accompagner nos clients dans leurs projets de transformation SI.

Au sein du pôle ERP en constante croissance et aujourd'hui composé de plus de 100 consultants, vous interviendrez sur les fonctions suivantes :

Encadrer et/ou réaliser des missions en lien avec les directions metier et DSI de nos clients dans le cadre de leurs transformation. 
Une maîtrise d’un ou des domaines suivants est souhaitée : Finance, Comptabilité et Gestion, Gestion budgétaire, comptabilité publique, maîtrise des chaînes de dépense et recette, gestion d’affaires, planification et gestion de production. 
Une expérience réussie sur les solutions Oracle E-Business Suite R12 et/ou ERP Cloud est attendue. 

Les prestations proposées pour nos nouveaux collaborateurs :

Études de cadrage, définition des plans projet
Prise en compte des besoins fonctionnels / Rédaction de cahiers des charges
Conduite de réunions / d’ateliers de conception
Formalisation et optimisation de processus
Support aux utilisateurs dans les étapes de qualifications
Gestion de la relation client sur les missions
Manager les consultants et vous impliquer dans le développement de leurs compétences

Etre acteur et accompagner l'évolution interne du pôle et des carrières des collaborateurs :

Contribuer aux actions de développement sur de nouvelles opportunités
Participer aux actions commerciales et aux dossiers d'Avant-vente
Développer votre expertise sectorielle appliquée aux ERP Oracle (EBS et Cloud) et la partager au sein de nos communautés
Participer à la préservation et à l’amélioration d’un environnement humain, professionnel et de qualité au sein des équipes. 

Qualifications

De formation BAC+5 (école de commerce, école d’ingénieur, formation universitaire), vous justifiez d’une expérience d'au moins 2 ans sur des projets dans un rôle d’AMOA/MOE, en ayant contribué aux différentes phases de définition et de mise en œuvre des ERP Oracle. 
Une expérience de pilotage de projets est souhaitée notamment pour les candidats avec un profil de Management
Au-delà de votre formation et de votre expertise, nous recherchons de futurs collaborateurs motivés par la perspective d'intégrer une structure à taille humaine en pleine croissance, exigeante et favorisant l’esprit d’équipe. 

L’équipe recrutement s’engage à vous proposer un processus de recrutement fluide :

Un premier échange de 30 min en visio avec le recruteur pour vous présenter le poste et comprendre votre projet professionnel.

Un à deux entretien métier dans nos locaux, pour entrer dans les détails du poste et rencontrer votre futur manager.

#TalanFrance

De connaissances techniques (PL/SQL, XML Publisher / BI Publisher, Shell, Oracle Forms, Oracle Workflow, échanges web services, Talend (ETL et ESB)…) ;

Vi søger en ERP Consultant til Finance IT Services (FITS) og håber, det kunne være dig. Uanset om du har erfaring fra et ERP-hus, som revisor eller fra en privat virksomhed, er det vigtigste, at du har finansiel erfaring og brænder for at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem finans og IT.

Bliv en del af Finance IT Services (FITS)
Hos FITS leverer vi helhedsløsninger inden for digitalisering og automatisering af arbejdsgange i finansafdelingen.

Basico er Microsoft Partner, og vores tilgang til ERP-projekter ligger forankret i vores DNA, hvor projekterne skal udvikle, effektivisere og transformere de finansielle processer. Det betyder i praksis, at vores tilgang er konfiguration og optimering inden for standard, frem for intensiv tilpasning og udvikling. Som ERP Consultant kommer du derfor til at beskæftige dig med de mest interessante aspekter af procesoptimering og systemimplementering, når du samarbejder med vores kunder om at opgradere deres ERP-system og sikre gevinstrealiseringen.

Opgaverne varierer afhængigt af kunderne, men dit primære arbejdsområde bliver i vores ERP-afdeling, hvor hovedprodukterne er foranalyse med fokus på processer og forretningsgange og Business Central-implementering, herunder opsætning, konfiguration og leveranceledelse. Du deltager også i tværfaglige projekter, som spænder fra implementering af nye supportsystemer til procesoptimering og rådgivning inden for Power BI og Power Platform.

Din hverdag som ERP Consultant
Fra din første arbejdsdag arbejder du som konsulent på kundeopgaver. Baseret på kundens behov samt dine erfaringer og kompetencer vil opgaverne typisk indebære:
Support og rådgivning ift. behovsafklaring og kortlægning af nuværende ERP-setup
Identifikation og implementering af forbedringer i finansprocesser
Implementering af systemer til understøttelse af finans, herunder ERP-systemet Microsoft 365 Business Central og værktøjer til optimering af månedsluk, fx Continia

Udvikling af metoder eller modeller, der effektiviserer kundens hverdag eller danner baggrund for strategiske beslutninger
Forståelse og dokumentation af user cases og kravspecifikationer i samarbejde med kunden
Design og udvikling af digitale løsninger til automatisering af processer sammen med dygtige kollegaer ved hjælp af fx Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps og Power Automate
Projektledelse og sikring af succesfulde leverancer fra start til slut.

Du vil opleve, at du skal være både praktisk og strategisk i din tilgang til opgaverne, og det er med til at skabe en spændende og varieret hverdag.

Din baggrund og kvalifikationer – indtil nu:
For at passe godt ind i rollen ser vi gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:
+5 års erfaring enten fra en finansfunktion – fx som revisor, controller, finance business partner eller fra et ERP-hus som ERP-konsulent, udvikler eller projektleder krydret med relevant finanserfaring
Erfaring fra ERP-projekter og kendskab til Business Central og relevante automatiseringsløsninger, fx Continia
Analytisk stærk med interesse for at arbejde med tal, finans og data
Evnen til at skabe relationer og kommunikere med stakeholders på tværs af organisationen
En stærk forretningsforståelse.

Vil du vide mere om hverdagen?
Læs vores cases om projektet hos Vild Nord og Hårklinikken, og få et indblik i, hvordan vi arbejder med ERP-implementeringer, og hvordan du som ERP Consultant kan gøre en forskel for vores kunder hos Basico.

Et solidt Basico-bagland i ryggen
Inden første kundeprojekt får du en grundig introduktion til vores forretning og kultur. Vi lægger stor vægt på at sætte det rette team og matche dine færdigheder og mål med kundens behov. Med en karrierecoach og buddy i ryggen sørger vi for, at du kommer godt i gang og altid har dine kollegaer til sparring og support.

Du deltager løbende i kompetenceudvikling gennem vores interne udviklingsprogram Basico Academy, så du altid er klædt godt på til at rådgive vores kunder.

Bliv en del af et konsulenthus i vækst
Vi er et konsulenthus i vækst og har det seneste år budt velkommen til over 90 nye Basico’ere. I dag er vi mere end 300 fastansatte og selvstændige konsulenter, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe værdi for vores kunder.

Fra vores kontor i Tuborg Havn med udsigt til Øresund dyrker vi en kultur, der kombinerer høj ekspertise, frie rammer og et stærkt fællesskab. Hos os er samarbejde på tværs af afdelinger og niveauer en naturlig del af hverdagen, og det giver dig mulighed for at opbygge et bredt netværk og adgang til ny viden.

Det sociale liv spiller også en vigtig rolle hos Basico. Du vil ofte blive inviteret til sportsaktiviteter, kulturelle arrangementer, gastronomiske oplevelser, firmafester og vores populære fredagsvin. Som en del af Basico bliver du en del af et inspirerende miljø, hvor både faglig og personlig udvikling prioriteres højt.

Er du klar til at tage det næste skridt i din karriere?
Ansøg nu og bliv en del af vores team! Du behøver ikke sende en ansøgning, men tilføj gerne et par linjer om din motivation og erfaringer i dit CV. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte Talent & Acquisition Consultant Nellie Hansen på nhansen@basico.dk for mere information om stillingen og Basico.

*Lead technical pre-sales engagements, demos, and solution design sessions.

*Influence stakeholders across business and technical domains (CxO level).
*Ensure seamless hand-off to deployment teams with clear success metrics and adoption plans.

*Ideally Master's in Computer Science/IT or Bachelor's in Computer Science/IT 
*Relevant experience in technical pre-sales or consulting

description:
Als führende globale Software Company befindet sich Sage in permanentem Wandel. Wir sind agil und blicken nach vorne, Cloud-Technologie und SaaS sind fester Bestandteil unserer Zukunft. Als People Company schätzen wir Vertrauen, Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben und Vielfalt. Bei uns arbeiten 12.000 unterschiedlichste Persönlichkeiten in 23 Ländern - was uns eint ist das gleiche Mindset: kooperieren, uns weiterentwickeln und gemeinsam etwas bewirken. Wenn das mit Deinem Mindset übereinstimmt, sei zukünftig als einer unserer 650 deutschen Kollegen mit dabei! Durch modernste Digitalisierung ermöglichen wir unseren Kunden vorausschauend zu agieren, zu wachsen und erfolgreich zu sein. Wir machen Sage zur einer führenden SaaS Company. Und über unsere Foundation setzen wir uns für die Gesellschaft ein.

ERP Customer Support (m/w/d)

Schwerpunkt Produktion und Handel

Mönchengladbach - Hybrid

Details zur Rolle

Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und liebst es, Kunden bei ihren technischen Fragen zu helfen, damit sie erfolgreich sein können?

Dann haben wir genau das Richtige für Dich!

Als Customer Service Specialist unterstützt und betreust Du unsere Kunden und Partner aus dem Produktions- und Handelsbereich sowie unsere Implementierungspartner in unserer ERP-Lösung Sage b7 bei Problemfällen in der Anwendung, im Handling oder Fehlerfall als Produktspezialist.

Wie würde Dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen?

2nd-Level-Betreuung unserer Kunden rund um das ERP-Produkt Sage b7 
Analyse und Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen, insbesondere aus dem Produktionsbereich innerhalb der ERP-Applikation 
Debugging funktioneller Probleme auf Test- und Kundensystemen 
Zusammenarbeit (meist virtuell) mit ERP-Consultants und Businesspartnern, um nachhaltige Lösungen für nationale Kunden zu entwickeln 
Ableitung von Maßnahmen zur Produktverbesserung aus vergangenen Analysen und Aufbereitung von Fehlerbeispielen für die Entwicklungsabteilung 
Pflege der internen Wissensdatenbank 
Mitarbeit an internen Projekten rund um Support-Tools und -Prozesse 

Was erwartet Dich in den ersten 90 Tagen?

Du wirst ein Onboarding sowohl in die Sage-Support-Prozesse als auch zu unserem Produkt Sage b7 als Überblick über alle Bereiche erhalten und anschließend ein Spezialgebiet vertiefen, um dort eigenverantwortlich für Support-Tickets Bereichsspezialist zu werden.

Training und die erste gemeinsame Bearbeitung von Fällen werden vorwiegend teamintern oder mit unserem Entwicklungsteam stattfinden, mit dem wir eng zusammenarbeiten.

Standort

Diese Rolle ist an unserem modernen Standort in Mönchengladbach hybrid mit 2 Home-Office-Tagen pro Woche zu besetzen

Anforderungen und weitere Informationen

Das bringst Du mit

Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, bist neugierig und hast Freude daran, Dich in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten. 
Du interessierst Dich für Software, deren Architektur und Parametrisierung, und verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL - insbesondere auf MSSQL-Servern und Oracle-Datenbanken. 
Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise im Produktions- und Handelsumfeld. 
Erste Erfahrung im IT-Service Center oder Helpdesk ist von Vorteil - alternativ bringst Du die Bereitschaft mit, proaktiv mit Kunden per Telefon oder Ticket-System zu kommunizieren. 
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift. 
Ein gutes Verständnis für ERP-Systeme oder wirtschaftliche Softwarelösungen rundet Dein Profil ab. 

Warum Sage?

Wir bieten eine attraktive Vergütung (Basisgehalt + Bonus) und weitere Benefits wie bspw. VL, Aktiensparprogramme, Shoppingrabatte, Bike Leasing, gratis Getränke in unseren Büros und vieles mehr. 
Die Möglichkeit von bis zu 10 Wochen "Workation" im Jahr durch unser Work Away Programm. 
30 Tage Urlaub pro Kalenderjahr. 
Bis zu 5 Tage Sonderurlaub pro Jahr bei gemeinnützigem Engagement über unsere "Sage Foundation". 
Eine spannende Herausforderung in einem innovativen und wachsenden Unternehmen, das Deine Fähigkeiten und Ideen wertschätzt. 
Ein motiviertes Team, das Dich unterstützt und in dem Zusammenarbeit und Spaß an der Arbeit großgeschrieben werden. 

Klingt interessant?

Bist Du bereit, gemeinsam mit uns Großes zu erreichen und Teil unseres dynamischen Customer Operations Teams zu werden? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Referenznummer (in der Bewerbung bitte angeben).

Deine Bewerbung können wir aus datenschutzrechtlichen Gründen ausschließlich über unser Karriereportal berücksichtigen. Bitte fasse Deine Unterlagen in 1 Dokument (PDF) mit max. 10MB zusammen und lade dies über unsere Karriereseite hoch.

Ein inkludiertes Motivationsschreiben ist optional, hilft uns jedoch, Deine Beweggründe besser zu verstehen.

Weitere Insights bekommst Du über unsere Seiten und Posts auf den gängigen Social Media-Kanälen sowie auf unserer Homepage.

Como la gente de las personas, apreciamos la confianza, la compatibilidad del trabajo y la vida privada y la diversidad. Trabajamos 12,000 de una amplia variedad de personalidades en 23 países: lo que nos une es la misma mentalidad: cooperar, desarrollarnos más y trabajar juntos. Si esto coincide con su mentalidad, ¡estará allí en el futuro como uno de nuestros 650 colegas alemanes! Estará encantado de trabajar con usted, tiene curiosidad, tiene curiosidad y disfrutas familiarizándote con nuevas áreas temáticas. description:
Sorgen Sie gemeinsam mit uns für die digitale Zukunftsfähigkeit der Bundeswehr. 

Als primärer Digitalisierungspartner der Bundeswehr erbringen wir stabile, sichere und effiziente IT-Services im In- und Ausland, vom Grundbetrieb bis in den einsatznahen Bereich und tragen so zur kontinuierlichen Erhöhung der Führungs- und Einsatzfähigkeit der Bundeswehr bei. Mit über 7.000 Kolleg innen betreiben und modernisieren wir eine der größten und komplexesten IT-Infrastrukturen in Deutschland. Wir suchen verantwortungsvolle IT-Spezialist innen, die die Bundeswehr-IT aus Überzeugung in herausfordernden Digitalisierungsvorhaben weiterentwickeln und so einen Beitrag zur Sicherheit Deutschlands leisten wollen.

Die Customer Solution Unit ERP erstellt für den Kunden Bundeswehr IT Lösungen auf Basis der SAP Cloud Produkte und berät intern sowie den Kunden Bundesamt für Ausrüstung, Informationstechnik und Nutzung der Bundeswehr (BAAINBw) in allen Themengebieten der Architektur ERP / SAP mit einem engagierten Team von IT-Architekten. Wir übernehmen dabei Verantwortung für bestehende ERP-Anwendungen und entwickeln neue Lösungen auf Basis von innovativen Technologien und Produkten. Wir möchten unser Cloud Kompetenz Team mit IT-Architekten verstärken, welche Neugier, Kompetenz, Engagement und Interesse für ERP / SAP-Anwendungen und Cloud-Technologie mitbringen und neuen Themen offen gegenüberstehen.

Ihre Aufgaben

Zuständigkeit für ERP Architekturdesign und -beratung 
Erstellung von Architekturkonzepten und IT- Lösungsdokumenten unter Anwendung einer methodischen Vorgehensweise 
Aufnahme, Analyse und Bewertung von Architekturanforderungen und Festlegung der durchzuführenden Aktivitäten 
Erstellung von Beiträgen zur Weiterentwicklung und Fortschreibung der Referenzarchitektur ERP und des Clusterprogramms ERP 
Verantwortliche Planung der Einführung und Migration von Cloud ERP Services sowie der Nutzung von Cloud-Anwendungen 
Design von ERP Lösungen auf Basis von hybriden Architekturen, die das Zusammenspiel von On-Premise- und cloudbasierten IT-Anteilen berücksichtigen 
Mitwirkung am Know-how-Aufbau im Team ERP-Architektur 

Ihr Profil

Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung i.V.m. einschlägiger Berufserfahrung 
Mindestens 2 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung als IT-Architekt 
Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Architekturmethodiken und den entsprechenden Werkzeugen 
Gute Kenntnisse im Cloud-Umfeld (PaaS, SaaS), SAP Cloud-Umfeld und Kenntnisse im Bereich DevSecOps 
Sicherer Umgang mit Architekturframeworks wie z.B. TOGAF und NAF und Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Architekturmethodiken 
Leistungsbereitschaft und Flexibilität 
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift) 

Wir Bieten

Durch abwechslungsreiche und gesellschaftlich relevante Aufgaben gewährleisten wir die IT-Sicherheit und Zukunftsfähigkeit Deutschlands 
Die BWI bietet eine marktgerechte Vergütung, einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz sowie eine prämierte und arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge 
Sie starten grundsätzlich mit 30 Tagen Jahresurlaub mit Option auf individuelle Anpassungen 
Wir ermöglichen Ihnen Flexibilität, um Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen, etwa durch mobiles Arbeiten oder Vertrauensarbeitszeit 
Sie können ein Wertguthabenkonto aufbauen, um dieses perspektivisch z.B. für ein Sabbatical einzusetzen 
An 20 Tagen im Jahr ist mobiles Arbeiten in zahlreichen europäischen Staaten möglich 
Bei beruflichen oder persönlichen Fragestellungen können Sie eine professionelle externe Beratung in Anspruch nehmen

description_final: Junto con nosotros, garantice la viabilidad futura digital de Bundeswehr. Como socio de digitalización principal de Bundeswehr, proporcionamos servicios de TI estables, seguros y eficientes en el hogar y en el extranjero, desde operaciones básicas hasta el área de uso y, por lo tanto, contribuimos al aumento continuo en la gestión y la capacidad operativa de las Bundeswehr. Komm' ins Team!

Theben ist ein weltweit führender Premiumanbieter. Mit über 800 Mitarbeiter:innen entwickelt und produziert das Familienunternehmen innovative Zeitschaltuhren, Bewegungs- und Präsenzmelder sowie Systeme für die Gebäudeautomation. _____________________________________________________

Du hast ein Händchen für smarte Lösungen, denkst gerne in Prozessen und fühlst dich in IT-Systemen zuhause? Dann bring deine Stärken bei uns ein! In unserer IT gestaltest du als Application Developer unsere ERP-Welt aktiv mit – und sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitalen Abläufe reibungslos funktionieren und mitwachsen.

Deine Zukunft bei uns: Code mit Sinn, Systeme mit Wirkung.

Du entwickelst neue Funktionen und Anwendungen im ERP-Umfeld – vom Konzept bis zum Rollout.
Du passt das ERP-System Proalpha durch Customizing an unsere Prozesse an.
Du konzipierst und programmierst Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen und betreust deren laufenden Betrieb.
Du berätst Fachbereiche und Key-User in allen ERP-Fragen und fungierst als zentraler Ansprechpartnerin.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ERP-Projekte und bist im 2nd-Level-Support aktiv.
Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unseres ERP-Ökosystems und leitest Kolleg:innen oder Azubis an.

Was Du Mitbringst

Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in oder ein Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung im ERP-Umfeld – idealerweise mit Proalpha.
Du beherrschst moderne Programmiersprachen (z. B. C#, Progress ABL/OpenEdge, Java, SQL) und arbeitest routiniert mit relationalen Datenbanksystemen.
Du verstehst die Prozesse in Produktion und Logistik und kannst sie systemseitig abbilden.
Du arbeitest selbstständig, denkst lösungsorientiert und besitzt eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – in Wort und Schrift.

Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklung.
Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein agiles Team mit starkem Zusammenhalt.
Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und attraktive Sozialleistungen.

Your work will focus on understanding business needs, enhancing ERP functionality, and ensuring accuracy and compliance in areas such as contract/service billing and government accounting.

Gathering and documenting business requirements from stakeholders.
Analyzing and mapping business processes to identify areas for improvement.
Collaborating with IT and development teams to implement system changes and enhancements.
Supporting finance teams with government accounting processes, including indirect rates and compliance.
Providing training and ongoing support to end-users.
Conducting regular system audits to maintain data integrity.
Documenting system processes and changes.
Assisting in testing and validating updates and new features.

Bachelor's degree in business administration, IT, or related field.
5+ years of Business Analyst experience, ideally with JD Edwards ERP.
Strong understanding of ERP systems and business workflows.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related tools.
Experience with contract/service billing and government billing systems (e.g., Deltek Costpoint, JD Edwards).
Familiarity with indirect rates (pools and bases) and indirect rate development.
Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and collaboratively.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of SQL and database management.

Job Description

ERP Data Analyst II - Remote, US

About Packsize

Packsize is an automation company that enables more efficient and sustainable packaging process flows from packing to unboxing. We’re propelling our customers and the industry forward, always looking to innovate and improve. Because, to us, packaging is about much more than a box, it’s about delivering what’s right, for our customers, for their customers and our planet.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Data Analyst with expertise in data governance to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, implementing, and maintaining master data solutions within our data governance platform, Precisely. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure data standards are upheld, processes are streamlined, and data is effectively leveraged across the organization.

What You'll Do

Build, configure, and maintain master data solutions in Precisely to support enterprise data governance objectives. 
Partner with business and technical teams to define, document, and enforce data governance policies, procedures, and standards. 
Monitor data quality and integrity, identifying gaps or inconsistencies and implementing corrective actions. 
Develop and maintain data models, workflows, and reporting dashboards to support operational and strategic decisions. 
Provide training and support to users to ensure adoption and correct utilization of the data governance tools. 
Communicate progress and updates to the ERP Data Management Lead and other relevant stakeholders 
Develop and maintain data governance processes and procedures 
Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to integrate Precisely with systems such as SAP and other enterprise platforms. 
Drive continuous improvement initiatives in data management processes. 

Additions

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data needs and ensure that the master data meets their requirements while maintaining integrity 
Ensure master data is complete, accurate, and up-to-date 
Run analysis on master data and complete updates in mass when new requirements or changes are implemented 
Provide training and support to business users on how to use master data effectively 
Work with other IT/IS team members to integrate data with other systems and applications and understand the impacts 
Ensures cross-functional access to systems 
Documents, delivers, and administers training and related materials to end users 
May provide system support following implementation of new data processes 
May provide leadership, coaching, and/or mentoring to a subordinate group 

What You'll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience). 
2+ years of experience in a data governance or data management role. 
Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, formulas, macros, data analysis tools). 
Hands-on experience with SAP and preferably Precisely or Winshuttle. 
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
Strong understanding of data structures and processes 
Experience working with offshore teams 
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and levels of the organization. 
Strong understanding of master data management (MDM) principles and best practices. 
Handles moderately complex issues and problems, and refers more complex issues to higher-level staff 
Ability to translate complex technical details into business-friendly language. 

Preferred Skills

Experience with data quality frameworks and compliance standards. 
Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and automation. 

What We Offer

The salary range for this role is [$85,000 USD - $105,000 USD]; however, Packsize considers several factors when determining compensation when extending a job offer, including but not limited to, the role being offered, the associated responsibilities, the candidate's prior work experience, education/training, and any special skills.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet each requirement listed, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Packsize, we welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences and understand that the best candidates may come from the most unlikely of places.

Packsize is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. In compliance with applicable federal and state laws, Packsize policy of equal employment opportunity prohibits discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, veteran’s status, status as a qualified person with a disability, or genetic information. Individuals from historically underrepresented groups, such as minorities, women, qualified persons with disabilities, and protected veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodations in the application process will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Job Overview

The Delivery Manager will act as the key liaison between business units, ERP implementation partners, and IT during the organization’s ERP transformation journey, migrating from SAP ECC6 to a modern cloud-based ERP platform (e.g., SAP Grow, Oracle Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, or Microsoft D365). The role is critical in challenging legacy processes, eliminating inefficiencies, and ensuring alignment with global ERP best practices while embedding strict regulatory compliance requirements relevant to the banking industry.

Key Responsibilities
Lead AS-IS and TO-BE process mapping across Finance, Procurement, HR, Asset Management, and other critical functions.
Identify and drive the elimination of redundant steps, manual workarounds, and excessive controls that do not add value.
Collaborate with ERP vendors to ensure system configurations align with business requirements and industry best practices.
Facilitate cross-functional workshops to gather requirements, build consensus, and secure stakeholder sign-offs on future-state designs.
Integrate regulatory requirements (BSP, AMLA, BIR) into ERP process changes to ensure compliance.
Oversee data migration activities, including mapping, validation, and fit-gap analysis.
Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders by challenging outdated processes constructively and promoting adoption of standardized SaaS ERP functionalities.
Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery of transformation milestones.

Skills & Competencies
7–10 years of experience in Business Analysis and Delivery Management, with at least 3 years dedicated to ERP transformation projects (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).
Strong knowledge of banking operations, including finance, procurement, and HR domains.
Proven expertise in process modeling and documentation (BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart).
Strong understanding of internal controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication, and facilitation skills across both business and IT teams.
Ability to challenge legacy processes diplomatically while influencing adoption of modern ERP practices.
Strong problem-solving skills with a structured, detail-oriented approach.

Work setup: Pure Onsite
Location: BGC, Taguig
Shift: Day Shift

Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership.
